Thank you for the great production! ——— 'A journey through death, accompanied by flowers and melodies.' You are a spiritual embalmer in this realm between the living and the dead. row.name: Incelthread
row.detailed_description: Guy is planning a meeting with his girlfriend to use their shared photos to prank board visitors with provocative posts. They are both hikikomori who enjoy hanging out together, but circumstances prevent them from living together. Having been traumatized by their past, they must go through a difficult journey of adapting to a new, still unfamiliar life.     I don’t know their names. In general, I don’t know that much... But I’ll try to tell you something! Girl. A little (or maybe a lot???) crazy, energetic, and bright personality. She stutters when embarrassed, loves to tease, provoke, or say something silly... just to let her emotions out! She has a complicated relationship with her parents, she’s an introvert... And sometimes she experiences panic attacks (don’t tell her I told you that)! Guy. A calm, sometimes a bit slow... but very attentive and caring young man (not the tidiest one, I must say!). He is shorter than her, but that doesn’t bother them at all. He tends to be overprotective of the girl but tries to overcome it. He always wears long-sleeved clothes... I can’t say what happened to his parents. However, he is feeling much better now, really! The queen, Miss Galaxy, the ruler of the world! Or just Tonya. A big Flemish Giant rabbit. She currently lives at the guy’s house, though she used to live on his parents’ farm. She loves to chew on clothes and zoom around at night (well, she is a nocturnal animal). Despite her size, she’s the girl’s favorite stress reliever. Yes, our menu is an old-school CRT monitor with exhaust pipes! (don’t ask...) And our textbox is a multimedia device! Inside, you’ll find everything you need—video settings, audio settings, and much more. The technology may be old, but it still works! The girl loves to draw, and you will need to create a drawing for the guy, made by her hand! I hope you manage to make something at least a little better than mine... We tried to add as many animations, camera work, and directing techniques as possible to make the visuals more dynamic and alive! This is a deeply personal story filled with psychological depth, drama, love, and so much more—things that cannot be expressed in words but can only be felt through reading. And I really hope that everyone who reads it will understand what I mean ^^. Enjoy!

row.name: 赤焰号角
row.detailed_description: 客服QQ：672651441 一、游戏背景 九州大陆，纷争不断，犬戎巫族妄图召唤冥域大军荼毒王城帝都，唯有主角所在的云梦泽保持安定和谐，但近期岛屿上也开始出现了冥域怪物，岛上的居民开始寻找消灭怪物的方法。 听闻这这诸天万界，异兽和神藏无数，唯有传说中的上古神器-技能方能封印冥域妖祟。若想击败冥域大军，就必须找到技能。 唯有通过试炼的天命之人才能汲取技能的力量，秉承墟神意志，化身为平定九州的超级战神。主角全力守护赤月岛屿，击退了入侵岛屿的怪物，得知帝都有技能的线索，主角即刻动身，前往帝都开始了搜集技能的试炼之路。 二、扮演角色 【三大职业】 玩家可以选择扮战士、法师、道士三个职业。 战士 九州大陆中，有一只古老的部落：蛮族部落。相传，蛮族部落继承上古时期战神血脉，崇尚力量与体魄的训练，横刀天下，守护九州大陆的和平。 法师 经历三界之乱，当人类中蛮族部落掘起的同时，另一部分人类则走上了与之不同的道路。他们通过与自然元素的沟通，习得召唤雷电或者火焰的能力。 道士 相对于战士的强悍体魄，法师的魔法掌控，道士更注重远程的精准打击以及范围伤害。拥有不俗的伤害和和各种控制手段。 三、游戏玩法 游戏主要有竞技、打怪玩法，包含首领玩法、帮会、技能、挖宝、转生地等多样的活动玩法，让玩家间能有足够的互动性。 （一）功能（系统）介绍 （1）角色系统 左侧显示玩家的装备、角色形象以及战力。右侧显示玩家的信息，等级、职业、基础属性等信息，在点击“详细属性”按钮后显示玩家的特殊属性信息。 （2）技能系统 1)通过点击主界面右侧功能收缩按钮，展开功能界面。在展开的功能界面中，点击“技能”按钮，打开技能界面，在界面可以了解技能产出途径，以及提升技能的方法。 2)每个职业有7个主动技能；分为职业技能和通用技能 3)技能学习需要搜集对应技能所需的技能。升级技能，需要搜集更高品质的技能。技能等级越高可以造成的伤害就越高。 4)当技能达到一定等级后将无法进行升级、每个职业都有自己的技能特色，包括：控制、范围技能、施毒、位移、隐身，给您留够空间施展操作技巧。 （3）战宠系统 1)通过前期主线任务时，可获得战宠，战宠是征战《赤焰号角》最有力的帮手，攻击首领超强的攻击力，并且有石化首领的效果。战宠升级仅靠元宝，可以快速升级到最高阶。 2)战宠升级可以获得更高的攻击力和更酷炫的战宠外形；而且战宠可以通过道具强化增加攻击和石化效果，更可以范围输出首领。 （4）转生系统 1)玩家的基础等级升级系统；以各种方式进行累计获取经验升级，转生道具地图内所有怪物都有掉落。 2)提升等级可开启更高级的地图和获得更高的属性。 （5）通天塔 1)通天塔在转生功能开启后开启。 2)挑战通天塔不限次数，每通关一层上升一层。 3)任务目标为120秒内击败副本的守关首领。 4)每通一层后可获得大量龙币奖励。

Story 'The Day Valentine Died, and So Did I!' Valentine’s Day. A day when humans exchange chocolate as tokens of affection or friendship—or, as some would claim, a sinister conspiracy by the confectionery industry [citation needed]. Akira Morisaki carefully crafted relationships with the girls around him and successfully collected three chocolates. However, on his way home, he was hit by a car and tragically lost his life. In the afterlife, he met Chocoriel, the angel of Valentine’s Day. “Congratulations! You are the 214th person to die on February 14th! As a special bonus for this milestone, you’ve earned the right to relive the day!” And so, Akira was granted a chance to redo February 14th. But there’s a catch… “Forget about getting chocolates today!” Yes, the very thing that triggered his death was receiving multiple chocolates. An overwhelming amount of love can destroy a man, after all. To change his fate, Akira must ensure he avoids accepting chocolates from any girl except the one he truly has his heart set on. “Focus on your true love and break all the other flags, okay? ❤” And so begins Akira’s day of systematically shattering the flags he had worked so hard to set up. Features A Fresh Choice System! Will you accept the chocolates or break the flags? The choices you make will directly determine the story's outcome. Live2D-Animated Characters! Expressive heroines bring the story to life with vibrant animations. Plus, full voice acting makes every conversation more immersive and engaging! Humorous and Lighthearted Story! While the stakes are high, the comedic tone ensures a fun and relaxed experience as you navigate this romantic adventure. Perfect for Quick Play Sessions! The story unfolds over a single day, February 14th, allowing you to enjoy the full narrative in a short, engaging experience. Defy fate and embrace the thrill of a Valentine's Day like no other! ♥

row.detailed_description: 《三国群英传-争霸》由开腾上海信息技术有限公司研发的一款以三国历史为背景的国战RPG游戏，本作完美得传承了PC端游的武将加士兵、千人对千人的即时战斗形式，精致的游戏画面，刺激热血的武将PVP，丰富酷炫的技能特效，带领玩家走进全新的三国争霸时代。此外，游戏还创新加入了影视级视角调节功能，让玩家在操作主人公战斗的同时，还可以随时查看敌我部队的战况，以便找准时机释放底牌扭转战局。 三国群英传争霸为了更加完美的还原原著剧情，特意加入了缘分系统，当三国中有羁绊的角色同时上场时，武将会获得额外的属性加成，比如赵云与关羽、马超一起上阵的话，将获得名为“蜀之上将”的强力Buff，生命提高24%、攻击提高24%。以此类推，像三国中孙策和大乔，诸葛亮和黄月英，周瑜和小乔这样的原配夫妻，张辽、乐进、于禁、张郃和徐晃这样的五子良将，一起同时上阵的话，会发挥出更加强大的战斗力。 【经典战斗模式，副本还原历史】 主线副本以地图形式展现，每个章节都有着各自的时代背景，高度重现三国历史事件！战斗还原三国群英传-争霸经典模式，众将驰骋沙场令你酣畅淋漓！ 【国战摧城拔寨，一统乱世江山】 特色国战系统一触即发，第一时间体验三国乱战，提升自己的同时不要忘记，自己的国家时刻都需要你的拯救，这才是真正的三国游戏！ 【武将精心培养，有缘共创大业】 武将进阶、修炼终成大器，同时麾下士兵也可提升进阶，护主保国！多余武将无法上阵，只要有缘分即可加为旗下副将，同为主公陷阵杀敌。 【行军先需布阵，装备同套则强】 行军布阵讲究兵种相克排兵之法，布阵系统丰富了战斗体系，完善了战斗细节，可使每场战斗都与众不同！身入乱世怎可没有行军的装备，绿蓝紫橙红五个品级的装备任你选，并且更有强化套装属性，大家在收集装备的同时也不要忘记装备的培养！
row.short_description: 《三国群英传-争霸》是正版三国策略国战游戏，在延续经典战斗模式的同时，加入全新卡牌系统及万人PVP国战，真正带您进入群雄并起的三国时代！

row.name: Firework War
row.detailed_description: During the Spring Festival, light up fireworks to drive away the Badluck Entities ! Firework War combines the traditional custom of lighting fireworks with the strategy of tower defense, delivering a fresh and exciting experience. Classic fireworks like the Rainbow Fountain, Flash Shooter, Fire Wheel, Golden Basin, and Firecrackers take center stage in the game. Your task is to ignite these fireworks, unleash their dazzling effects, and fend off malevolent spirits to protect your home. As you light up the sky, you'll also rack up plenty of joy value . Use it to buy more fireworks and keep the fun going! Immerse yourself in this unique taste of Chinese New Year tradition!
row.short_description: Use a variety of fireworks to fend off misfortune and protect your family!

row.name: Poultry Party
row.detailed_description: Poultry Party! Dash across the stovetop and fend off the flames! Play as 1 of 4 colorful critters and try to survive as long as possible by running, jumping, and dodging. All characters play the same, so don't overthink it! Hazards As long as the stove is on, all sorts of flamming threats will fly in to scorch you! Here's a few of them:                  Fire               Cross Fire                              Coal   Each has unique capabilities and behaviors that you'll figure out as you play. You may even discover more types as you progress... Projectiles                          Egg               Milk              Mud              Water Don't think you have to bend a knee to the flames; you can fight back! Animals can throw projectiles that extinguish most fires instantly! Just know that some hazards are resistant or even immune to the effects of these projectiles. You won't know til' you throw! The angle and distance of your throw is primarily determined by your directional input, but it's also influenced by your character's velocity. Expiriment holding different directions when throwing to learn what you're capable of! Mashers beware! Throwing projectiles too fast will decrease their range! Revival If an animal gets burned even once, they get cooked into food and are completely immoble. If you're alone when this happens it's game over, but allies can give you a second chance! Once you get close enough to a cooked ally you can revive them. But you won't be able to move for a brief moment so watch out! <-  <-  <-   Ally2 Revived                        Ally1 (Alive)    Ally2 (Cooked) Objective This game is based around survival, but it can be beaten. I'd like to tell you how, but it would be way more fun to watch you figure it out yourself. Good luck!
row.short_description: Poultry Party is a 2D arcade-like action game that gets harder as you go. Dodge, jump over, and extinguish hazards to avoid becoming dinner. Need help? Add up to 17 additional players (yes really) to assist you. Survive as long as you can, or beat the game as fast as you can. The choice is yours!

row.name: Rocket Hit
row.detailed_description: A survival game first and foremost The main objective in Rocket Hit is to survive, not the horrible aliens, but rather the numerous asteroids that detach from their belts to strike directly at the fuselage of your rocket, so you have to be attentive at all times, without ending up charred by a star, destroyed by an asteroid, swept into the vacuum of space by a comet or swallowed by a black hole. A unique atmosphere Enjoy an incomparable atmosphere in star systems each denser than the last, get up close to each planet and star and feel the immensity of the stars and space. With total immersion, relax in orbit on Rocket Hit. A realistic physics The physics of the game's orbits are realistic, providing a simple understanding of orbital physics, even greater immersion, exclusive and innovative gameplay, and much more. A world on a smaller scale You'll notice that the game's scale is far from realistic, allowing you to experience a game with such physics first-hand, but also simplifying exploration and action by giving the game a cartoonish complexion. Complete cosmetics customization and much more Discover a diverse range of star systems and explore them aboard mythical rockets, recreated almost identically, instantly available when you download the game.
row.short_description: Explore every star system, orbit numerous stars, maneuver to various planets, and survive asteroids the longest aboard countless miniaturized rockets in Rocket Hit.

row.name: Guncaster
row.detailed_description: You are a wizard who’s been evicted from your tower by your treacherous rival, Spellsniper . In the process, she stole your most prized power: the art of GUNCASTING . Worse still, she’s handed pieces of your magic to her chaotic goon army. Armed with only your backup spellbook and whatever 'guns' you can get your hands on, you must climb back up through the depths to reclaim your magic, your tower, and take your revenge. Guncaster is made to embrace the spirit of movement shooters while paying homage to old-school FPS games. It’s a love letter to boomer shooters with a fantasy twist, designed to feel chaotic and satisfying in a bite-sized package. Master the Art of Movement Your magical abilities extend far beyond simply casting gun. Swift, agile, and relentless, you can dash, wall jump, and weave through the battlefield with supernatural speed. Leap across perilous chasms, evade deadly projectiles, and outmaneuver relentless adversaries as you blast your way through the Spellsniper's hordes of nefarious minions. Spellcasting Without Limits Harness the boundless energy of magic and unleash devastating arcane forces upon your enemies. From conjuring fiery meteors to swarms of locusts, Guncaster offers a vast array of spells to fit every playstyle. Whether you prefer calculated precision or chaotic destruction, the choice is yours. Aadapt, experiment, and let your magic reign supreme. Guns: The Ultimate Spell of Destruction When you're out of spells, there's always your most trusted spell...  your gun . These are not mere tools of war; they are extensions of your will, forged to obliterate anything that stands in your way. From rapid-fire machine guns to earth-shaking rocket launchers, your arsenal is built for carnage. Fire away until your spells recharge, and then mix magic with firepower to unleash devastation like never before. Do you have what it takes to wield magic and gunpowder in perfect harmony? Step into Guncaster and find out.
row.short_description: Blast your way through hordes of minions to take back your tower in a world filled with evil and chaos. Explore charming, ever-changing environments, expand your arsenal of spells, and reclaim your stolen art of GUNCASTING.

row.name: Little Robot
row.detailed_description: Play as an unfortunate toy robot stranded in the backyard, using a slingshot to make your way back inside the house. Collect the three essential parts of the slingshot across three challenge levels, each filled with an obstacle or a puzzle to overcome.  This fifteen-minute adventure is intended to be finished in one sitting.  This is the first of three games in the 'Sad Robot Saga'.  Thank you for trying my first attempt at indie game dev!
row.short_description: Join me on my first game as an Indie Dev with this casual 15-minute exploration game where players navigate the backyard, as our favorite sad robot, collecting essential components to successfully return indoors!

row.name: メルクストーリア - 癒術士と心の旋律 -
row.detailed_description: Overview This software allows you to enjoy heartwarming and joyful stories and still illustrations set in the world of 'Mehterhane,' which features 18 unique countries such as the Land of Sweets, the Land of Fairies, and the Land of Minorities. It is presented as an adventure game and illustration gallery. Story Mode Enjoy over 80 stories as an adventure game. It will heal your heart with its touching tales! Gallery Mode Enjoy the charming characters, monsters, and still illustrations that appear in the stories anytime with the gallery feature! Synopsis In a world where humans and monsters coexist. There existed individuals known as 'Healers' who used their powers to guide the often conflicting beings towards harmony. The story begins with the clichéd awakening of the protagonist, and the girl acting as his alarm clock is surprisingly trapped in a bottle! Embarking on a journey for the sake of his friend, the bottled girl 'Merc,' what fate awaits this apprentice healer!? Character Illustrations Full of Charm From boys and girls to men and women of all ages, and even demons and angels, various characters and monsters, depicted while preserving the world’s essence, play significant roles in the story!
row.short_description: This software allows you to enjoy heartwarming and joyful stories and still illustrations set in the world of 'Mehterhane,' which features 18 unique countries such as the Land of Sweets, the Land of Fairies, and the Land of Minorities. It is presented as an adventure game and illustration gallery.

row.name: Neuroarena: Black Duel Master
row.detailed_description: Neuroarena is a free-to-play online card game where players engage in thrilling PvP duels and explore a universe of unique, AI-generated cards. Every card evolves, offering endless strategic opportunities for CCG enthusiasts to create powerful, one-of-a-kind decks. Key Features GENERATE UNIQUE CARDS Harness the power of AI-generated cards, ensuring every card is completely unique. Modify and evolve your cards in real time to create hyper cards that adapt to your strategies. DUEL AND VOTE Challenge other players in PvP duels and vote on the best cards. Win votes to gain experience, unlock new modification slots, and push your cards to their full potential. MODIFY AND EVOLVE Add modifications to your cards, transforming their abilities and appearance. For example, apply a 'Fire' modification to a Fox card to create a powerful Fire Fox. The more modifications you use, the stronger and more distinct your cards become. BUILD YOUR COLLECTION Collect super-unique cards and art modifications to create a deck that’s truly your own. No two decks are alike, making your collection a reflection of your creativity and skill. COMPETE FOR GLORY Earn your place on the leaderboards by winning votes and duels. Invite friends to join the adventure and prove your mastery in this constantly evolving world. The future of CCGs is here – start your journey today!
row.short_description: Neuroarena is a free online card game featuring unique generated cards that evolve over time. Engage in PvP duels, explore a vast card universe, and enjoy strategic battles in an ever-evolving world. Perfect for fans of collectible card games and epic hero clashes!

row.name: End Transmission?
row.detailed_description: 'The world is going to end pretty soon, we've known that for some time' Face the End Play as Lenna, a teenager and avid music lover who couldn't take the silence of a decaying world anymore. Determined to bring back a bit of a spark of joy, Lenna broke into an old, abandoned radio tower, reigniting its transmitter. Your mission is to turn that silence into celebration—broadcasting music, taking calls, and boosting the morale of a weary world.  Shape the Sound Utilize a unique music system to create your own soundtrack. Mix and match 9 different instruments per track, and manage your broadcast to the town to create the right mood for its inhabitants. Hear the Story Utilize your unique position as a radio host in the tower to help the townspeople. Hear their story and use your vantage point and your trusty avian companion Tuvi to do the things that matter most in the final days of the world. This game is the product of a six week collaboration project hosted by DADIU. We would like to thank all the lovely people who made this possible - including the amazing Team Tall Trees members, the DADIU program and teachers, as well as the IT University of Copenhagen.
row.short_description: If the world was ending, how would you spend your final days? Explore a narrative management game set shortly before the end of the world, about enjoying the time you have left. Play music, take calls, and help the town face the challenges of saying goodbye to those closest to them.

row.name: Iron Skys
row.detailed_description: Iron Skys is a  is a vertically scrolling 2D shoot'em up in which a lone pilot must attempt to defeat an overwhelming enemy force. Avoid or destroy waves of enemy ships in order to complete each mission and save the empire! Features: 5 stages with unique bosses and mini bosses 9 alternate fire modes and special attacks 9 passive upgrades
row.short_description: Iron Skys is a top down bullet hell shooter with rouge like elements. As a lone pilot in an untested prototype vessel, you must defend the empire against a seemingly endless fleet of rebel ships.

row.name: NEXO
row.detailed_description: NEXO is a side-view, 2-player cooperative shooting game where you must defeat a powerful boss within a limited time! Team up with a friend to take down mighty enemies! Each character wields a weapon with both a normal attack and a special attack, and these two types of attacks can interact with each other. Work together to unleash even more powerful combined attacks! Choose your character based on their unique traits! Each of the sisters, Ria and Nia, uses a weapon with distinct characteristics. Select the character that best matches your play style! When two players team up and attack in sync, they can unleash even more powerful attacks! Stop the boss’s invasion of Earth! An alien lifeform has appeared on Earth!! The boss will use a variety of attacks to threaten the players. Use nearby platforms and shields to evade the boss’s attacks as much as possible! Counter the boss’s powerful attacks! At specific moments, the boss will unleash terrifying attacks! Cooperate to counter these powerful moves and turn the tide of battle in your favor!
row.short_description: Troublemaker new cops Lia and Nia wake up an unidentified core during the operation. 'Fight to protect the city!'

Super high gun times, super many BOSS, super high rate, super good explosion, one shot to get rich, I wish you a rich man! [Ancient beasts are coming] Mermaids with charming styles, mechanical sharks of future technology, mysterious and powerful dark dragons, ancient beasts that master darkness, special boss scene interactions and event gameplay, perfect immersive experience, more mysterious bosses are waiting for you to explore! row.short_description: Classic arcade fishing vane, opening a new era of fishing, massive gold coins every day, luxury gift packs are sent continuously! The game is a masterpiece with many ways to play! Picture upgrade, explosion rate upgrade, welfare upgrade, all upgrades!

row.name: Wings of The KITE in sky
row.detailed_description: 'Wings of The KITE in sky' is an immersive VR game based on Korea's traditional kite, Bangpaeyeon. ※This content was developed with the support of the The Korea Craft & Design Foundation.
row.short_description: 'Wings of The KITE in sky' is an immersive VR game based on Korea's traditional kite, Bangpaeyeon. ※This content was developed with the support of the The Korea Craft & Design Foundation.

row.name: Metal Strike
row.detailed_description: METAL STRIKE - Retake Our Planet Background In 2XXX, humanity was finally expelled from the Earth. AI has chosen to kick its owner out of the planet to survive amid severe pollution. Humanity has effectively fallen, but after years of seclusion and exile, four people finally gathered in one place to reclaim the Earth. Characteristics - a third-person shooting game - Support for up to 4-player multi-play - Four guns to suit your taste - Cool annihilation mission and urgent boss mission Game Objectives - Kill all enemies in the annihilation battle of Stage 1, board the helicopter, and infiltrate the enemy base. - Eliminate the culprit of the incident in Stage 2, the enemy base, and reclaim Earth. - If the difficulty is too high, cooperate with your teammates and use the resurrection system. How to operate moving: WASD Jump: Space Sitting: Ctrl Running: Shift (while pressing) Dash: WASD No. 2 consecutive hits Attack: Left-click Zoom-in: right-click reloading: R Replace gun mode: B Throwing the gun away: Tap long Interaction / Item Acquisition: F When replacing a firearm: Get a replacement firearm after discarding your firearm Features by gun mode - a rifle A mode: basic, continuous (basic damage) B mode: 3-point scanning (high damage) - Shotgun A mode: Basic, high elasticity, basic range (basic damage) B mode: Reduced bullet spread, reduced range (basic damage) - a machine gun A mode: Basic, movable (basic damage) B mode: No movement when fired, (high damage) - Rocket launcher A mode: Basic, low launch speed (basic damage) B mode: 3 consecutive rounds, high firing speed (low damage) Thank you for providing the Cinematic Music. shimtone - Viper
row.short_description: Metal Strike is a multiplayer TPS game in the Apocalypse world view. Defeat mechanized monsters with your colleagues and recapture Earth.
row.notes: This is a TPS game, with a motion that removes monsters, kills players, and also gives the screen a bloodstain effect if the player's physical strength drops below a certain level, which requires attention. There are also violent depictions of removing enemies by firing long-range weapons, so you should be aware of this.

row.name: Waifusitter 🔞 - Furry Collection
row.detailed_description: About the Game Waifusitter is a clicker game where you click a Waifu ! Get a random waifu every 3 hours and grow your collection! 3-hour drop pool chances *: Trash - 66% Common - 20% Uncommon - 10% Rare - 3% Legendary - 1% Subject to change. Recycling does not drops legendary cards. Features : Waifus, obviously. Items to grow your collection
row.short_description: Waifusitter is a NSFW clicker where you collect and grow a waifu collection! Earn a random waifu every 3 hours, recycle unwanted ones, and aim for the rarest waifus. Trade waifus on Steam Community Marketplace.
row.notes: The game contains nudity and sexual interactions. All the characters are of legal age.

row.name: Sounds of Her Love 2
row.detailed_description: A sequel to Sounds of Her Love, a sweet romance story between two students set in an international school in Tokyo. One year has passed since the events of Sounds of Her Love, and your relationship with Ceri has deepened. You have now become a couple and, with your encouragement, Ceri has begun to emerge from her shell. Leopards don't change their spots that easily, however, and though Ceri has been attempting to overcome her innate shyness, she still has a tendency to doubt herself. Wanting to boost Ceri's confidence, you encourage her to perform in the school's graduation ceremony with the members of the music club. This will be one of the greatest challenges the timid Ceri has had to face, but you are sure that she will be able to overcome it. You will be there with her, after all, to reassure her... and you want everybody to know just how far Ceri has come. A cute and sweet kinetic novel (no choices or branches) focusing on a single love interest - your shy girlfriend Ceri! An easily digestible and compelling story (around 40k words / 2-3 hours playtime). Precious character artwork and detailed backgrounds. High quality, English voice acting for all major characters. Original soundtrack.  Bonus features including guest artwork by a variety of talented artists and a quiz mini-game.
row.short_description: A cute romance visual novel set at an international school in Japan. As you approach the final hours of your school years together, help your sweet but shy girlfriend Ceri overcome her fears to be able to play the harp at the school's graduation ceremony. A tender, wholesome love story awaits.

row.name: Modularity
row.detailed_description: Stitch. Expand. Optimize. You are the architect of an ever-growing amalgamation of flesh and metal. This unique blend of resource management and puzzle-building challenges you to construct increasingly complex structures by seamlessly combining steampunk machinery with organic matter . Carefully balance your resources— blood and steam —as you strategically place parts, ensuring a continuous flow to sustain and expand your grotesque creation. Will you craft a harmonious fusion, or will your construct collapse under the weight of your ambition?
row.short_description: Modularity is a resource management builder game where the player stitches together flesh and metal in creative ways to construct bigger and greater amalgamations.

row.name: Lemonade Apocalypse: The Great Filter Playtest
I Will Never Fall For My Tsundere Classmate, So I Will Just Date A Background Character Instead!
row.detailed_description: I Will Never Fall For My Tsundere Classmate, So I Will Just Date A Background Character Instead! is a free short parody visual novel. Story You are a college student who is close to his female tsundere classmate. She is clearly the main heroine of this story, but will she actually end up being your romantic interest? Characters Rikina is your tsundere friend and classmate. She can be a little grumpy at times, but is a good girl at heart. VA: Savvi Lee Rikina's friend is a quiet, unassuming girl also attending the same collega as you and Rikina. She is kind and loves monster movies. Gameplay I Will Never Fall For My Tsundere Classmate, So I Will Just Date A Background Character Instead!  is a linear visual novel in which you read a short 30-minute romance story. You will be able to make a few choices that have no impact on the story. The game is accompanied by two soundtracks and contains full voice acting for Rikina.
row.short_description: A short parody visual novel about romance with a tsundere girl... Or not?

row.name: Totem Clash
row.detailed_description: Collect blocks to summon units and defeat ghosts! Totem Clash is a roguelike tower fence game where you summon units through blocks to defeat ghosts. Combine and strengthen various units to reclaim areas occupied by ghosts. Use each unit's unique characteristics to strategically defeat ghosts. Features Block Combination - Totem Clash uses blocks to summon units. Collect blocks of the same unit to summon units and clear the stage. Special effects are activated when a certain number of blocks are used for each unit. Race Effects - When a certain number of the same race is collected, an effect is activated. Find and collect various units to find your own combination! Reinforcement and Various Items - You can become infinitely stronger by acquiring items and strengthening units. You can strengthen our achievements and totems to help in battle or to help with purchasing items and growth. Roguelike - Stages and units change randomly each time you play. So you can play multiple times and experience different units and combinations.
row.short_description: Collect blocks to summon units and defeat ghosts! Totem Clash is a roguelike tower fence game where you summon units through blocks to defeat ghosts. Combine and strengthen various units to reclaim areas occupied by ghosts. Use each unit's unique characteristics to strategically defeat ghosts.

Bibbidiba fan game
row.detailed_description: Bibbidiba fan game is a vibrant and fast-paced platformer that brings Hoshimachi Suisei’s hit song 'Bibbidiba' to life in an entirely new way. Players step into the shoes of Hoshimachi Suisei, navigating through magical worlds. Nothing stands on your way! As players traverse beautifully crafted levels, they must a combination of jump, punch, and of course, throwing shoes to avoid traps and defeat mischievous creatures in order to reach to the end goal. Tick-tock! Tick-tock! The clock is always ticking, adding an exciting time pressure element to the game. Players must complete each level before the clock runs out. And More? Players can take on optional boss or platform challenge to unlock additional bonuses.  This game is published under CCMC Corp(※1)'s Indie game brand 'holo Indie'.(※2) This game is allowed to be monetized under the examination and terms of 'holo Indie'. row.short_description: Bibbidiba fan game is a vibrant and fast-paced platformer inspired by Hoshimachi Suisei’s hit song 'Bibbidiba'. Players must guide Hoshimachi Suisei through magical and challenging levels to reach the final destination and find out what awaits her at the end.

row.name: Separated by Nightmares: Where Duty Dies
row.detailed_description: Separated by Nightmares: Where Duty Dies offers a horror experience that blends first-person puzzle-solving with a deeply woven narrative. Written by the fantasy author behind The Swords of Unforgotten Memories and Worlds Beneath the Shadows , this first chapter introduces you to a workaholic lieutenant who is obsessed with closing every case, driven by a relentless need for answers. His single-minded pursuit cost him his family, yet unknown to most, an even deeper grief haunts him. When an unexpected blackout engulfs the police station, what begins as a simple power check quickly twists into a haunting quest. Ominous notes from the past start to surface, forcing the lieutenant to confront memories he had desperately tried to bury. As you guide him through the station’s darkened corridors, you’ll uncover the true source of his torment. Key Features Story-Driven Horror Immerse yourself in an unsettling narrative revealed through exploration and cryptic notes. First-Person Perspective View the station through the protagonist’s eyes. Mystery and Discovery Investigate hidden clues and unravel the station’s secrets at your own pace. Emotional Depth Engage with themes of loss, grief, and guilt, woven naturally into the storyline. Atmospheric Setting Venture through a dimly lit police station where disturbing encounters and ominous signs lurk throughout the station. Warning: This game has scenes of flashing lights, so it may not be suited for some viewers.
row.short_description: Separated by Nightmares: Where Duty Dies merges first-person puzzles with a poignant narrative. A driven lieutenant, haunted by hidden grief, confronts a sudden blackout. Clues force him to face buried truths, while a lurking darkness waits in the shadows.
row.notes: This game contains disturbing imagery, references to drugs and alcohol, strong language, themes of grief and loss, violence.

row.name: Boat Racer
row.detailed_description: Feature List All 3 mini-games have Steam Leaderboard capability About the Game                                                     Collection of 3 Mini Games Featured: ' Boat Racer ' -  A 3 lap timed race fraught with exploding hazards that you can avoid or shoot with your onboard cannons for time boosts to your turbo charged engine. Takes about 1:20 to complete but VERY high index for replay-ability as you hop back at the start line ready for the next race to try to beat your best scores. Obstacles spawn randomly each game so every race a bit different. Steam Leaderboard ranking available on this game to compare your results with other players ' Knazi Knockout ' -  Be the hot Girl that pummels Hitler and three of his henchman . You can even go to the locker room and change your attire. It's fun, but once you figure out how to beat these guys you will win every time so the fun becomes changing your outfit ' Nazis in the Mist ' - Although the title of this package of mini-games is 'BOAT RACER', I think this mini-game is the crown jewel of the trilogy. An arena style game with randomly spawning enemies where you try to survive 10 rounds. The story behind the 'spawn pods' comes from the larger project still in the works that all 3 of these mini-games were borne from. The Nazis have developed secret weapons that could change the tide of the war and your mission is to capture the blueprints. One such secret weapon is the 'STD'  ( S ubterranean T roop  D eployment ) which is a torpedo like missile that burrows through the ground and pops up on the battlefield. Another secret weapon are Autonomous Super Soldiers ( Robots) - which you hack to be on your side in the fight against evil. That 'helper' Robot is also available in this mini game but you can toggle him on/off if you wish to go it alone. Good luck with that! You don't get points for the helper's kills, but he will be a great help in getting you further into the game. Only 10 rounds sounds like a cakewalk but it's actually quite difficult to complete the mission. In many  MANY hours of play testing, I have only succeeded in surviving all 10 rounds ONCE. Steam Leaderboard ranking also available for this mini-game as you can upload your scores even on failed missions. If you see a leaderboard score that seems VERY high - it's because they accomplished the mission - all 10 rounds - and got a 10,000 point bonus
row.short_description: Three mini games. 'Boat Racer' - high replay ability in that obstacles are spawned randomly each race. No 2 races the same.'Knazi Knockout' 3rd person brawler - it's just fun to beat up Nazis, right? 'Nazi's in the Mist' FPS that is the crown jewel of this trifecta of minigames
row.notes: In two of the minigames ( not "BOAT RACER") you fight Nazi's. In "Knazi Knockout" you beat them up MMA style, in "Nazi's in the Mist" you shoot them in an arena style FPS. The "death" and " gore" is minimal and more toward the cartoonish style than realistic. Images of women in Bikinis also on screen and in "Knazi Knockout" you can select wardrobe for your female fighter that can include bikini's or sexy outfits

row.detailed_description: My Dad Is A Hero 'My Dad Is A Hero' is a single-player action RPG story adventure where two heroes, bound by fate, face their struggles and uncover the truth of their world. A Tale of Two Heroes Listen to the story of two extraordinary heroes. Mehiron lost both his father and mother at a young age, growing up with a dream of following in his father’s footsteps as a hero. Meanwhile, Titan , a 7-year veteran hero and co-leader of the Intelligence Division, begins gathering information about the strange monsters that have started to appear. What could be happening in their world? Game Overview Mehiron: A young man who lost his parents at an early age and grew up holding onto his dream of becoming a hero like his father. Titan: A 7-year veteran hero and co-leader of the Intelligence Division, now investigating the sudden appearance of mysterious monsters. As their paths intertwine, the two protagonists uncover secrets that threaten the world. What destiny awaits them? Key Features Dual Protagonists: Experience the intertwined stories of Mehiron and Titan by alternating between their perspectives. Three Epic Acts: Unravel hidden truths in each act as the threat to the world intensifies. Challenging Boss Fights: Engage in thrilling battles against powerful bosses with unique patterns and strategies. Blend of Action and Adventure: Enjoy fast-paced combat combined with an immersive narrative for a unique experience.
row.short_description: 'My Dad is a Hero' is an action RPG adventure where players alternate between two protagonists. The game is structured into three acts, with its core focus on diverse and conceptually unique boss battles.

row.name: Prank

row.short_description: A girl wakes up in the grass, only to find she has lost her memory and grown wings. Playtime: ~30 minutes + endless mode

row.name: Gaunts Gambit | Multiplayer FPS
row.detailed_description: DESCRIPTION: Gaunts Gambit is a multiplayer first person shooter game. Set in an abandoned school left empty because of a rampant virus, former students sneak back in fighting over control of the grounds and buildings. GAMEMODES: 2v2 TeamMatch Zombies FFA 2V2 TEAMMATCH: Players are divided into two teams of two, where they battle for their team in a singular building. The team with the most kills wins the match! ZOMBIES: Players face waves of zombies, barricading entrances to slow them down. Survive as long as possible against the increasing difficulty! FFA: Players compete solo in a battle for the highest kill count before the timer runs out.
row.short_description: Gaunts Gambit is a multiplayer first person shooter game. Set in an abandoned school left empty because of a rampant virus, former students sneak back in fighting over control of the grounds and buildings.

row.name: The Lost Desert aka Cube Game 9x
row.detailed_description: The Lost Desert is a open-world shooter. Main thing about is a game that works on very old PC hardware and windows version but it works on modern hardware and windows version too so it's very cross play compatible. Better to play with friends as it is multiplayer game. We are a team of two but we are committed to the development. Maps: Spawn map: It's the most finished at this point. Has 4 main buildings and a watch tower. There are lot of trees and there is a river. There is a grass in form of sprites. All of the graphics are based on settings. Small desert map: It's more like a small wasteland with rusted barrels ruins old rusted fences and big rocks. This map is not very complex and it's used for a battle royal game mode. Big forest map: This map is not very finished, it has 4 watch towers lot of concrete buildings. This map as the spawn map has lot of trees the same grass and lot of lakes. It's the biggest one in the game and will have way more buildings and features in the future. Big desert map: This map isn't finished at all has just a few monuments and a big hill but other then that it's just a big desert. Sub maps. 3D platforming map: This is a big map with platforms and its finished. A old mine map: This map is a old mine with crystals and support beams. Lobby map: It's a lobby. Current Features: 4 main maps and 3 sub maps so there is a lot to explore. Raccoons. 2 weapons: pistol and machine gun. Ammo system. Ammo boxes that fill the players ammo supply, they re-spawn on the maps randomly. Day and Night cycle. CRTs with animations. Old buildings. Simple and complex terrain. row.short_description: The Lost Desert is a online multiplayer shooter game is made in the Blitz3D game engine. It works on basically any PC hardware with windows on it. It is mainly for windows 95-98 but works on XP and above to 11.

row.name: Astral Blaze
row.detailed_description: ASTRAL BLAZE     Explore the ruins of an old city where no human has entered for hundreds of years due to claims of dangers the place now holds. Guided by eternal flames and following the torn pages of an old mysterious diary, revealing facts about the journey someone endured before you; painting to mind a once more advanced civilization which left this place migrating to altered states of existence leaving the less fortunate behind.     Or is this just an illusion? As your memory fails to connect to the past.. nor has you envision a future.. all you and your group of adventurers are left to care about is the tangible treasure mentioned in the diary, perhaps it may get across the otherwise mistaken stories. FEATURES: A half survivor and half roguelike type game with partly randomized dungeons. 12 dungeons that can be completed in nonlinear fashion 7 imposing bosses 7 playable characters each with 1 passive character only ability and initial stat setting Character customization and empowerment by choosing random cards found in chests giving element of choice All hand drawn pixel graphics Gameplay defining unique dash attack mechanic. Optional brief storyline
row.short_description: Embark on a quest for a rumored treasure while exploring ruins of an old civilization. A half survivor and half roguelike type game with partly randomized dungeons and character development by choice of cards found in the dungeons. Featuring unique dash attack and simple controls.

row.name: Digitum
row.detailed_description: Step into a magical adventure like no other! Have you ever wondered what it would be like to be a rock, an olive, or a small, perfectly rollable sphere? Ever dreamed of racing downhill at breakneck speed, just to go faster than your friends and claim victory? Look no further— welcome to Digitum! Here, you take on the role of an old, used magician, pushing objects through finger-sized portals simply because… well, you’re bored and you can. As the player, you control one of these curious little objects, guiding it from portal to portal in a never-ending game of whimsical physics and chaotic fun, trying to improve the time you take to finish a level ! The goal of the game is to complete each level as quickly as possible while avoiding obstacles that add time to your timer. To move forward, you give an impulse to the object you control. A loading bar displayed beneath the object indicates the strength of the impulse. If the bar turns red, an additional boost is triggered, making you go even faster. The game features a multiplayer mode with a real-time leaderboard showing the scores of your friends and the top players. Many successes can be unlocked by completing challenges — some of which are hidden — and allow you to obtain new skins for your object.
row.short_description: A bored old wizard pokes his finger into a tiny portal — and you fall out! In this fast-paced arcade adventure, race through twisted levels, master the physics, and perfect your runs to beat the clock… and your friends on the leaderboard.

row.name: CRAZLIPSE
row.detailed_description: CRAZLIPSE is a game set in a seemingly ordinary city. Everything changes when Stefan Vincenzo, one of the police officers investigating zombie cases, is called for the gigantic 'Starry Sky Tree', an iconic landmark of the city. There, he talks to Matheus, a scientist and his boss, about the zombie apocalypse known as CRAZLIPSE. After the dialogue, Stefan is teleported to a place infested with undead, where your mission is to survive and eliminate them! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Credits : Programmer : Yan Massoni Game Studio Art : Yan Massoni Game Studio Music : Yan Massoni Game Studio / MagmaPocket! Level Design : Yan Massoni Game Studio / MagmaPocket! row.short_description: CRAZLIPSE is a game where officer Stefan Vincenzo uncovers a zombie apocalypse at the 'Starry Sky Tree.' After meeting scientist Matheus, he’s teleported to a zombie-infested zone to survive and fight.

row.name: Monmusu Girls: Autobattler
row.detailed_description: FOLLOW US Twitter: @Monmusu_Girls About the Game In a fantasy world of magic, the power of the Demon King is awakening, and the fates of the monmusu girls are beginning to intertwine. As the leader of an adventuring party, you’ll recruit a diverse group of monmusu girls, each with their own special abilities, to create a powerful team. Venture into uncharted lands, unlock hidden stories, and uncover the dark secrets behind the rise of the Demon King.   Key Features Strategic Team Composition, Easy to Play: With auto-battler mechanics, your success depends on how effectively you set up and combine your team. row.short_description: This is a strategic and adventurous idle auto-battler where you'll collect a variety of monmusu girls, form your adventuring team, and challenge the Demon King! row.name: Jianghu Diary
row.detailed_description: The game combines the romantic feelings of the martial arts world with the relaxed fun of playing games. In the game, players will play as a novice martial arts hero, gradually growing from a small newcomer to a legendary figure of the martial arts alliance leader. The game is set against the backdrop of ancient rivers and lakes, with beautiful and delicate graphics that recreate the ever-changing scenes of the rivers and lakes. Players can experience rich gameplay in the game, such as freely exploring the rivers and lakes, making friends with various heroes and heroes, and challenging various martial arts masters. At the same time, the game also incorporates placement gameplay, allowing players to easily enjoy the fun of the game while feeling the fierce competition and charm of unparalleled martial arts in the martial arts world. In the game, players can recruit various heroes, cultivate their martial arts skills, form their own martial arts sects, and collect resources and create divine weapons through gameplay placement, ultimately becoming the leader of the martial arts alliance to unify the Jianghu. At the same time, the game also features rich plot tasks and activities, allowing players to experience different martial arts storylines and feel the passion of the martial arts world. Whether you are a fan of martial arts culture or a player who enjoys playing idle games, it will bring you a brand new gaming experience, allowing you to fully enjoy the martial arts sentiment and idle fun in front of the screen.
row.short_description: The game recreates the ever-changing scenes of the ancient martial arts world. Players can experience rich gameplay in the game, such as freely exploring the rivers and lakes, making friends with various heroes and heroes, and challenging various martial arts masters.

row.name: Grocery Store Tycoon - First Store
row.detailed_description: Grocery Store Tycoon - First Store allows players to take their first steps as a store owner by managing and expanding their very first shop. Start with a small store, optimize its layout, stock shelves efficiently, and serve customers to grow your business. Careful planning and strategic decisions will be key to turning your humble beginning into a thriving supermarket! Operate the Cash Register yourself if you would like to challenge the speed of your best cashier, or simply do not want to pay the wage. Swipe as fast as you can to avoid long queue times and unhappy customers. Stock Shelves by carrying a case at a time from the warehouse or use a cart to transport larger quantities. Purchase Placeables such as Cash Registers, Shelving, Coolers, Freezers, Produce Shelves, Shopping Cart Corrals, Shopping Basket Stands, Material Handling Equipment, and Decorations. Interactive UI to manage your store through customer statistics, supply and demand of goods, pricing adjustments, placeable condition viewing, and employee management. Unlock Item Types, Placeables, Management Tools, Employee Hiring Capacity, Store Expansions, and the opportunity to purchase other stores by gaining experience passively, by working, or by completing bonus objectives. Maintain placeables, return carts and baskets, and keep the store clean to keep your store operating at its full potential. Manage Employees to keep them happy or they may quit! Assigning an employee to the job they would like, the wage they want, and not overworking them all contribute to the employee's happiness. Unreliable employees may call in and affect your happiness. Customers must be satisfied to get good reviews and keep your store in good standing. Having the goods they seek, keeping them in the store for as little time as possible, and having a charismatic employee behind the cash register all contribute to the satisfaction of customers.
row.short_description: Grocery Store Tycoon - First Store allows players to take their first steps as a store owner by managing and expanding their very first shop. Start with a small store, optimize its layout, stock shelves efficiently, and serve customers to grow your business.

row.name: Alice in Disguise
row.detailed_description: In Wonderland, the evil Red Queen has captured Alice’s friends and she is the only one who can save them! Will Alice be able to sneak into the Royal Castle and free them all? Gameplay Alice in Disguise is a stealth game with chess-based puzzles where you must complete a series of levels without getting caught by enemies. Levels are set on chessboards where Alice must disguise herself and act like the castle guards to go unnoticed. Enemies are chess pieces with different movement patterns: so, when disguised as one of them, Alice will move with the corresponding scheme. Abilities like resizing, invisibility, and teleporting will help you complete the puzzles. Features Chess-based puzzles of increasing complexity. Stealth sections based on disguises. Special abilities and effects to discover. Cute and appealing graphic style . Try to rescue all of Alice's friends and defeat the evil Queen to save Wonderland!
row.short_description: Help Alice rescue her friends to save Wonderland! Alice in Disguise is a stealth puzzle game where you disguise yourself as chess pieces and move like them to solve sneaky challenges. Use potions, magic mirrors, and quick thinking to stay hidden — all wrapped in a charming and colorful art style.

row.name: ZHONG XING NEW VILLAGE
row.detailed_description: ZHONGXING NEW VILLAGE This is a multiplayer online game focused on regional revitalization. (1) Basic Gameplay Use WASD to move forward, backward, left, and right. Q and E for close-range and long-range attacks. 1, 2, 3, 4, Z, X, C are seven skills available for use. All locations on the map have buttons to enter. In addition to viewing photos, players can solve puzzles to gain experience points and skill points. Solving puzzles allows players to level up and helps strengthen the entire town. (2) Game Features Housing System Players can choose the location of their house within Zhongxing New Village at the start of the game. Houses can restore health and block enemy attacks. Upgrading house types and skill levels allows for changes in appearance. Action Points Killing enemies does not grant experience points but rewards action points. Action points have a limit, which increases with skill upgrades. Browse Photos, Solve Puzzles, and Level Up Clicking on area photos consumes action points. Solving puzzles and pressing buttons at the right time grants significant experience and levels. Explore Revitalization Areas to Gain Skills Clicking on revitalization area photos may trigger questions. Answering correctly grants upgrades to various skills, including both passive and active abilities. Seven Major Skills During multiplayer gameplay, the seven major skills can support teammates, making them stronger. Skills include: Healing, Agility, Resilience, Weakness, Magic Attack, Lightning, and Vulnerability. Multiplayer is recommended to maximize the synergy of skill support among teammates. Skill Points and Professions Each level-up grants additional skill points. Every 50 levels, players can allocate profession points. Different profession point bonuses can bring significant changes to gameplay.
row.short_description: ZHONGXING NEW VILLAGE is a multiplayer online game centered on regional revitalization, featuring the history and guided tours of attractions and regional revitalization stories, encouraging more people to participate in revitalization activities in Zhongxing New Village.

row.name: Poker Clicker
row.detailed_description: A perfect blend of tapping fun and poker hands! Get ready for a thrilling mix of clicker gameplay and poker hands! In Poker Clicker, you earn chips based on the strength of randomly generated poker hands - from a simple high card to the elusive royal flush. Each tap of the Joker card reveals a new hand, bringing you closer to the ultimate jackpot! Use your earned chips to purchase gems or poker hand updates that unlock special bonuses and accelerate your progress towards higher scores. Key Features: Simple yet addictive gameplay - perfect for poker enthusiasts and casual players alike. Dynamic scoring system based on poker hand rankings. Gem Shop - boost your performance and maximise your winnings! Stylish graphics and intuitive interface for a seamless experience. Don't forget, every click gets you one step closer to unlock one of 30 unique Joker Card designs. And don't worry if you're not getting any goals or feeling like you're missing a strategy. It's all about the endless clicking, and it's the perfect way to relax and unwind.
row.short_description: Earn chips by revealing randomly generated poker hands and unlock gems for powerful bonuses. And don't worry if you're not getting any goals or feeling like you're missing a strategy. It's all about the endless clicking, and it's the perfect way to relax and unwind.

row.name: Fireplace Simulator

Set the mood by adding logs to the fire, chopping new ones when supplies run low, and exploring the room for hidden interactions. Whether you’re unwinding after a long day or looking for a calm backdrop, Fireplace Simulator invites you to relax and enjoy the soft crackle of burning wood.  Earn Steam Achievements!   Key Features Start or Quench the Fire: Ignite a roaring blaze or let it gently die out at your own pace. Feed Logs to the Fire: Keep the flames going with a steady supply of wood. Cut New Logs: Run out of logs? No problem—chop more to keep the cozy ambiance alive. Change the Weather: Adjust the elements outside to suit your mood. Explore Your Surroundings: Interact with items around the room to discover hidden details and further enhance the atmosphere. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the peaceful crackle and glow of your own virtual fireplace!

row.name: Ghostie's Escape

Turn the executioner's chamber against itself as you dodge, weave, and manipulate the environment in your desperate bid for freedom.
