row.name: Haunted Hues
row.detailed_description: Wow, another great day to be rich! Travel to the world of Amille You did it! After months of searching, You've worked hard and finally found a wonderful place to begin exhibiting art from all over the world. The gallery space is filled with old pieces (and some secrets...), but could use some big collections to really drum up excitement. Bargain with collectors The journey to curating the greatest collection of art will bring you face-to-face with some of Amille's most curious individuals, each with their own unique personality and tastes. How far are you willing to go to get what you want? Survive the night Not everything is as it seems in the gallery. Discover what horrors lie in the dark at night, and do what you must to survive... Gameplay Features -Every choice matters. Speak with collectors, locals, and staff to build your reputation -Reputation only goes so far... Gain money to bid on and buy art from collectors -A menagerie of horrors come alive at night. Use your knowledge from the day and do what you must to survive -Become immersed in the game's unique art style
row.short_description: Travel to the world of Amille as Larue, an eager art curator looking to make a name for themselves. Build your reputation by talking with collectors and locals, and explore the ever-expanding gallery as you buy more artwork. But beware, as every choice matters when day turns to night...

row.name: Ruyn HD
row.detailed_description: What is it? Ruyn HD is a remake of my minimalist boomer shooter Ruyn , rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5 . It keeps the fast, combo-driven gameplay of the original, but now features more modern visuals, smoother controls, updated audio, and tighter gameplay. The levels are short, intense, and built for momentum—just you, some weapons, and a ton of enemies to blast through. The focus is on pure, simple shooter mechanics: fast movement and nonstop action. T he original Ruyn Classic is included , and the level editors work across both versions , so you can build once and play in either style. Ruyn HD is 100% free — no ads, no microtransactions, no DRM. The original Ruyn Classic , the 2D/3D level editors , and the launcher are all open source and public domain. The HD version's Unreal Engine code is not open source due to engine licensing restrictions, but everything else is yours to modify, share, or build on. How do I play it? The basic goal is simple: eliminate all enemies and reach the exit. If you're chasing a high score, it’s all about speed, variety, and combo flow . Each time you kill an enemy, a combo bar appears at the top of the screen—it drains quickly. Kill another enemy or collect a gem before it runs out to keep your multiplier alive. The longer you maintain it, the higher your score climbs. But there’s more: the game rewards creative kills . Use different weapons or methods to earn style bonuses . Repeating the same kill type will reduce the bonus—so keep it fresh if you want to score big. There’s also a bonus for finishing the level quickly, so don’t hang around too long. Note:  Ammo is shared over multiple weapons. When you collect some shells, you have access to the shotgun and double barrel shotgun straight away. This works the same for the plasma which is shared across the plasma rifle and trident. Tip:  Use the single-barrel shotgun when you need something that fires fast and the double-barrel shotgun when you need more grunt. This can help when you're trying to keep up a combo. How do I make and share my own levels? You can find detailed tutorials on how to build your levels here on github gists(See Online Manual URL on this page) and in the community hub.  If you have any questions just fire me a message in the community hub. All in-game music by GTDStudio (aka Palrom), licensed under OGA-BY 3.0.
row.short_description: Ruyn HD is a remake of my minimalist boomer shooter Ruyn, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. It keeps the fast, combo-driven gameplay of the original, but now features modern visuals, smoother controls, updated audio, and tighter gunplay. Ruyn Classic and the 2D and 3D level editors are included.

row.name: Clockwork Sword
row.detailed_description: Slash, stab, and shoot your way through a multi-tiered museum filled with corrupted automata, customizing your weapon with the scraps of the fallen. Clockwork Sword is a thrilling isometric hack and slash, in which you utilize combinations of weapons and elements to conquer your foes. In Clockwork Sword, every part of your weapon can be customized to fit your playstyle. Forms dictate the move set of the weapon and the range at which you fight. Charges apply devastating elemental effects and change the dynamic of combat. Gears add enhancements that allow you to specialize your weapon further. From flaming spears to life-stealing Gatling guns, the choice is up to you. The weapon of Clockwork Sword has two sides that each have their own form, element and set of gears. In the heat of combat you can switch between these modes to adapt to whatever you may encounter. Is it worth having a balance of melee and range or should you double down on on your strengths and brute force any obstacle in your way? Fighting enemies in Clockwork Sword will build up the pressure gauge on your weapon. When your pressure is full, switching between modes will unleash a massive special attack unique to each form. Time your weapon switches right for massive payoffs.
row.short_description: Slash, stab, and shoot your way through a multi-tiered museum filled with corrupted automata, customizing your weapon with the scraps of the fallen. Clockwork Sword is a thrilling isometric hack and slash, in which you utilize combinations of weapons and elements to conquer your foes.

row.name: The Sixth Sorrow
row.detailed_description: “And a sword will pierce your own soul also.” Things haven't felt right since the accident. Your mother's passive aggression, your father's refusal to speak, and strange things around the house... Are they unable to move on, or is something even more sinister lurking beneath the surface? Dark Secrets Be a part of a character-driven narrative as you unravel a mystery engulfed in grief, sorrow, and maternal love.  Unsettling Atmosphere Be immersed as you explore creepy environments that each feature their own eerie sound design and captivating retro aesthetics. Choices Matter with Multiple Endings Engage in interactive dialogue that shapes your relationships and how the story unfolds. With multiple endings and hidden secrets, more than one playthrough is encouraged. Interactive Mechanics Gameplay extends beyond simple key collection, featuring minigames and puzzles that engage players and advance the narrative.
row.short_description: The Sixth Sorrow is a short, narrative-driven horror game where your choices impact the story. To what lengths can a mother's love drive her?
row.notes: Tobacco and alcohol use, demonic imagery, sacrifices, blood and gore, strong language, and general mature content.

row.name: Late Night Mystery
row.detailed_description: Late Night Mystery  is a first-person horror video game that immerses you in an intense and mysterious experience. Jason enters his home returning from a quiet night out dining, but when he arrives, something unexpected happens: there have been changes that will make your hair stand on end! And the protagonist! Will he manage to survive and uncover the truth? Explore dark hallways, collect key items, solve clues, and navigate oppressive environments filled with tension. You'll need to keep your composure to uncover the truth hidden in the corners of home... and survive whatever lurks in the shadows. Key Features: A horror story with elements of mystery and suspense. First-person gameplay focused on exploration and interaction. Terrifying environments and an oppressive atmosphere. Medium-length gameplay, ideal for a complete experience without being overly long.
row.short_description: A terrifying story that immerses you in a dark world full of horrific surprises that will leave the player frozen in fear.

row.name: Sprout Crafter
row.detailed_description: You can manage crops on your farm, sell them, and talk to people. And you can meet various creatures through fishing. And you can explore all the places in the world
row.short_description: A farm simulation game where you cultivate nature, run a farm, and enjoy colorful interactions. Develop your farm by planting crops, harvesting, caring for animals, crafting, and exploring.

row.name: 时忆 Memory of Time
row.detailed_description: If... everything could be chosen again. Will our final outcome be... different? In 2041, as a detective, you receive an invitation from a renowned scientist named 'Jody'. When you arrive at Jody's residence according to the contents of the letter, you only have time to attend the doctor's funeral. As a result, you are caught up in a series of unsettling mysteries. An unknown invitation from the deceased? The mysterious girl who suddenly appeared? A strange machine buzzing? The terrifying truth intertwined in a spiral? Worry, suffer, struggle. Give everything for the so-called 'perfect ending' that you don't even know if exists. Only in this way can we end this tragic 'fate'. Only in this way can we welcome the 'future' that you have hoped for. The game is expected to last 5-7 hours and contains a large number of reasoning elements. The names of people, places, and organizations that appear in the game are all fictional settings and should not be elevated to reality. Hope you have fun.
row.short_description: This is a science fiction detective themed visual novel game, where players need to play the role of a 'detective', connecting seemingly unrelated events and discovering mysterious truths hidden behind them, Please survive, and walk with your head held high towards the 'perfect ending' you expect.
row.notes: This game contains elements of mystery and suspense, and the following will be mentioned in the plot: Death, murder cases, suicide, banned drugs, gangs, myths. Please play after learning the above content.

row.name: 创造世界
row.detailed_description: 《创造世界》是一款备受玩家喜爱的多人在线沙盒游戏，它融合了自由创造、社交互动、冒险探索等多种元素，为玩家打造了一个充满无限可能的虚拟世界。 游戏背景与特色 自由创造：游戏提供了一个开放的游戏世界，玩家可以自由发挥想象力，利用丰富的材料和工具建造属于自己的独特世界。无论是精致的城堡、高耸的塔楼，还是深邃的洞穴，都能由玩家亲手打造。 社交互动：游戏支持多人在线模式，玩家可以与朋友或其他玩家一起建设和探索。通过合作与竞争，玩家可以结识新朋友，共同创造更加精彩的游戏世界。 冒险探索：游戏世界充满了未知和惊喜，玩家可以探索各种地形和生物群落，发现隐藏的宝藏和秘密。同时，游戏中还有丰富的怪物和敌人等待玩家去挑战，打败它们可以获得丰厚的奖励。 核心玩法 建造与装饰：玩家可以使用各种材料和工具，建造自己的梦想之城。游戏提供了多样化的建筑材料和装饰物品，让玩家能够创造出独一无二的建筑风格。 种植与养殖：游戏中还有丰富的种植和养殖系统。玩家可以种植各种作物和树木，收获丰富的资源；同时，还可以养殖各种宠物和动物，与它们建立深厚的感情。 挖矿与探索：游戏世界中有丰富的矿产资源等待玩家去挖掘。通过挖矿，玩家可以获得珍贵的矿石和宝石，用于打造更强大的装备和工具。 打怪与升级：游戏中充满了各种怪物和敌人。玩家可以不断提升自己的战斗能力，打败它们以获得经验和奖励。同时，游戏还提供了丰富的技能和装备系统，让玩家能够打造出更加强大的角色。
row.short_description: 创造世界手游 发挥你的无限创意，开启不一样的的多人在线沙盒冒险！ 与你的小伙伴们一起，用无限想象构建梦想家园，自由建造，快乐无限！ 在宁静的湖畔，享受垂钓的乐趣； 投身于种植养殖，体验田园生活的宁静与满足。 与好友驰骋在广阔的世界中，发现美景！ 深入地下，挖掘矿石，锻造装备，挑战未知。 创造世界，打造梦想，美好相遇，尽在创造世界手游！
developers: 上海世游网络科技有限公司
publishers: 上海世游网络科技有限公司

row.name: Concentration Required
row.detailed_description: Fast-paced bullet hell where you try and dodge all projectiles while collecting as many coins as possible with in the time limit.
row.short_description: Concentration Required is a tough bullet hell made to challenge your focus and reaction time. The game has 6 unique retro-themed music tracks with 5 levels plus a tutorial and endless mode.

row.name: Ghost Shock
row.detailed_description: 'Ghost Shock' is an asymmetric single-player action game. At the beginning of the battle, the player controls a hero with extraordinary power. After being defeated, he will randomly turn into a monster, and the monster that gets the last blow will turn into a hero and continue to fight. In the end, the player will challenge the boss controlled by three ghosts, or control the boss with two ghosts to meet the challenge of the hero. [Death is not the end] The death of the hero does not mean the end of the game. The ghost who defeats the hero will be reborn and transformed into a new hero. The defeated hero will become a soul servant controlled by the demon until he defeats the hero and resurrects again. [Equipment Matching] The hero can collect teeth as trophies to buy more powerful equipment and skills. Match a variety of weapons, equipment and skills to build different combat styles. You can choose to use long-range skills for continuous consumption, or use sharp melee attacks to defeat the enemy. The strategy and style of the battle depends entirely on your choice. [Monster Evolution] Loyal servants can receive the gift of the demon. Monsters can consume psychic energy and choose to evolve into one of two new forms, using more powerful dark forces to easily defeat the hero. 【Boss Battle】 As a victory condition for the game, the hero will challenge the boss controlled by three ghosts. If the hero can successfully defeat the boss in three challenge opportunities, he will win the game. On the contrary, if the hero unfortunately loses in the third challenge, the three ghosts will win together.
row.short_description: Switch roles between heroes and monsters to fight, become the embodiment of justice or let evil rule, everything is possible.

row.name: Welcome Home
row.detailed_description: Welcome Home is a psychological horror game that immerses you in the unsettling life of a secluded village preparing for its annual festival. Experience a chilling tale of tradition , trust , and terror , narrated through your journey of uncovering dark secrets and making choices that determine your fate. PSX Style 12 NPCs Stealth & Survival Multiple Endings The game is around 30 - 60 minutes long depending on your skills and playstyle. Warning: This game contains themes of religious rituals, unsettling imagery, blood, violence, and psychological distress.
row.short_description: Where home feels wrong, and you're anything but welcome
row.notes: Violence, Murder, Blood on screen

row.name: Asteroidia
row.detailed_description: Asteroidia is a simple retro-style arcade shooter. Blast your way through waves of asteroids and enemies! Upgrade your weapons, face stronger and numerous enemies, aim for the top! It’s straightforward, fast-paced, and all about chasing high scores.
row.short_description: A simple and fun space shooter.

row.name: Hardest
row.detailed_description: Rock-Paper-Scissors Card Game Roguelike – stop time, summon tsunamis, shoot with bubble guns, feed cards to mimic, collect rare negative cards! -Get 3 points to win a game. -Drag cards forward to play them. -Hold a card in hand to read its effects. I made this game with Godot4. If you want to get inspired, I made the code repository public, so you can just look or reuse the code in your own projects. My github name is 'horridparlor', and 'hardest' is name of the project. In the README there is link to the Google Drive folder with the game assets. I have linked as the website of this game the card gallery I created for the game on my website, basically to be used as a data base for the cards. Also, has high-quality images of the cards!
row.short_description: Rock-Paper-Scissors Card Game Roguelike – stop time, summon tsunamis, shoot with bubble guns, feed cards to mimic, collect rare negative cards!

row.name: PEXIT 8
row.detailed_description: Penguin × Exit 8 : A unique combination Escape from the endlessly looping hallway. If you find an anomaly, choose YES PEN . If there is no anomaly, choose NO PEN . All anomalies contain penguin elements. Answer correctly 8 times in a row to escape. A mixture of cuteness and fear. ※Pressing 'Continue' allows you to collect undiscovered anomalies. Penguin Hotel This game is a spin-off of the mascot horror series 'Penguin Hotel.' You don’t need to have played 'Penguin Hotel' to enjoy it. If you’re interested, give it a try! About video production and distribution Please include the name of this game in the distribution and video title. Please put a link to SETAM in the summary section. Other than the above, we do not specify anything else. Please use common sense. We want many people to know this game. So videos and distribution are welcome.
row.short_description: Penguin × Exit 8 : A unique combination Escape from the endlessly looping hallway. If you find an anomaly, choose YES PEN. If there is no anomaly, choose NO PEN. All anomalies contain penguin elements. Penguins are after you.

row.name: SNAREWAVES' SHOOTING CHALLENGE
row.detailed_description: This is a free short shooting minigame that lasts ~2.5 minutes and is set to a punk rock soundtrack. Move and shoot and compete with your friends. Aim for the high score! Movement: WASD Shoot: Space
row.short_description: A short, free high-score chasing 2D shooter set to a punk rock soundtrack.

row.name: Death in the Gulag
row.detailed_description: Enter the haunting world of a 1930s-1950s Russian Gulag in this 2D top-down narrative experience. Your time is limited—your survival is fleeting—but before your journey ends, you'll uncover the voices and stories of those who shared this harsh existence. A Story-Driven Experience Explore a stark, oppressive prison camp where every corner holds a story. Listen as prisoners and guards recount their harrowing experiences, all inspired by true accounts from the Gulags. A Unique Approach to Gameplay With no combat, puzzles, or objectives, the focus is solely on immersing yourself in the narratives of those around you. The game's core is its atmosphere and the hauntingly human stories it brings to life. 2D Top-Down Visuals Navigate beautifully crafted, minimalist environments that reflect the bleakness and isolation of the Gulag. Original Soundtrack Featuring a custom score that blends haunting melodies and atmospheric soundscapes, the music draws you deeper into the emotional weight of the stories. A Somber Reflection This is not a game of triumph or escape but an experience of reflection—an opportunity to bear witness to a part of history often overlooked.
row.short_description: Stories from the Russian Gulag
row.notes: Dialogue based on true stories from the Russian Gulag. Stories include depiction of violence, including sexual, which are meant to show players the harsh experiences what prisoners had to endure.

row.name: NOX AETERNA - Veil of Darkness
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the world of NOX AETERNA - Veil of Darkness 🦇 A thoughtful but humorous text adventure about a teenage boy, a little, but ancient vampire girl, and the machinations of an immortal parallel society. 👁️‍🗨️ Along the way, you'll experience a mix of thoughtful as well as philosophical and often  humorous dialogues. You forge new friendships and uncover secrets  that were meant to remain hidden from the human world forever. Your decisions determine the course of the story. 💬 Additionally: You ever wanted to play a text adventure inside a text adventure ? Then this is your chance now  to play the cool game your friend Jens has programmed 😵‍💫 A single play through will take 1..2 hours, but you can   you will want to play it through multiple times to explore more lore along different story paths. TL;DR: Short , but dense narration with replay value You can even play a game within a game Uses sound and music to enhance immersion Game automatically saves at any time
row.short_description: He’s been searching for his missing friend for days. She’s been searching for her long-lost clan member for decades. Now their paths cross.

row.name: Gyra
row.detailed_description: Game Features: 1. Online third person shooter adventure game. 2. Intense and exciting Boss battles, rich and varied. Monster category 3. Item affixes full of surprises and random drops. 4. Fight with pistols, rifles, shotguns and melee weapons. Game background: In the near future, human beings have been freed from the bondage of the body and have mastered the ability to incarnate fantasy bodies. The best warriors among men can even stand up to the gods. Then the abuse of the ability leads to the blurring of the boundary between fantasy and reality...... You will play as a new recruit, solve various world anomalies, and strengthen yourself. Remember: Death is not the end. Any powerful affix could easily change the course of the war.
row.short_description: Gyra is a third-person shooter action game based on Unreal Engine 5. Here, players will be incarnated as fantasy bodies, fighting with monsters from various worlds, looting resources, and improving abilities. Free with no in-app purchases, still under development.
row.notes: This game is TPS (third person shooting) class game. In order to advance the story, there are violent scenes using firearms or bombs, which are repeated but not excessive. There are critical strikes and character or monster scenes, there is no violence when hit or hit, only a variety of sound effects and visual effects.

row.name: Sisyphus
row.detailed_description: Sisyphus is a music rhythm game. Players will control Sisyphus and kick out stones according to the rhythm of the music. As the number of combos increases, the game scenes and stones will change, bringing a new visual experience and challenge. Game Features: Endless Gameplay: The game features an endless mode where players challenge their limits, aiming to maintain combos and score as high as possible. Music Rhythm System: The stone kicking is closely linked to the rhythm of the music. Players must follow the beat with precise movements, experiencing the perfect fusion of music and action. Dynamic Scene and Stone Changes: As the player’s combo count rises, the game’s scenes and stones will change, providing fresh visuals and new challenges. Simple and Intuitive Controls: The game offers easy-to-learn controls, making it suitable for players of all skill levels while providing a deep rhythm sensation and immersive experience. Challenge yourself, break your limits, and feel the power of music! Come join Sisyphus on an endless journey!
row.short_description: Sisyphus is a music rhythm game in which players control Sisyphus to kick out rocks to the rhythm.

row.name: Bird Bump
row.detailed_description: Overview: Tap to stack the square bird higher. Don’t bump into the ledge. Control your bird stacking well, to survive longer. The platforms will magically change, so you should too! Features: Endless gameplay Earn coins to unlock new skins such as parrot, unicorn, rabbit, dog, wolf and more Challenging gameplay
row.short_description: Don't bump into the ledge

row.name: アンリアリィ・サバイバーズ：わたしたちのときめき無人島ライフ
row.detailed_description: 【ゲーム概要】【実況配信大歓迎！！】 アンリアリィ・サバイバーズは、VTuberたちがメタバース「アンリアリィ」の世界で繰り広げる、サバイバルアドベンチャーゲームです。プレイヤーは、2人のVTuber キャラクター「麗白つむぎ」と「小太刀咲夜」を操作し、無人島での生活を楽しみながら、配信や実況で高評価を獲得していきます。クラフトや採取、釣りや狩猟を駆使して、サバイバル生活を乗り越えていくことが目標です。 【ストーリー】 プレイヤーは、架空のvtuber「麗白つむぎ」と「小太刀咲夜」 夏休みにアンリアリィサバイバーズというイベントに出ることに メタバース「アンリアリイ」の世界にある、無人島で一緒にサバイバル生活を送ります。視聴者からのギフトやチャットを活用しながら、島での生活を楽しむ一方で、動画のネタを集めて人気を高めていくことが求められます。 果たしてサバイバル生活を乗り越え、最高の動画を作ることができるのでしょうか？ ・キャラクター紹介 麗白つむぎ 【音声】COEIROINK麗白つむぎ(CV夜宵紫苑) • ﻿特徴：お絵描きが好きで、採取が得意。しかし、身体能力は弱め。 • ﻿役割：主にクラフトや採取を担当。 小太刀咲夜 【音声】COEIROINK小太刀咲夜(CV乃花こより) • ﻿﻿特徴：身体能力が高く、遠距離武器の扱いに長けている。狩猟が得意だが、採掘スキルは低い。 • ﻿役割：主に狩猟を担当。 【ゲームプレイ】 • ﻿拠点作り：最初は小さな旗を立てた場所が拠点になります。拠点でキャラクターを切り替え、効率的にサバイバル生活を進めましょう。 • ﻿クラフト：クラフトによって新しい道具や建物を作り、生活を豊かにしていきます。 • ﻿採取と狩猟：咲夜は高い身体能力を活かし、狩猟や採取を行います。 • 配信とギフト：プレイヤーが釣りや狩猟で視聴者を取ると、視聴者からギフトが届きます。ギフトには食べ物や素材などの物資が含まれ、サバイバル生活を支援します。 目標 • ﻿視聴者からの高評価を得て、ギフトを獲得する。 • ﻿最高の動画を作成し、VTuberたちの人気を高める。 Project.Unreallyは音声合成キャラを使った創作活動をしているプロジェクトです。 ゲームだけでなく漫画や動画、二次創作で使える音声合成キャラを作成しています。 今後ともさまざまなメディア展開をしていく予定です。よろしくお願いいたします。
row.short_description: 無人島サバイバルで作る最高の動画！視聴者と一緒にVTuberたちの夏休みを盛り上げよう！

row.name: ReDo
row.detailed_description: Enticed by the prospects of fame and fortune, a senior class of exorcist students roam the halls of the infamous East Ridge High where numerous blood thirsty spirits hunt the halls for fresh prey. A horror visual novel with a point and click choose your own adventure style that can lead to multiple endings
row.short_description: A supernatural horror visual novel game where your choices decide if you and your friends see the light of day again or not. Use your sleuthing skills with point and click mechanics to battle horrifying creatures of the night that haunt an abandoned school building and earn your title of 'Exorcist'!
row.reviews: “Great game, enjoyed a much I hope you'll continue working on this project and the other games. Keep it up.” 5/5 – JYN “Great game! I really hope you'll continue working on it and drop more chapters.” 5/5 – PolishLynx “Had some jumpscares that genuinely got me, the game contains beautifully animated scenes, excited to see this game completed.” 5/5 – Dum._.pling
row.notes: Violence, Gore, Swearing, Blood, Death

row.name: SteamForge
row.detailed_description: SteamForge is an indie clicker game where players click on the anvil in their workshop to earn diamonds. With the diamonds you earn, you can open mysterious creatures that give you items. These items can be sold on the Steam Marketplace . The goal of the game is simple: farm diamonds by clicking, open creatures for items, and sell them for profit. You will explore a virtual economy based on the Steam marketplace, where you can interact with other players and trade your items. Main Features: Clicker gameplay: Click the anvil to earn diamonds and open creatures that give you items. Creatures and rare items: Discover creatures that provide valuable items that can be sold on the Steam Marketplace. Simplicity and fun: The gameplay is easy to understand and highly addictive, perfect for short gaming sessions. Step into the world where each click could bring you a new item to sell!
row.short_description: SteamForge is an indie clicker game where you farm diamonds by clicking an anvil. Use your diamonds to open mysterious creatures that drop valuable items. These items can be sold on the Steam Marketplace. Simple, addictive gameplay with endless opportunities for trading and earning.

row.name: HoloCall - Send Your Cheers!
row.detailed_description: 'HoloCall' is a fan-made music rhythm game inspired by hololive. You can choose your favorite hololive songs to play. In the game, notes fall along with the rhythm. You need to press the keys in time with the notes and rhythm, and shout out the calls using your microphone when prompted to score high points. Each song offers four difficulty levels, allowing everyone, from rhythm beginners to experts, to enjoy the fun of cheering and calling. For those unfamiliar with hololive, we hope you'll discover its charm through our energetic, heart-moving songs. For hololive fans, this game serves as a practice tool for live concert calls. And for those who couldn't get concert tickets, we hope this game provides some comfort and lets you experience the unity of a live venue. ※Powered by 'CRIWARE'.CRIWARE is a trademark of CRI Middleware Co., Ltd.
row.short_description: A rhythm music game where you press buttons while doing fan calls. Show your support for your favorite hololive idols by cheering with your voice!

row.name: Lithium
row.detailed_description: In Lithium , you play as one of three social groups of your choice – Activists, Locals, or the City – who mobilize against a planned lithium mining project in Cínovec, Czechia . The developer seeks to start mining quickly, regardless of the locals’ interests. You aim to halt this project and initiate a debate about a just and environmentally friendly solution. Will you stall the mining project so the developer cannot finish his projects? Or will you join forces with the remaining social groups for a collective action? The second can be reached by organizing a deliberative forum about the environmental consequences of such mining.   To win the game, it is essential to cooperate with all social groups to gain societal support for your actions. Each social group has different actions and tools at its disposal.   Every action you take may provoke unexpected reaction. You to consider various factors when choosing a winning strategy. These factors include the local community, the global economy, the climate crisis, the impact on nature, and a just energy transition. Investigating lithium mining in Czech Cínovec and the global context of energy transformation is the central theme of the new ecogame Lithium , developed by the art Blue Pulsar kolektiv for the exhibition Symptoms of the Future at the Hraničář Gallery (September 2024—February 2025).
row.short_description: Play as one of three social groups of your choice who mobilize against a planned lithium mining project. The developer seeks to start mining quickly, you aim to halt this project and initiate a debate about a just and environmentally friendly solution.

row.name: fluXis
row.detailed_description: fluXis is a community-driven, vertical scrolling rhythm game with customizable visual and gameplay effects. Create your own flashy maps or compete against the world in the online leaderboards. Features Feature-packed Editor - Create your own maps and share them with the world. Visual and Gameplay Effects - Move the playfield around, change the key count mid-song, flash the screen white or make it greyscale, with no limitations! Online Multiplayer - Play with your friends or compete against strangers online. Customization - Change textures and move HUD elements around however you want. Cross-game compatible - Import and play maps from various other rhythm games and add support for more games through plugins.
row.short_description: A community-driven rhythm game with a focus on creativity and expression.

row.name: It's Raining Acorn!
row.detailed_description: Welcome to It’s Raining Acorn! —an idle pachinko drafting game where strategy meets nature in a beautifully crafted, vertically scrolling forest. It sits on the side of your desktop and you can leave it running while you work, but good luck focusing when you see those acorns bounce, roll, and trigger satisfying combos across your custom-built forest. Key Features Pachinko-Style Fun : Place, tweak, and upgrade your pieces to create the most efficient acorn-catching setup. Idle with a Twist : Unlike typical idle games, this one won’t let you completely forget about it. The falling acorns, playful animals, and bouncing balls are just too satisfying to ignore. A Dynamic, Living World : Mix and match animals, plants, and landscapes to create a vibrant ecosystem that’s always evolving Fits Right into Your Screen (Or Not) : Built to sit unobtrusively on the side of your your screen. Relaxing Yet Hard to Resist : Don’t be deceived by it’s relaxing vibes, the game is cleverly designed to make it hard to stop playing once you start.
row.short_description: An idle, drafting pachinko game that slowly distracts you from work while you watch the acorns rain from the side of your screen!

row.name: Hyperdrive Horizon
row.detailed_description: Get ready to dive into the ultra-dynamic universe of Hyperdrive Horizon , an electrifying space racing game where speed, reflexes, and adrenaline are the keys to victory! Game Modes Single player: Challenge yourself to beat your own records and improve with every race. VS AI: Test your skills against highly competitive AI opponents designed to push you to your limits. Ships and Customization Unlockable Ships: Earn new ships with unique designs as you race. Customizable Colors: Make your ship your own by choosing from a variety of vibrant color schemes. Features: Boosts and barrel rolls: Use boosts to speed past your opponents and barrel rolls to skillfully dodge obstacles. Procedurally generated tracks: Every race is unique, offering fresh and unpredictable challenges with dynamically generated terrain. Global Leaderboard: Compare your best times and achievements with players from around the world to see who is the fastest racer. Race across a vast lunar canyon, dodge obstacles at high speed, and collect boosts to push yourself even further. With fluid gameplay and increasing difficulty, Hyperdrive Horizon offers a tough challenge for players seeking fast-paced action. Are you up for the challenge? Play Hyperdrive Horizon and experience a game that combines the simple with the extreme!
row.short_description: Hyperdrive Horizon is a high-speed space racer where you’ll dodge obstacles, collect boosts, and challenge advanced AI on dynamic tracks.

row.name: Takara Cards: Academy
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Academy, Cadet! In this free prologue of Takara Cards, you can create your Cadet and venture into the first sector of your adventure in search of the Space-Dragons who stole from the Federation. Build your deck while exploring the Cosmos, and choose from a handful of Maneuver and Equipment cards earned in story events, level-ups, and stores. Create new characters and strategies: Earn extra XP in combat by doing a chain of COMBOS! Plan and make your turns never end: Defeating a wave of enemies recharges your batteries. You might even resort to using your whole ship as a weapon! Continue your adventure from the Prologue in the full version of Takara Cards without doing anything!

row.name: CodeStrike - Python Practice Adventure Game
row.detailed_description: In Code Strike , you don’t “learn Python” through lectures—you bring Python with you into the mission. Play as Nova, an elite agent dropped into a world cracked open by rogue AI and corporate greed. When systems fail and routes lock down, Python is your way through. Hack devices, solve puzzles, and push missions forward with real code—then jump straight back into the action. “If you tried CodeStrike earlier, consider giving the latest build another look. We have rebuild it from the ground ,it feels different now: smoother controls, cleaner UI, easier first missions, more polish, and a privacy-friendly setup.” Real Python. Real impact. You’ll use real Python to: Hack security systems mid‑mission. Solve high‑stakes puzzles to unlock routes and objectives. Turn the tide in combat with tactical, code-driven decisions. Take on optional side missions for extra rewards. Build confidence with Python concepts while still playing a proper action game. Early Access (what’s in right now) Tutorial level. Explosive trial level focusing on Python strings and variables. Story-driven missions where code affects what happens next. Shooting, fighting, puzzles—powered by what you write. Fight smarter, code faster, win bigger. Every line you write can be the difference between getting out… or getting erased. We improved the game (latest build) Smoother, more responsive controls (movement + camera). Improved UI (cleaner screens, clearer prompts, easier navigation). Easier for beginners (better guidance and a friendlier ramp-up). More polish : improved low‑poly visuals and better animations . Stability pass : fixed game‑breaking issues (minor bugs may remain). Privacy change : removed the need for third‑party tracking; only in‑game progress/coding progress is tracked. Multi-language support is planned (not available yet). For students (and self-learners) Interactive coding missions that unlock systems, disarm traps, and complete objectives. Mission-based progression with upgrades and new challenges. Difficulty that can work for beginners who know the basics, and still stay interesting for intermediate coders. Runs well on low-end PCs (no high-end GPU required). For educators Customizable missions to align challenges with a course or syllabus. Classroom-friendly way to reinforce Python concepts through hands-on practice. Adaptable difficulty for beginner/intermediate/advanced levels. Progress tracking (planned for future updates). Who is this for? Gamers who want action with a fresh mechanic. Coders who want a fun way to practice Python. Students/educators who want practice that feels like gameplay, not homework. Important note (please read) Code Strike is not a step-by-step teaching course. It’s designed to supplement your Python learning by giving you a place to practice and apply what you’re already studying. If you’re brand new to coding, pairing the game with a course/book/tutorial will make the experience much smoother.
row.short_description: Code Strike is a high-action coding game where you fight, hack, and race through missions. Solve puzzles, battle enemies, and master real Python coding and AI skills — all while surviving intense combat, shooting sequences, and thrilling adventure.

row.name: Kingdom of Piss
row.detailed_description: Step into the world of Kingdom of Piss , a wild, punk-infused visual novel that blends irreverence, adventure, and bizarre humor. These two misfits are stuck in a situation they never asked for, as they navigate the chaos of royal life while craving freedom. Whether it’s battling absurd political schemes, sabotaging stuffy royal events, or just blowing off steam at a local dive bar, this couple is out to prove that sometimes the best way to rule is by refusing to follow the rules. row.name: Mecharashi
row.detailed_description: Mecharashi is a mecha-themed tactical turn-based game. The game adopts a unique part-destruction combat system, where you can assemble mechas however you want, equip a wide selection of weapons, and choose your favorite pilots to engage in battle. When any part of a mecha is destroyed, its battle efficiency will diminish significantly. By focusing attacks on the most critical enemy parts, you can gain a clear strategic advantage. As a mecha commander, your task is to achieve victory through strategic insight and journey through a world shaped by war, where profound stories of dire conflict and unassailable hope are born! ■ Tactical Turn-Based Mech Action, Unparalleled Next-Gen Graphics Every detail, from scene design to the mech models, is crafted in a solemn, realistic style to achieve the ultimate expression of mech aesthetics. ■ Story Stages Combining Engaging Narratives and Tough Challenges Surrounded by the immersive environments of Milkhama, players command a mercenary unit, exploring the world and shaking up the political machinations behind the scenes, becoming key players in a story that will shape history. ■ Build and Customize Your Mecha Squad On Milkhama Island, countless mecha factories vie for supremacy, leading to the creation of classic mechas with diverse designs and performance features, along with an array of corresponding weapons. You can customize the bodies, arms, legs, and weapons of your mechas to form a mecha squad tailored to each battle's needs, then outfit them with elite pilots, each boasting a unique personality and backstory. You can also customize the paintwork of your mechas and weapons down to the finest details, with over 120 free colors available by default. ■ Revolutionary Turn-Based 'Part Destruction' Gameplay The hit points of different mecha parts are calculated separately in battle, allowing for individual part destruction. This feature opens the doors to a world of infinite strategic possibilities. Destroying the torso, the part with the highest hit points, will directly neutralize the target, while breaking the arms or legs will impair weapons and mobility. Your every choice must be considered in advance, based on the current situation on the battlefield. Thank you for your interest in Mecharashi. We look forward to meeting you in Milkhama!
row.short_description: Mecharashi is a mecha-themed tactical turn-based game. The game adopts a unique part-destruction combat system, where you can assemble mechas however you want, equip a wide selection of weapons, and choose your favorite pilots to engage in battle.

row.name: 米姆米姆哈
row.detailed_description: mimumimimimu— （等你很久了梦想家mimu，7月24日梦世界正式开放，请收下这份入住说明书mimu~） 欢迎来到0分孤单全糖陪伴的米姆米姆哈！ 我们的生活准则是，允许摆烂禁止孤单。在这里双端互通一直热闹，无论何时无论做什么，都有好友和米姆在陪你。 【陪你去飞】 驾驶飞屋漫游主题浮岛，穿越云海邂逅一个又一个的奇妙世界和它的小伙伴们，一场童话般的飞屋环游式团建等待你的到来； 你可以撑着滑翔伞飞！把滑翔伞系在日落尾巴上，和好友共享同一片渐变色天空 你还可以开着小飞机，巨树岛的烟花、松鸣群岛的萤火虫，溪柳小岛漂流的歌声跳上你的机翼，探索一个个未知空中国度…… 【陪你去疯】 浮空岛可以沉默，但不建议孤独。可以在云海中开启钓鱼比赛、骑着巨型米姆赛跑，或者加入飞行爱好者协会冒险队，显眼包们还能穿着西瓜菠萝水果套装到处打卡……请注意无论你在做什么，浮空岛的云海，岛上的米姆，都在陪伴着大家哦！！ 【陪你去种】 无人岛终于要变成有人岛了！天上的菜可不是一般的菜，种下孤独收获方头南瓜，种下压力收获星星小麦，这里永远给你元气~好了，请暂停双手，有请我们的软fufu搭子米姆，蓝蓝鼠浇水、桃桃猴采石头、刚带回家的夜电喵居然还会做面包……诶？卡皮豚怎么在摸鱼！惩罚它来让梦想家rua肚皮吧！ 【陪你去造】 地形是能改造的，高度上限是没有的，家具建材是多样，浮空搭建是可以的，8D立体岛屿只有你想不到，没有你搭不出。I人可以用999块方块搭巨型仓库安全屋，抽象显眼包可以把岛爆改空中花园或者盖大型厕所。你还能为你的好友搭建一座独一无二的地标建筑，建完记得拍照发到空岛好友圈，会有很多人为你点赞的！ 【陪你去躺】 无论是种菜、探索收集，还是钓鱼比赛开趴体，浮空岛永居计划已经开启，有人陪你看日落，有人陪你听晚风。 7月24日，请点击你的好友，发送【点亮惊喜瞬间】的邀请吧~~

Fight your way through 3 handcrafted dungeon maps, from haunted graveyards, monster-filled forests to the empty tombs in the pyramids. Beware of what you will find there! We composed a melodic horror sound that will companion you through the exciting experience. This is a student project made in Godot 4.3. Open the skill tree, go on a shopping spree and come back to finally kill the reaper! Controls: Play with mouse and keyboard. row.name: Cat Syndicate: Istanbul
row.detailed_description: Do you love cats? How about a bit of chaos, strategy, and cuteness all mixed together? Then welcome to Istanbul's purr-fect neighborhood. Run your own little cat business in the heart of where East meets West, team up with uniquely talented Turkish feline friends, grow your production — and make some lira along the way. Meet legendary Turkish cat breeds in their natural habitat. ✔ Limited Space, Endless Possibilities – Make the most of Istanbul's narrow streets and compact shops. Don't miss the cutest corner of Istanbul. Add it to your wishlist!
row.short_description: Get ready for a mix of chaos, strategy, and cuteness in the heart of Istanbul. Run your own cat business among the city's legendary street cats, grow your lira income. This becomes a worldwide festival and is called 'Arcarg' , but Forsteritas gradually loses its pursuit of social good and begins kidnapping people for experiments behind the scenes of the competition. Following this, the factions jointly developed new combat mechs, [E.T.E] , and formed the 'Human Alliance,' entering a stalemate with Noah Technologies. Somewhere in this fractured world, a combat organization under the 'Human Alliance,' known as the Ninth Accord, awaits the arrival of a guest... Players command a four-member squad in wide, open environments, seamlessly switching between roles and utilizing diverse combat strategies to control the battlefield. Land, sea, and air combat environments significantly impact squad movement patterns and combat behavior. Combined with varied mech skills and ultimate abilities, you’ll experience the grandeur of the battlefield and the intensity of combat like never before! [Hardcore Mechs x Beautiful Girls: Crafting an Epic Tale of Resistance] Amid the chaotic future, where factions vie for dominance and outer-space technologies disrupt the balance, humanoid combat weapons known as 【E.T.E】   emerged. Together, they fight alongside you for their beliefs, composing an epic anthem of defiance against despair in the end times. row.name: Pale Abyss
row.detailed_description: Our precious sunlight… taken by that… thing. The Pale Abyss, they call it. A wound in the earth, an accursed maw that swallows all it touches. And from its depths spills that pale, unholy light. Lay your eyes upon it… Our warm and golden sunlight has been dragged down into that darkness, twisted and defiled. Mocking us with what was taken! Immersive First-Person 'King's Field-Like' Exploration Master the tactile combat of old school melee and magic when battling strange creatures and traversing the depths. If you want to survive the Pale Abyss, you'll have to fight with every scrap you can find. Long lost weapons, spells and consumables will aid you on your way. Let the Abyss change your very being with the unique Otherworldly Influence System   In the Pale Abyss the otherworldly beings seem to clash and influence whatever mortal beings dare to descend its vast depths. Your actions in battle and during exploration shape your mind and body as you drift towards either the Abyssal  or the Occult . Many secrets and powers are connected to the otherworldly, but when trifling with the eldritch, you might discover unheard of dangers as well...  Beautiful Old-School Aesthetics Harken back to a simpler time in gaming where the few polygons we had jittered and shifted away as we were in awe of the first instances of 3D on our CRT screens. Pale Abyss combines its more modern gameplay with this nostalgic aesthetic to bring a whole new experience in a familiar form. From Humble Origins to Stalwart Explorer Choose from 6 different starter classes with unique origins and let your choice of character stats and Level Ups empower you and the way you fight!  Rich Asynchronous Multiplayer Communicate with other delvers with Chatter Pebbles. Leave behind cryptic messages for other players to find and feel the faint echoes of other players' journeys as you traverse through the Pale Abyss.  Small team with big aspirations Pale Abyss is a student project by a team of three people made within six months. As such, this game is currently only a short Demo with about 1 hour of playtime, but we will continue providing updates in the future. Our humble team at Permanent Crab Studios consists of one Programmer, one 3D Artist and one Musician. While it ain't much, it's honest work, so please enjoy this experience we created for any Adventure Game enthusiast.
row.short_description: Descend into the Pale Abyss, a cursed chasm where the forgotten truths of a dying world fester in its depths. Inspired by games such as King’s Field and Shadow Tower, Pale Abyss is a first-person action RPG about exploration and adventure. Currently it's just a demo with about 1 h of playtime.
row.notes: This game contains stylized fantasy violence.

row.name: Tricks, Treats and Mirrors - An EoG Side Story

row.name: 奇趣博物馆
row.detailed_description: 《奇趣博物馆》是一款以博物馆经营为主题的休闲治愈模拟经营游戏。玩家将扮演博物馆馆长，在可爱的精灵帮助下进行文物收集、修复以及展览，从而慢慢找回世界丢失的色彩。 【核对玩法】 ▼经营博物馆：打扫与解锁博物馆各种特色主题展馆、经营文物展厅、获取门票收入 ▼文物收集：搜集文物碎片-修复文物-恢复色彩-收集图鉴-激活羁绊BUFF-文物展览 ▼精灵探险：体验各类小游戏，派遣精灵进行探险获取更多的文物与文物碎片 ▼精灵养成：通过抽卡获取精灵以及进行精灵养成，养成深度足 ▼色彩恢复：通过日常玩法获取爱心，使用爱心可以对游戏中各个场景进行色彩恢复，从黑白-彩色治愈体验 ▼云顶洞窟：通过清理、挖掘洞窟，完成小游戏解锁各个主题壁画以及获取文物碎片 【游戏特色】 ▼坐拥14层主题展馆的博物馆由你打理经营，更有国宝馆、自建馆、水族馆等待你开启。 ▼100种颜色属性收集后为博物馆带来色彩恢复 ▼1200+件文物及其历史故事待你修复解锁 ▼以游戏为载体，让玩家在游戏的过程中学习到丰富的历史文物与传统文化知识 【创新卖点】 ▼色彩归途（颜色恢复） 游戏创新性加入了颜色恢复玩法，投放了100种颜色属性与文物相结合，玩家可以通过日常活动玩法获取爱心，消耗爱心可以将游戏中各个场景建筑进行颜色恢复，同时我们在玩法中很巧妙地加入了游戏中每个NPC不一样的剧情故事线。让玩家们在黑白-色彩这整个体验旅程十分治愈。 ▼淡彩国风（美术风格） 美术风格与游戏题材高度贴合，在不损害文物辨识度的情况下，让游戏整体感观更可爱、治愈。

row.name: Reap
row.detailed_description: One swing. One cut. One endless harvest. Welcome to Reap, the most relaxing (or obsessive?) game about cutting grass you’ll ever play! row.short_description: One swing. One cut. One endless harvest.

row.name: Drone Academy
row.detailed_description: На планету Кинерма высадились команда первопроходцев с Берлоги. Их цель — исследовать ландшафт, флору и фауну, чтобы создать здесь передовую научную станцию. Вы — оператор квадрокоптера, которому доверяют самые ответственные миссии: от аэрофотосъёмки до доставки хрупких грузов через экстремальные условия. Какие ещё трудности вам уготовит Кинерма? Отличия игры Из стажёров —  в пилоты! Обучение с нуля : от первых взлётов до сложных манёвров. Три режима управления: для новичков и профи (Stable, Angle, Acro). Реалистичная физика полёта : учись управлять, как настоящие операторы. Решайте практические задачи Доставляйте грузы через сложный рельеф и переменные погодные условия. Проводите аэрофотосъёмку объектов для научных целей. Создавайте маршруты автономного полёта с прогнозированием рисков. Вас ждут 14 уникальных миссий, включая гонки, спасательные операции и исследовательские задания. Дополнительные возможности Используйте курсовую камеру и камеру на подвесе для профессиональной работы. Реалистичная система повреждений коптера и груза: научитесь избегать аварий. Поддержка классических пультов управления, совместимость с контроллерами и клавиатурой. Почему стоит попробовать? Бесплатно : погрузитесь в симулятор, доступный каждому. Учебный тренажёр : приобретайте знания и умения в игровой форме. Контент: подходит школьникам до 16 лет и старше. Для всех уровней : новички и опытные пилоты найдут вызов по себе. Присоединяйся к «Академии дронов: Медвежий патруль» и открой будущее экзопланеты Кинерма вместе с медведями-первопроходцами!
row.short_description: Поздравляем, вы зачислены в «Академию дронов»! Освойте управление квадрокоптером в реалистичном симуляторе, полном интересных заданий. 14 миссий на фантастической экзопланете ждут ваши манёвры. Заводите моторы!

row.name: Jurard Run
row.detailed_description: Jurard Run is a short side-scroller shooter game featuring Jurard T Rexford of holostars , the leader of the ARMIS unit! Shoot through corruption beasts and battle against other holostars members on the way. Can you survive until the end? Or will this dino face extinction once again? FIGHT 4 UNIQUE BOSSES! Battle against 4 bosses with unique and creative mechanics, with telegraphed attacks inspired by MMO raids. SIMPLE AND FUN! Destroy incoming corruption beasts and dodge enemy attacks while shooting. It's very simple, but can also be very challenging! SELECT YOUR DIFFICULTY! Play casually in the normal difficulty with checkpoints for each bosses, or challenge yourself in the merciless difficulty with harder mechanics and no checkpoints! ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- WARNING: This game contains some flashing lights. row.short_description: A short side-scroller shooter game featuring Jurard T Rexford of holostars! Fight against corruption beasts and 4 other holostars members in this simple boss-rush game!

row.name: Supercar Collection Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: “Supercar Collection Simulator Prologue” is a game where you can collect cars and earn money by selling surprise car boxes.  Unlock and offer for sale different Supercar series. Each series has different features and advantages. Set up racing platforms in your store and give players the opportunity to race. Make money from racing! Design your Supercar store the way you want. Unlock Supercar series, order surprise boxes and place them on your shelves to make sales. Create the perfect store for lovers of collectibles. Enrich your collection with cars from Supercar boxes. Find and sell rare and valuable cars for a profit, or collect them to complete your collection. Attract more customers by upgrading your store! Win new customers and increase your profits with new shelves, racing platforms, Supercar boxes and collectibles.
row.short_description: Start your own toy car store! Open surprise boxes, expand your collection and start selling. A world of speed awaits you in your shop!

row.name: Death Drive
row.detailed_description: There isn’t much you need for a road trip, just a car, the road, and enough snacks to get you through. Whether it takes days or weeks, as long as you keep going, you’ll reach your final destination. You just have to keep driving. You aren’t running away from something, but you might be running towards something. People say road trips are better with company; you’ve never really agreed. Still, you ended up with company—it seems like Helia, a strange woman you picked up along the way, means to stay with you for the entire trip.                                At least you’ll have someone to talk to.                         Death Drive is a visual novel that takes place entirely inside your trusty jalopy as you make the trip across the country from your hometown to the ocean's shore. With only your dark thoughts and a mysterious hitchhiker you met along the way for company, you must navigate the interstate highways to your final destination, making decisions, defining your character in dialogue, and encountering increasingly strange and haunting events. Features: Tale inspired by classic American Gothic fiction and authors such as Poe, Lovecraft, and King. Branching Narrative Multiple Endings Complex Characters Full Voice Acting Beautiful and Haunting Art (by human artists)
row.short_description: Death Drive is a road trip visual novel inspired by classic American Gothic fiction.
row.notes: Dark content, including topics such as death, suicide, violence, themes of horror, personal loss, self-harm and will feature characters speaking profanity but no themes or dialogue will be sexual in nature.

row.name: Poco
row.detailed_description: Poco is a 2D/3D hybrid point-and-click adventure game where you play as Poco, a two-inch tall clown who is banished from a giant walking circus, and left to fend for themselves in the undergrowth of the Below World, where they befriend and enlist the help of the local homunculus population to build a rocket. Explore the beautiful, cluttered Below World... Where everything broken, lost, or unwanted from the Worlds Above comes to decay. Find items, solve puzzles, and engage in interactive minigames to complete quests. Meet and befriend a cast of 5 homunculi: bizarre little creatures representing the 5 senses. Enjoy the deliciously detailed 2D painted backgrounds and joyously cartoony 3D animation.
row.short_description: Poco is the story of the world's smallest clown, who is banished from the circus and finds themself in a mysterious undergrowth full of lost and broken things. Explore, meet strange creatures, solve puzzles, and help Poco return to the circus in this charming 2D/3D hybrid point-and-click adventure.

row.name: SurfsUp
row.detailed_description: Classic surf re-imagined in the Godot game engine. Free to play and made for everyone. SurfsUp is a faithful recreation of the community air-surfing that is designed for both veterans and newcomers. Whether you're chasing world records or riding your first ramp, SurfsUp offers precise movement, a competitive feel, and an easy entry point into one of gaming's most iconic experiences. Features Multiplayer, Your Way Surf solo or with friends. Join public lobbies or host your own with full control over map selection. Surfing Mechanics Perfect your technique in high-speed air-surfing. Ride ramps, carve tight turns, and launch massive jumps with precision and flow. It's all about momentum, timing, and control. Multiple Game Modes Featuring class Surf, Bhop, Climb (KZ), and Long Jump there's variety with every map Daily Map Rotation A new random set of maps every day keeps sessions fresh and helps you master a wide range of techniques.  All maps are included with the optional Supporter Bundle. Classic Surf Maps Play on iconic maps like Utopia, Boreas, Summit, and Mesa, no unlocks or paywalls. These community classics are always available , letting you sharpen your skills on the maps that helped define the genre. Built in Voice Chat Teach, trash-talk, or just socialize. Voice is fully integrated into every lobby. Global and Friends Only Leaderboards Compete worldwide or with your crew. Every run counts. Cosmetic Item Drops Earn tradable player models and surf animations just by playing. Supporter Bundle DLC An optional upgrade that unlocks all maps, custom lobbies, unique cosmetics, and supports the future of the game's development.
row.short_description: SurfsUp is a free-to-play, high-speed multiplayer platformer where precision movement and air-surfing are the keys to setting your personal best time or even breaking a world record!

row.name: 科技素
row.detailed_description: This game is a PC based third person top-down puzzle game. The inspiration for the game comes from various physical laws in daily life. The overall art style of the game is 'minimalist sci-fi style'. The story background of the game is set in the near future, and players will play as a tester, completing various tests on the newly invented 'technology element' while uncovering the secrets hidden behind the 'technology element' and its inventor 'Dr. Harrison'. During the game, players need to use the keyboard to control the movement of the game character, while selecting different 'technology element' and using mouse clicks to add 'technology element' to surrounding objects. Objects with applied 'technology element' will have special physical states, such as being more elastic, smoother, and heavier. The game is divided into multiple levels, and players need to use these objects with 'technology element' applied to help them reach the end of each level. At the same time, there will be some props on the way, and by collecting these items, players can unlock hidden levels and true endings, revealing the true plot hidden beneath the surface.
row.short_description: This game is a PC based third person top-down puzzle game. The story background of the game is set in the near future, and players will play as a tester, completing various tests on the newly invented 'technology element' while uncovering the secrets hidden behind it.

row.name: Four Mini Kingdoms War
row.detailed_description: This is a small-to-medium RTS game that takes up less than 300MB on the hard drive, but it already has most of the elements required for a classic RTS game, let you quickly experience the fun of RTS games at any time ~UwU. You can collect resources, recruit soldiers, conquer neutral creeps, build buildings, deploy defenses or gather troops to attack the enemy, and play online battles on the LAN! The resources in the game are divided into three types: gold, wood, and meat. You can send your soldiers to collect these resources. These three resources have their own uses: gold coins are used to recruit human soldiers, meat is used to recruit goblin soldiers, and wood is used to build buildings. Each soldier and building has different ability values ​​and special effects. And soldiers can jump onto the buildings of their own team, and different special effects will be obtained depending on the buildings. Choose the map you want to play: the terrain, map size, resource richness, and distance between the camps will bring different gaming experiences. You can freely adjust the difficulty: simply suppress the enemy, fight evenly matched, or take on the most difficult challenge. Play the campaign alone or play online battles on the LAN, try to destroy castles everywhere in different modes, and win the Four Mini Kingdoms War! Special thanks to the pixel art <Tiny Swords> for the beautiful graphics UwU~ I hope you will be interested in more RTS games and other games using <Tiny Swords> after playing :)
row.short_description: This is an RTS game less than 300MB, but it already contains many interesting game mechanics, There are many types of soldiers and tactics for you to choose. Support LAN online battle. Special Thanks for Pixel Art <Tiny Swords> UwU~ I hope you will be interested in more RTS games after playing :)

row.name: Waifu Shop
row.detailed_description: Turn your small island shop into a paradise of wealth and lust! Start with a tiny shop and turn it into the hottest spot on Vesper Island, filled with sexy babes and desire. With your trusty and busty assistant, Harmony, and a team of horny workers, you’ll attract customers, expand your shop, and soon enough, your business will transform into a sizzling harem of the island’s hottest girls! Unlock the island’s secrets, earn naughty rewards, and collect all beautiful girls while building your empire! Send your adventurers on daring missions, and watch as they reward you with exotic treasures… and their eager bodies! Each worker and customer has their own story, secrets, and kinks to explore. Flirt, gift, and charm your way into their hearts and beds to unlock steamy H-scenes and deeper connections. Dive into thrilling visual novel-style stories, packed with uncensored sex scenes and animations that’ll leave you wanting more. With surprises and sexy events around every corner, Vesper Island is never boring. So, what are you waiting for, Master Trader? Grow your shop, expand your harem, and get ready for a wild ride: craft, trade, and love your way to the top!
row.short_description: Welcome to Vesper Island! Build your harem of sexy waifus, grow your shop, and amass a fortune in this unique mix of shop and dating sim. Recruit lusty workers, uncover the island’s secrets, and become the ultimate Master Trader while collecting all the hot babes!

row.name: Senet: Households
row.detailed_description: PROVE YOU'RE BLESSED BY THE GODS Play an Ancient Egyptian board game.  Play against your friends on steam.  Learn new ways to play with -never seen before- special house rules.  Customize the rules to your liking.  Experience a story where you travel through ancient Egypt.  All environments are fact checked by professionals.  Senet Households is a free to play digital adaptation of the Ancient Egyptian Strategy Board game senet. Senet households adds to the base rules of senet with special house rules. The game also brings 3 different historically accurate environments of an Ancient Egyptian farm an Ancient Egyptian festival and an Ancient Egyptian Palace based on the Amenhotep III Palace. Every environment has it's own character with an Ancient Egyptian Farmer's Child, An Ancient Egyptian Priest and An Ancient Egyptian Pharaoh.
row.short_description: Prove you're blessed by the gods in this Online Multiplayer Ancient Egyptian Board Game.

row.name: Scrongly
row.detailed_description: Scrongly is a free poker themed roguelite deckbuilding game inspired by Balatro. Make one card straight flushes, blow up your whole deck with bombs, play seven card poker hands, and much more! Start with a standard deck of 52 cards, or use one of the unlockable decks Earn chips by playing strong poker hands Spend those chips between rounds in the shop on new cards to add to your deck, many of which you won't find in a typical deck You can also purchase Baubles, which change your run in significant ways, like letting you earn chips for discarding aces, or giving multiplier bonuses to hands that contain a lot of face cards Lastly, you can purchase unique zodiacs for all 18 playable hand types, from high card to seven of a kind. Zodiacs improve the power of all played hands that contain that hand type, so that you can transition into higher tier hands without losing your investment Ten difficulties to climb through Boss levels that will challenge your builds Variants system that lets you play the game the way you want to. Like always having a certain Bauble? You can start the game with it. Want Zodiacs to be more powerful and cost less? You can do that. Change your starting deck, the efficacy of special cards, the score thresholds, and a multitude of other options Daily games show off some of the power of the Variants system and have a set seed each day. Compare your score with your friends! Stats tracking and old games are stored, so you can see how far you've progressed Unlockable Baubles Save game system lets you play at your pace
row.short_description: Scrongly is a free poker themed roguelite deckbuilding game inspired by Balatro. Make one card straight flushes, blow up your whole deck with bombs, play seven card poker hands, and much more!

row.name: The Fable of Fairy Glen
row.detailed_description: The Fable of Fairy Glen is a narrative-driven RPG that merges historical events with a vibrant fantasy setting. Set in a small Welsh village during the tumultuous mining strikes, the story follows a humble farmhand who becomes entwined in a tale of sacrifice, community, and unseen forces at play. As mining strikes devastate the local community, a kind-hearted farmer makes the bold decision to give away his wealth to aid the struggling miners and their families. But his generosity comes at a cost—mysterious Elves, tied to the prosperity of the land, begin to pressure him to capitulate, threatening both his livelihood and the balance of the glen. The farmhand, caught in the middle, must navigate the growing tensions, uncover the true nature of the Elves’ motives, and decide where their own loyalty lies. Key Features: A Richly Layered Story : Explore themes of sacrifice, loyalty, and resistance as you witness the far-reaching consequences of one man’s selflessness. Historical Meets Fantasy : Experience a unique blend of Welsh mining history and Celtic folklore, where the struggles of the real world intertwine with the enchantment and danger of the magical.
row.short_description: A Richly Layered Story: Explore themes of sacrifice, loyalty, and resistance as you witness the far-reaching consequences of one man’s selflessness. This is a free story driven game.
row.notes: There are some undertones of drama relating to the turbulence of mining strikes and general calls to action. The content is purely narrative based and is not in anyway gory.

row.name: Puppycraft: Maze
row.detailed_description: Cat vs Dog War: Ultimate Strategy Showdown! Cute Pets, Brutal Brain Battles ——Only 5% Global Clear Rate! Dare to Enter This 'Adorable Hell'? Core Gameplay Become a tactical cat commander on a 7x7 strategic board, battling evil dog forces. Calculate every move, deploy maze walls to trap enemies, and outsmart their formations. One wrong step, and your paws will be forever locked in canine fortresses! Developer's Manifesto 'We craft the cutest looks and the cruelest traps—victorious players' neural synapse density will surpass chess grandmasters!'
row.short_description: A turn-based strategic duel where you command a tactical cat against AI dog armies on a 7x7 dynamic board; Deploy 10 unique barriers per match to build evolving mazes while racing to breakthrough enemy lines; Victory demands razor-sharp calculation of distance optimization and resource management.

row.name: Beastly Bites
row.detailed_description: A Deliciously Twisted Adventure Awaits! Step into a world where every bite has consequences—and every battle brings you closer to redemption. Beastly Bites follows a starving young woman cursed by the Food God and transformed into a supernatural food-human hybrid.   To reclaim her humanity, she must battle food-themed monsters across magical realms, ranging from colorful festival streets to the grand temple. Her journey of redemption and confrontation is driven by fast-paced combat with an oversized chopstick! Gameplay Features Dynamic Chopstick Combat: Players wield an oversized chopstick to execute fast-paced, rhythmic combos, counters, and dodges, rewarding skill and timing. Transformation Progression: The protagonist gradually restores her human form as she defeats food-based foes, providing both narrative and gameplay progression. Unique Food Foes: Battle against imaginative enemies inspired by cursed food dishes, each with unique mechanics and designs. Immersive Environmental Storytelling: Explore a surreal, magical realm filled with visually rich and narratively engaging locations such as abandoned festival grounds, mystical lantern-lit gardens, and the Food God’s grand temple. Controls Movement: Left Joystick/WASD Camera: Right Joystick/Mouse Interaction:  L1/E Skip Dialogue:  R1/Left click Light Attack: L1/Left click Heavy Attack: R1/Right click Run: B/Shift Dash: L2/Ctrl Targeting: R3/Middle Mouse click Pause: Start/ESC About Us Beastly Bites is the result of  eight weeks of collaboration  by a team of 15 students from  DADIU  ( Danish Academy of Digital Interactive Entertainment ). Hailing from universities across Denmark, we combined our talents in  design, programming, art, and sound  to create this flavorful, action-packed game. This game was made by... row.short_description: A fast-paced action-adventure where a cursed woman wields an oversized chopstick to battle food-themed monsters. Progressing through surreal realms, will she be able defeat the Food God who's behind her curse and reclaim her humanity?
publishers: DADIU (The National Academy of Digital, Interactive Entertainment)

row.name: Veil of Sanity
row.detailed_description: Veil of Sanity: Echoes of the Carnival (Chapter 1) Welcome to the haunting world of Veil of Sanity: Echoes of the Carnival , the first chapter in a psychological horror series. Set in a derelict carnival, this game immerses players in a tense and atmospheric battle for survival. Key Features Thrilling Chase Gameplay : Evade the relentless pursuit of a terrifying clown while navigating the carnival grounds. Problem-Solving Under Pressure : Fix broken generators, repair electrical boxes, and locate essential tools—all while being hunted. Creative Combat : Outsmart your foe by luring them into traps. Use tools you find to gain the upper hand and survive the night. Dynamic Sanity System : Keep your mind intact by managing your fear and using rare resources to fend off psychological effects. Atmospheric Exploration : Dive into the dark, abandoned carnival, exploring areas like twisted funhouses, eerie tents, and more. What to Expect This first chapter offers a standalone horror experience that blends stealth, strategy, and light problem-solving with a tense and unfolding story. Future chapters will expand on the narrative with new threats, environments, and challenges. Will you survive long enough to uncover the truth?
row.short_description: Veil of Sanity: Echoes of the Carnival (Chapter 1) combines psychological horror with intense gameplay. Keep your sanity intact as you explore a forsaken carnival. More chapters coming soon!

row.name: Bubba Yuga
row.detailed_description: A curse! The three Baba Yaga sisters have been cursed for their misdeeds. Two of the sisters have been tethered together by magic and the third… well, she’s been transformed into a house! You must work together to solve puzzles, find the children, and lift the curse from your family. In this cute co-op game, players can use their magic to both lift objects and one another to navigate through puzzle-filled woods. Throughout these woods, players will find lost children and bring them back to the house-sister that follows you through your journey. Together, the sisters can use their tether to: Dangle off ledges Pull physics objects about the environment Yank the other player And more! Birds of a feather must work together. Bubba Yuga must be played using controllers. The game only supports local multiplayer. Bubba Yuga was created in 6 weeks by students at the University of Utah for the Master of Entertainment Arts and Engineering program.
row.short_description: Bubba Yuga is a 2-player couch co-op puzzle game based on the Slavic folktales of the Baba Yaga. Playing as a pair of tied together witches, you and a friend must work together with your walking house to capture all the woodland children and break the curse that’s been placed upon your family.

row.name: Cemetery Warrior 7 Boss Rush
row.detailed_description: Cemetery Warrior 7 Boss Rush. It is a hardcore 3D Shooter from the first person, where you have to defeat 11 strongest bosses! All the best bosses from the previous parts are collected here: here is a giant worm from the 4th part of the game, and a mighty dragon from the 5th part, as well as a number of COMPLETELY NEW bosses, for which you need to choose a special tactic! There are no restrictions! Just choose a boss and test your skill! Boss battles are quite hardcore and will require the player to study the behavior of bosses, as well as the competent use of the Dash - the main skill of the demon Zexus. If you hit the timing and dodge correctly, you can avoid any damage, but this requires a good reaction and competent use of endurance energy. (based on the principle of souls-like games) The game also has a survival mode, where you can fight with ordinary enemies and set your own survival record. For the survival mode, the player receives special coins that can be spent on temporary bonuses - boosts, in case the bosses still seem too difficult. In this way, the player can significantly strengthen himself before the battle with the bosses, for example, by calling on the Fire Dog to help him fight on your side, or by strengthening the armor, or increasing the ammunition. - Crazy 1st person 3D Shooter action with heavy metal, play as Demon Zexus and test your skill! - Various weapons: Shotgun, Minigun, Laser Gun, Grenade Launcher, Blazing Blade that shoots fireballs! - 11 strongest and most diverse bosses to choose tactics for. - Survival mode, where you can have a meaty shootout with a large number of enemies! - Bonus boost system: Fire Dog - assistant, Blazing Blade, armor boost, speed, ammunition. - A real test for hardcore players, where reaction speed and timing are important!
row.short_description: Cemetery Warrior 7 Boss Rush. It is a hardcore 3D Shooter from the first person, where you have to defeat 11 strongest bosses!
