row.name: 梦境管理公司：梦魇清洁工
row.detailed_description: DreamControl Inc: Nightmare Cleaner is an action role-playing game set in a medieval-inspired dream world. As night falls, you assume the role of a senior cleaner at DreamControl Inc, tasked by an elderly woman to enter the nightmares of her granddaughter, who weeps in the attic. Navigate through labyrinthine dreams, battle against dark forces to cleanse the girl's haunting nightmares, collect powerful relics left behind by former colleagues to enhance your abilities, confront perilous challenges, and piece together scattered diary fragments to uncover the truth behind the origins of these dark visions.
row.short_description: Guard every trapped soul. Step into the realm of dreams, and clear away the nightmares. DreamControl Inc—wishing you pleasant dreams!

row.name: Hit and Stand Blackjack
row.detailed_description: Hit and Stand Blackjack is a relaxed 2D card game where you play classic blackjack at your own pace. No timers, no pressure — just sit back, play your hand, and enjoy the calm atmosphere. The only sound in the game is a gentle background music track , designed to help you relax. Prefer silence? You can easily adjust or disable the music in the settings. Features: Classic solo blackjack Over/Under side bet: Guess if your starting hand totals over or under 13 for bonus credits Split pairs for more chances to win Multiple difficulty levels — from casual to challenging (note: on Hard mode the player’s hand count is hidden) Five unlockable achievements Relaxing background music only (no sound effects) Multiple included backgrounds to choose from Customizable audio and language settings Whether you're unwinding after a long day or looking for a chill card game, Hit and Stand Blackjack is your perfect match.
row.short_description: A chill 2D blackjack game with relaxing music, side bets, and multiple difficulty levels. Play at your own pace and unwind.

row.name: Mighty Wars
row.detailed_description: Mighty Wars Prepare for epic battles and strategic warfare in Mighty Wars , one of the finest turn-based strategy games that masterfully blends RPG elements, multiplayer online battle arenas, and action-packed gameplay. Rise as the ultimate warlord, defeat ruthless enemies, and prove your dominance in the Battle Royale Warzone. Assemble an immortal team of heroes, craft your war strategies, and engage in real-time PvP battles against guild masters from around the world to build your empire. Show your might and become the most powerful war commander! Real-Time PvP Battles! Harness your combat strategies and recruit a roster of spectacular heroes to lead epic battles and conquer the Warzone. Develop your warlord with enhanced looks and abilities to become unstoppable in online PvP fights and dominate the battlefield. Build Your Ultimate Army! Collect and choose from over 100 powerful heroes, each with unique abilities and equipment, to form an unstoppable team. Upgrade legendary heroes to win thrilling daily challenges, improve your Mighty Wars experience, or join a guild to embark on epic missions with your allies. Crush Your Rivals or Power Up! Strengthen your forces by defeating rivals or acquiring powerful upgrades. Key Features: Engage in real-time PvP battles Join guilds and clans to unite with other players Deploy dozens of special heroes with unique abilities and combinations Plan your Battle Royale strategies and war tactics Collect and develop heroes and warlords Enjoy stunning graphics Explore a variety of exciting game modes Compete Globally! Battle opponents from around the world in diverse modes like the Hall of Fame, Gold Mine, and Dungeon of Trial. Experience real battles with your alliance and lead your team to glory. Become the Ultimate Commander! Develop your offensive and defensive strategies, rise as the Clash Royale demon slayer, and invite players to join your guild. Trade heroes and items with friends, chat, share war spoils, and compete in an incredible mobile gaming universe. NOTE: Mighty Wars is free to play, with optional in-app purchases for in-game currencies and items. An internet connection is required. Are you ready to command, conquer, and become the mightiest war commander of all time? Join the battle now!
row.short_description: Mighty Wars – A thrilling turn-based strategy game blending RPG and PvP action. Build an immortal hero team, craft war strategies, and dominate real-time battles against global rivals. Conquer the Warzone, join guilds, and become the ultimate war commander! Free to play with in-app purchases.

row.name: Ocean Otter Climb
row.detailed_description: Ocean Otter Climb is a 2D platformer game about climbing to great heights. An otter has fallen into the deep sea, where someone has drained all the water! Now, the otter must make its way back to the surface. Jump from platform to platform and escape the depths of the ocean. You can soak in water to fill your water pouch! Use the water as a booster to reach higher and farther platforms. Can the otter safely return to the surface? Start your challenge now!
row.short_description: Ocean Otter Climb is a 2D platformer game about climbing to great heights. Let's climb With CUTE SEA OTTER!

row.name: 디시인사이드 중붕이의 모험(Joongboongi's Adventure)
row.detailed_description: This game is a role-playing adventure featuring the protagonist 'Kim Joongbung,' an ordinary unemployed person. Hearing a rumor that collecting classic games can lead to a great job at a game company, 'Kim Joongbung' embarks on a journey to gather classic games. This is a game about 'Kim Joong-boong,' a lifelong unemployed man, struggling to live a better life. Talk to people in the village to gather information for collecting items. Defeat monsters or collect items to earn monetary rewards. During the journey, you will encounter various powerful monsters that you must fight and defeat. Overcome unbeatable monsters by leveling up and gaining strength. You won't be able to defeat monsters at Level 1. Converse with villagers and open all treasure chests to purchase armor. Gather all the items required by the game to achieve your goal. Press the Page Up key during the game to view the current mission. Press Page Down to make it disappear. Controls Movement : Arrow keys Dash : Left Shift key View Mission : Page Up, Page Down View Options : ESC key
row.short_description: The game genre is a modern role-playing game. You can move around the village using the arrow keys, talk to people, and open treasure chests. You can experience the life of a young person that could happen in reality.

row.name: Hidden Cats: City
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in the relaxing world of Hidden Cats: City by finding cleverly hidden cute cats and paint black - white locations with colored inks. Let your keen eyesight and interest guide you on this exciting journey! Atmospheric background music will ensure complete relaxation) Suitable for the whole family) Game Features: 150 hidden cats There is a hint The map is colorable 2.5D effect Customize brightness Saving progress Scaling Relaxing music
row.short_description: Go on a short but sweet adventure into the black and white world of an urban area! Enjoy the search for cats and recreate a colorful picture. 150 cute cats are waiting for you! Play and relax!

row.name: Run, Veggies!
row.detailed_description: Escape the Plate! Meet Tom, Cornelius, and Cabb! — A fiery tomato with a knack for reaching high places, a clever ear of corn who launches kernels with pinpoint accuracy, and a strong, gentle cabbage with a heart of gold. Trapped in a sprawling food processing plant, this unlikely trio must combine their talents to leap, swing, and smash their way through a maze of deadly machinery, perilous platforms, and creeping threats. Teamwork is their only hope as they solve tricky puzzles, avoid unseen dangers, and face off against more than just machines — These challenges will test more than just their roots. The factory isn’t empty… and getting out won’t be easy. Can this veggie trio make it out before they’re turned into someone's next meal?
row.short_description: Three unlikely heroes— a fiery tomato, a clever ear of corn, and a strong cabbage — must combine their unique skills to escape a dangerous food processing plant! Leap, swing, and smash through puzzles, hazards, and hidden threats before they end up on the plate. It’s time to Escape the Plate!

row.name: Heist Royale
row.detailed_description: Heist Royale is a fast-paced multiplayer heist game where strategy, sabotage, and teamwork collide! Gather your friends and race to rob a heavily secured bank on a mysterious abandoned island. But there’s a twist—everyone is out for themselves! Will you outsmart your rivals, trick security, and escape with the most cash, or will you get caught in the chaos? 🏦 Plan, Steal, Sabotage! In Heist Royale , you’ll need quick thinking and clever tactics to navigate a high-stakes heist. Every match is a race to break into the bank, grab as much money as possible, and escape before your rivals do. 🔥 Key Features: 🎭 Multiplayer Mayhem – Play online with your friends (only private rooms). 🏃‍♂️ Every Robber for Themselves – Work together… or backstab your way to victory! 💰 Dynamic Heists – Security systems, guards, and unexpected events keep every match unpredictable. 🎮 Easy to Pick Up, Hard to Master – Simple controls with deep strategic possibilities. 😂 Chaotic Fun – Traps and hilarious physics-based interactions make every heist unique. 🕵️‍♂️ Customize Your Crook – Play as quirky fruit-headed robbers in stylish suits. Can you pull off the perfect heist, or will you be left empty-handed? Find out in Heist Royale !
row.short_description: Heist Royale is a chaotic multiplayer heist game where strategy, sabotage, and speed determine who escapes with the most cash! Race to rob a heavily secured bank, outsmart rivals, and dodge security—all while pulling off hilarious tricks and betrayals. Work together or backstab your way to victory!
row.notes: Heist Royale contains mild mature content. Some female character outfits feature clothing that may be considered suggestive and revealing. Additionally, alcohol is present as a gameplay mechanic—it temporarily impairs a player's vision and movement, creating a tactical disadvantage.

row.name: Restoring the Past
row.detailed_description: Hello everyone, I’m an indie game developer with five cats. This is a free 2D puzzle game where you restore damaged artifacts from various periods of ancient history. Move and rotate the pieces to complete the restoration like a jigsaw puzzle! Game Features: Each level showcases a beautifully crafted ancient artifact, accompanied by a brief introduction. Simple mouse controls: Left-click to move, scroll to zoom, and right-click to rotate. A nostalgic art style with relaxing background music. A peacefully sleeping cat will always be by your side—come and unwind!
row.short_description: Restore ancient artifacts in the company of a cat!

row.name: Where's my kitty
row.detailed_description: Do you like cute cats? Come to 'Where's my kitty?'! Participate in this grand cat-finding party and use your sharp eyes and smart mind to discover every cat hidden in the party. [Game Goal] Find all the cats! [Gameplay] Try to find all the hidden cute cats in the shortest time, catch them, and enjoy the fun of discovering cats. [Unique Scene] From rural areas to neighborhoods, from markets to New Year, you can find cute cats hidden in various scenes. Discover the cats in each scene. [The Strongest Brain] Through different scenes, exercise your brain, improve your observation skills, find hidden cats, and hone the strongest brain! [Many postures] Each cat hides in different postures, find them and feel the magic of cats. 【Feel the Cat】 Each cat hidden in the scene is unique. Find them, listen to their calls and experience the charm of cats. Are you ready to cuddle your cat? Are you ready to hug the cat? Download 'Where's my kitty?' now and start a warm cat-finding journey.
row.short_description: Do you like playing hide and seek with cats? Come and find them.

row.name: ACS
row.detailed_description: You are an underpaid employee trying to pay off your student loans at Joe's Freedom Burgers, the only Fast Food Joint where burgers are prepared authentically American with the use of firearms and firearms only. Choose your weapons to maneuver food around the kitchen. Each weapon has its own niche - try them all to find out what they're best at. As you are cooking, your boss Joe Hannes is looking over your shoulder - and will routinely point out the mistakes you make. Quality matters - each time you deliver an order, you will get a rating from the customer. They're quite picky - to get the perfect S rank, you'll need to become one with your firearms. At the end of the shift, all your mistakes will be added together. If the customers at the end of the day aren't happy with your performance, you will be fired!
row.short_description: What's more American than Fast Food? How about cooking it with guns! Switch between individual weapons to move ingredients, cook and deliver them to your customers before they lose their patience.

row.name: Mini Idle Dice Monster
row.detailed_description: Ever wished for a friend to roll dice with? Meet Fred, the friendly monster who's Hungry to Play Dice with you! Mini Idle Dice Monster is an idle game all about dice rolling. Roll dice, unleash combos, upgrade perks, and spend time with Fred! Features: Fred the Monster! Many Upgrades and Combos! A prestige System! Statistics to check you progress! Achievements!
row.short_description: Ever wished for a friend to roll dice with? Meet Fred, the friendly monster who's Hungry to Play Dice with you! Mini Idle Dice Monster is an idle game all about dice rolling. Roll dice, unleash combos, upgrade perks, and spend time with Fred!

row.name: Differences Online
row.detailed_description: 🔍 Two similar pictures? Only at first glance! 🏆 Spot the differences faster than your opponent and prove who’s the real observation master. You'll face levels of varying difficulty with 5–10 differences, vibrant images, and easy zoom controls. Stuck? Use a hint - but remember, your opponent won’t wait! 🎮 No Time Limits, Just Pure Challenge! There’s no timer in Differences Online, but that doesn’t mean you can relax. Each round is a duel of perception, where the first to find all the differences wins. Play online against real players, prove your observation skills, and climb the leaderboard! 🗺️ Discover New Locations! As you progress, you’ll unlock new themed picture sets. Explore different game settings, enjoy beautifully crafted scenes, and sharpen your skills with every level. 🧘‍♂️ Train Your Mind & Relax at the Same Time! This game is perfect for improving focus or simply winding down after a long day. No stress, just a fun and engaging experience that helps you concentrate and enjoy the challenge. Ready to test your observation skills? Jump into Differences Online and prove you have the sharpest eye!
row.short_description: Differences Online - a game of attention and speed! Find the differences between two pictures faster than your opponent in exciting duels. Unlock new levels and locations, improve your attention, and compete for the top spot in the rankings. Play stress-free and enhance your skills.

row.name: Nirvana
row.detailed_description: Wake up and embrace your new powers. In this Bullet Hell Fast-FPS, dare to take on mystical creatures to defeat the God Raj. Nirvana awaits... • A mystical universe to explore A mystical temple with many facets, from sacred halls to forgotten crypts, all linked by a mysterious power of divine might, awaits you. On your quest, discover lost artifacts, battle corrupted creatures and restore the sacred balance. • Fast-FPS Bullet Hell: A daunting challenge Immerse yourself in fast-paced, merciless gameplay where every second counts. This fast FPS bullet hell will challenge you with enemies of increasing difficulty and a mix of genres that test your reflexes and strategy. Master your powers to survive the relentless hordes of opponents. • The story of Ari, a young earthling with unique powers Ari, unwillingly absorbed into a mystical world, has accidentally inherited the consciousness of several entities. This bug in the system gives her new powers that guide and strengthen her in her fight. Use these new abilities to progress, unlock secret areas and defeat powerful enemies. Team :  Gameplay Programing - Hugo ROCHE AI Programing - Nathan GATEAU-REUZE Level Design/ Cinematics - Mathieu ABADIE Game/ Level Design - Lucas COULOMBEL Game Design - Andreas VANMEERBECK Concept Art - Ilona DUPREY Character Artist - Noa AFFAGARD Character Artist - Antonin COUZINET Environment Artist - Giovan BUIATTI Environment Artist - Lilian DURET VFX Helper - Kyliann FAGGIAN Sound Design - Nicolas ROCHE Sound Design - Victor DESRAT Sound Design - Solène FALK Music - Arnaud 'Header' PREYNAT-SEAUVE Voice Actors :  Ari - Audrey BOURGEOIS Simon - Frederic PERCHET Anna - Agathe SCHUMACHER Diana - Alexandra MORI Blaise - Ronan DUCOLOMB
row.short_description: Wake up and embrace your new powers. In this Bullet Hell Fast-FPS, dare to take on mystical creatures to defeat the God Raj. Nirvana awaits...

row.name: Death to the Universe: ACT I
row.detailed_description: 'Death to the Universe: ACT I' is a story-driven, 3rd person action platformer which takes place at the end of time. Play as Death, voiced by Kevin Miller (Sly Cooper), in a surreal, shattered world where the concept of death has begun to lose meaning. Despite The Universe falling apart, he clings on to the duty of his job. The Universe itself, voiced by Cassianne Lawrence, is a playful and antagonistic character who mocks and challenges Death at every turn. Represented through the map itself and sometimes as a pair of floating rock hands, The Universe tries to maintain control of an assured, continued existence. Follow Deaths existential journey towards the final souls, as he reveals underlying truths about the underlying fabric of The Universe and learns that his job might be more complex than he anticipated. The game is a mix of dark humor, cosmic absurdity, and existential reflection, blending entertaining gameplay with narrative depth. This game is the product of a six week collaboration project hosted by DADIU.
row.short_description: This game is for people who enjoy classic 3D Platformers, but also have an interest in indie games that combine storytelling, character design and gameplay. Death comes with abilities to challenge any obstacles. Shoot a hookshot to swing across gaps, or wield his scythe to shred any opposition.

row.name: uDesktopMascot
row.detailed_description: About 'uDesktopMascot' 'uDesktopMascot' is a highly customizable desktop mascot application that brings freedom and personality to your desktop. Users can create their own unique desktop environment by adding files and changing settings to suit their preferences. Main Features Customizable Character Models Load 3D models in VRM, GLB, and GLTF formats to freely change the appearance of your mascot Place your favorite characters or original models on your desktop Character Voice Settings Replace the character's voice for startup, shutdown, and when the character is tapped Set original audio files to make your mascot more familiar and personalized Other Features Adjust the mascot's position and size Support for multi-display setups Fine-tune settings for transparency and display state Recommended For Those who want to customize their desktop to reflect their personality Those who wish to feel closer to their favorite characters Those who want to enliven their desktop with 3D models Create your very own desktop mascot with 'uDesktopMascot'!
row.short_description: 'uDesktopMascot' lets you customize your desktop mascot: Add Models: Import models in VRM , GLB, and GLTF formats from folders. Set BGM: Add music files to the BGM folder. Customize Voices: Add voice files for startup, shutdown, and tapping interactions. AI Chat

row.name: Quadrivium - Paths of History
row.detailed_description: There is an energy derived from memories, emotions, and both historical and personal values. It’s connected to places, objects, and monuments. It’s thanks to this very energy—the Glänzen Energy —that the world’s historical memory endures. Today, unfortunately, it’s fading away as we forget more and more quickly. If the Glänzen Energy were to completely dissolve, the world would become an endless desolation. We must act! ENTER THE DRIVIUMNET Join the Quadrivium Project and help your team preserve the world’s historical memory. How? By entering the Driviumnet ! Through it, you’ll gain access to a historical simulation and relive events from the past. Stroll through the streets of Rome in 64 AD, or explore Theodoric’s Palace in Ravenna—level by level, you’ll uncover little-known episodes of history that risk being forgotten forever. PLAY AS DIFFERENT CHARACTERS The strength of a soldier or the skills of a blacksmith? The power of a noble or the knowledge of an intellectual? Why choose just one? Thanks to the Driviumnet, you can embody various characters and use their unique abilities to solve the puzzles within the game. Discover history and hidden plots by adopting different perspectives . IDENTIFY THE HISTORICAL ERRORS The situation is worsening due to Ouroboros —a criminal organization that steals the Glänzen Energy and uses it for its nefarious purposes. The only way to prevent this is to stop them from unleashing chaos by altering historical memory. They must be stopped! By reliving episodes of the past, you can identify these errors and halt Ouroboros before it wreaks havoc. SOLVE THE PUZZLES AND OBTAIN NEW GLÄNZEN ENERGY Every level is a challenge; every story hides secrets. Interact with various characters and solve the puzzles in each mission . Will you be able to obtain the Glänzen Energy needed to put an end to Ouroboros’s crimes? What are you waiting for? Are you ready to enter the Quadrivium Project?
row.short_description: In an innovative 2.5D puzzle game, the Quadrivium Project will transport you into a simulation where you will relive the past while solving puzzles and correcting the errors that threaten the world's historical memory.

row.name: Hidden Tomatoes 3
row.detailed_description: Hidden Tomatoes 3 takes you on a relaxing hidden object adventure through enchanting forests, tranquil rivers, and charming old rural houses. Your task is to find 100 hidden tomatoes cleverly concealed in this serene and captivating environment. With soothing background music and stunning visuals, this game offers a peaceful yet engaging experience for players of all ages. Gameplay: 🍅 1 Level, 100 hidden tomatoes in a lush forest and riverside setting. 👉 Click on the tomatoes as you spot them. Features: Explore beautiful forests, sparkling rivers, and rustic rural homes. No time pressure—enjoy the calm and take your time. A perfect mix of relaxation and challenge for hidden object enthusiasts.
row.short_description: Explore serene forests, sparkling river, and rustic rural houses in *Hidden Tomatoes 3*! Find 100 cleverly hidden tomatoes in a peaceful yet challenging hidden object adventure. With stunning visuals and relaxing gameplay, it's fun for all ages. Can you uncover them all?

row.name: Frosty Enterprise: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Frosty Enterprise: Prologue is the prologue version of Frosty Enterprise Frosty Enterprise is a game in which you can start your ice cream business. You start your journey in a floating town. Your objective is to make ice creams, milkshakes, sundaes and floats for the town's residents and to grow your business! Welcome to the Frosty Enterprise Prologue! This is a small part of the game that awaits you! This prologue includes all the parts of the game to show players what they can expect more about the full game! Starting their business journey in their ice cream truck, players will have all access to the stores that will improve their cute ice cream business. Limited number of flavors are waiting for players to explore! Stores are offering small portion of their inventory for players to have and improve their business. And finally, Recipes! With new flavors and goods you will be able to creates real recipes for your customers! Players will have enough experience and content to love spending time in Frosty Enterprise Prologue and expect the full game!                                                                     ENJOY! Join the beautiful world of Frosty Enterprise Prologue. Your business is waiting for you!
row.short_description: Manage your own ice cream business to start a journey. Buy fruits, syrups and other ingredients to make ice cream. Add new setups to your business to sell milkshake, float, sundae. Research new flavors to attract more people and grow your enterprise.

row.name: Cats & Critters: A Dungeon Claw-er
row.detailed_description: 'Cats & Critters: A Dungeon Claw-er' is an enchanting party game that casts up to four players as cat wizards working together to defeat the evil dragon Frank and recover the golden yarn. This whimsical, pick-up-and-play experience captures the essence of miniature tabletop adventures with its simple controls and low-poly art style. Grab a few friends to help you defeat pesky critters, solve some puzzles, and earn magical loot. Along the way, use a variety of spells and collect the most sparkles to prove that you’re the coolest cat! Play solo or recruit up to three friends in local couch co-op! Explore an ever-changing archipelago with new layouts each time you play! Discover all 18 whimsical spells and cast them to defeat your enemies! Compete for sparkle points along your adventure to achieve the highest score! Customize your cat wizard with 19 fun accessories and tons of possibilities! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Adventure and cast spells with up to three friends in this local co-op, cat-themed dungeon crawler! Explore a coastal forest filled with enemies and loot, and use a variety of unique abilities to tackle challenges as you journey to retrieve the Golden Yarn.

row.name: The Meowfficer
row.detailed_description: War has broken out between Cat Kingdom and Dogland. In Meowville, a city near the border between the two powers, you are a mere lieutenant in the police force. With tensions between dogs and cats in the city at an all-time high, however, you will be forced to make moral decisions, fight for survival, and save the city.
row.short_description: In this top-down single-player pixelated RPG, you play as a cat in the police force, talking with your allies, fighting in intense gun fights, unraveling the lore, and making moral decisions.
row.notes: Depicts pixelated violence and gore, touches on themes of police brutality and discrimination/racism

row.name: DUNGEON OF LOVE: Catch Monsters
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Dungeon of Love! Ready to dive into dungeons filled with danger, excitement, and… your next romantic date? In this world, every battle can change your destiny because the monsters you capture won't just join your team—they might become your dream partner! Explore Dungeons and Capture Hearts Face wild creatures, but don't underestimate them—once captured, they reveal their true form: magical girls with personalities as unique as they are irresistible! The shy sorceress? The bold warrior? Choose wisely whom you charm, as each one has much more than meets the eye. Build the Refuge of Your Dreams When you're not fighting (or flirting), focus on upgrading your base. Train, sharpen your skills, and earn money to gear up for your adventures. Remember, even the best adventurer needs a cozy spot to relax and… socialize! Discover Their Secrets (and Perhaps Their Hearts) Every girl has her story, her preferences, and her special moments with you. Talk to them, get to know them better, go on romantic dates, and unlock unique rewards in your gallery as you grow closer to them in ways you never imagined. Key Features: Breathtaking Turn-Based Action: Strategic combat with a seductive twist. A Charming Cast: From the sweet girl next door to the mysterious rebel, there's someone for every taste! Management and Customization: Turn your refuge into a place worthy of a hero and their conquests. Art That Captivates: Every character and dungeon is designed to delight your eyes and your heart. In Dungeon of Love , the adventure doesn't end when you defeat the final boss… that's when the real fun begins! Explore, conquer, and discover who will become your next great romance. Are you ready to enter?
row.short_description: Capture monsters, discover their human form, and fall in love with a unique cast of girls while exploring dangerous dungeons. Love has never been this adventurous!
row.notes: Mature character outfits

row.name: I'm Pregnant at 16
row.detailed_description: I'm pregnant at 16 — A visual novel about tough choices and their consequences. This story will guide you through the heroine's experiences, her search for meaning, and her attempts to find her place in the world. Complex relationships with family, friends, and her first boyfriend force her to make important decisions that will shape her future. In this visual novel, you will lead the heroine through moments of joy and despair, through mistakes and redemption. Make choices that will affect her life, her relationships, and how she shapes her future. Game Features: Deep Characters: Explore the heroine's relationships with her loved ones, friends, and her first boyfriend. Uncover their hidden motives and feelings. Emotional Story: The game touches on difficult topics such as love, responsibility, social pressure, and personal experiences. Serious Themes: Issues like abortion, teenage pregnancy, and coming of age are not just plot points—they are essential to understanding choice and self-identity. Humor: Inner monologues, memes, chats, and awkward situations add some levity to the tense moments. Follow the heroine's journey to the end and discover the consequences of her decisions. The backgrounds and music in the game are partially AI-generated. This allowed us to release the project for free. The characters, story, and script were created by real people. Recommended Age Rating: 16+. By downloading the game, you confirm that you are aware of the recommended age rating.
row.short_description: 'I'm Pregnant at 16' is a visual novel about tough choices, growing up, and navigating relationships during an unexpected pregnancy. Personal stories and the consequences of decisions are balanced with awkward moments, chat messages, inner thoughts, and memes.
row.notes: The game contains minimal textual descriptions of intimate relationships without detailed scenes. It includes occasional strong language and mentions teenage pregnancy, including discussions about the possibility of abortion.

row.name: SSR Summoners
row.detailed_description: SSR Summoners is a turnbased combat online idle fantasy RPG, featuring the Gacha system, allowing players to summon powerful heroes and rare characters to build their ultimate team. Set in a rich, fantasy world, the game combines strategic gameplay with an engaging storyline, offering both offline and online progression. The Gacha system enhances the experience, providing a constant stream of new characters to collect and upgrade. With its blend of immersive combat, captivating quests, and idle mechanics, SSR Summoners delivers a rewarding experience for all types of players. Summon and Unleash the Power of SSR Heroes Embark on Epic Quests and Challenges Build and Dominate with Strategic Formations Unite in Guild Battles
row.short_description: SSR Summoners is a turnbased combat online idle fantasy RPG, featuring the Gacha system, allowing players to summon powerful heroes and rare characters to build their ultimate team.

row.name: Sound of Survival
row.detailed_description: Fight and survive to the beat against various robots that want to bring you down. Improve yourself each round to face the boss in the final showdown. Sound of Survival is a rhythm shooter with Vampire Survivors elements, offering multiple unlockable levels and difficulty modes. Gameplay Fight against the onslaught of machines in each round. Shoot in sync with the music using the different modes of your weapon to optimally take down various enemies. After each round, you can individually upgrade yourself and your weapon in the shop menu to perform better next round. Choose a suitable song and begin the upcoming round. Shoot on the beat Shoot, jump, and dash perfect to the beat to increase your damage, leaving your enemies with no chance. You can choose from a variety of songs composed specifically for this game. Each song has a unique speed and duration, helping you find the track that best fits your playstyle. Metaprogression After each playthrough, you have the opportunity to further upgrade yourself, your weapon, or the shop to perform even better in the next level. Defeat the boss to unlock additional levels or difficulty modes and prove that you have the best sense of rhythm.
row.short_description: Sound of Survival is a rhythm ego shooter where you have to shoot on the beat. Fight in a cyberpunk City against hordes of robots while you groove to the music. Shoot and hit on the beat to get stronger!

row.name: Museums of History
row.detailed_description: Step into a world where art, history, and exploration come alive through an immersive, multiplayer experience. 'Museums of History' lets you and fellow explorers from across the globe visit meticulously recreated museums, interact with historical artifacts, and share insights in real-time—all from the comfort of your own home. Key Features: Immersive Museum Environments Explore vast museum environments, each featuring beautifully detailed galleries. View famous paintings, rare artifacts, and cutting-edge interactive exhibits. Travel through time as you explore ancient civilizations, modern masterpieces, and hidden treasures. Multiplayer Adventure Connect with friends and players from around the world. Work together to uncover secrets, discuss your favorite exhibits, and collaborate in solving museum-wide puzzles. With multiplayer support, every visit is a shared adventure. Voice Chat Integration Enhance your experience with real-time voice chat. Engage in discussions with other players as you explore exhibits, exchange thoughts on the art, or dive into a shared passion for history. Voice chat brings a personal touch to your multiplayer museum visits. Interactive Exhibits Engage with interactive exhibits like never before. Solve ancient riddles, discover hidden passages, and unlock the mysteries behind iconic works of art. Your interactions can shape the course of your visit, making every experience unique. Player Profiles as Passports Track your journey with custom player profiles designed as passports. As you visit different museums within the game, your passport will earn stamps to show which exhibitions you’ve explored. Share your collection of stamps with friends and see where they've ventured in the virtual museum world. Article and Content Comment System After exploring an exhibit or artifact, leave a comment for others to see. Share your thoughts, interpretations, or even fun facts you've discovered. Read and interact with other players' comments on the museum’s art and exhibits, fostering a sense of community and collaboration. Avatar Selection and Customization Personalize your museum experience by choosing a custom avatar. Select from a wide array of styles and outfits to represent your identity. Your avatar will be synced across all multiplayer sessions, allowing others to recognize and engage with you easily. Achievements and Badges Earn achievements and collectible badges by completing specific challenges within the game. Whether you solve a particularly tough puzzle, complete an entire museum, or uncover hidden artifacts, there’s always a new badge to earn.
row.short_description: Explore history like never before in Museums of History! Customize your avatar, solve puzzles, collect virtual passport stamps, and connect with players worldwide in this immersive multiplayer adventure.
row.notes: Museums of History is an educational game that explores significant historical events. The game includes depictions of historical violence, such as wars and revolutions, and mature themes, including suffering and oppression, presented for educational purposes. Some visuals may include distressing imagery, such as representations of historical tragedies, but these are intended to provide an accurate understanding of history. Viewer discretion is advised.

row.name: OmOneko
row.detailed_description: When our main character finds himself as the owner of three nekos – cat girls – his quiet world is suddenly beset with the conjoined problems that having three cats and girls in the house can bring. Overcoming both everyday and not-so-common difficulties, will our main character finally find peace and stability again—and maybe something more? OmOneko is a bishoujo-style game made by fans like you. It uses a text and sprite-based visual novel model with a NVL styled text box. This game was inspired by other passion projects such as  Katawa Shoujo  and  Doki Doki Literature Club ; since those games are free, so is this one! A unique and more cinematic presentation of the choice-driven Visual Novel medium. Three unique routes and ten possible endings. An engaging tale told by unusual characters containing over 260,000 words. Several deep and nuanced stand-alone stories woven together means 20+ hours of story-rich gaming. Original soundtrack of more than 50 songs and variations. Several hundred environmental and character images, and over 200 backgrounds. No AI was used in the making of this game. Extras area including a “Library” to view all manga, graphic novels, and comics that you unlock along the way, including: SinKitty, Nyako Maids, Red Rocket, Cat’n a Rat, and more!
row.short_description: “A story about cat girls … with bite.” Nekos have evolved in the shadows of human society. Beautiful. Mysterious. Chaotic. And now, three of them live with you. Will you be able to get past the stigma and grow closer to them? OmOneko is a tale of cat and mouse... and rats.
row.notes: - Some (veiled) nudity / adult situations. - Infrequent depictions of injuries and blood, Infrequent jump-scares, Comic-book violence. - Mild to moderate "holding-hands" and tugging at heart-strings. - Mostly pleasant slice-of-life... if life had catgirls.

row.name: Beamdown
row.detailed_description: Beamdown is a 3D top-down action game featuring fast combat, upgrades, and difficult big bosses. Explore the different planet environments, take down large bosses, upgrade your character, and repeat. Beam down to each planet and conduct research for the Societias Philanthropia! Take on varying enemy types and combine your upgrades to create the ultimate kit! Players will play as E.R.O. 4, the Societias Philanthropia’s newest iteration of Research Operatives. Beam down to various planets on a research quest from the Societas Philanthropia! Discover new enemies and customize your abilities to become the ultimate killing machine! Players will play as E.R.O.4—the newest and shiniest research operative robot available—as they crush foes in their way. Fight and utterly decimate each planet’s guardian in the name of the SP! Experience unique and exciting combat scenarios with each boss—reaping bountiful rewards upon defeating them! Create the kit that works best for your own playstyle! E.R.O. 4 is a highly adaptable robot that comes with a refined selection of upgrades to use on its research journeys. You want to dash as much as possible, dive into danger and deliver devastating melee damage? You got it! Want to become lord of fire and burn everything in sight? That’s an option! The Societas Philanthropia has accounted for all your burning desires with the most innovative robot they’ve ever made. Explore different worlds as E.R.O. 4! Find different cultures and ways of life as you research planets for the Societias Philanthropia. Immerse yourself in the universe the Societias Philanthropia is creating, and discover their true intentions.
row.short_description: Beamdown is a 3D top-down hack&slash action game featuring fast combat, upgrades, and difficult big bosses. Explore the different planet environments, take down large bosses, upgrade your character, and repeat.

row.name: Vinyls

Spin your way through a world of rare finds, legendary albums, and a community that lives for the groove! 🛒 How to Play: Collect Vinyls – Open random drops every few hours. Trade & Upgrade – Use the Steam Marketplace to trade with other players. Build your dream collection. Discover Rarity – Every drop is a chance at Common, Rare, or Legendary vinyls. Show Your Style – Use your collection to unlock themed levels inspired by your records. row.short_description: Collect, trade, and showcase your virtual vinyl collection in Vinyls! Open random drops, score rare records, and trade with others on Steam.

row.name: Butterfly X
row.detailed_description: A free Butterfly X game featuring characters from all versions of the Butterfly series of puzzle games. You can choose any level to pass through. But it will be great if you pass them all, helping the caterpillar to fulfill its mission. As usual, the caterpillar can't jump on its own. row.name: Godwreath: Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: Godwreath: Chapter 1 is a top-down nonlinear survival horror game set in a prison in the fictional Balkan nation of Tetrania. Discover what lurks within the shadows of this unique world, filled with unsettling locations and characters. Features: Classic survival horror exploration without many of the common tropes and pitfalls of the horror genre, such as boring puzzles and cheap jump scares. Tense combat, with a unique system revolving around health and adrenaline stats that support each other. If you run out of health, you can miraculously survive off of any remaining adrenaline. If you run out of adrenaline, attacking instead drains your health (representing stress). Core gameplay mechanic: you must return to your cell before the end of each night, adding more tension to every journey you take into the darkness. An intricate narrative with complex characters and lore. Three different possible endings.
row.short_description: Godwreath: Chapter 1 is a top-down nonlinear survival horror game set in a prison in the fictional Balkan nation of Tetrania. Discover what lurks within the shadows of this unique world, filled with unsettling locations and characters.
row.notes: Violence between fictional pixel art characters. There is also one reference of suicide, but it is not depicted.

row.name: Cipheur
row.detailed_description: Letter by letter, word by word, sentence by sentence - the work of a cryptographer is far from easy. Luckily, we have you, our talented codebreaker! Take your place at the machine and confront diverse, highly intriguing encrypted messages, all requiring sharp thinking and cleverness to unravel. Step by Step At first, each message will seem like incomprehensible gibberish - convoluted, seemingly meaningless. However, nothing could be further from the truth! By deciphering subsequent letters and words, you will quickly find a pattern that will allow you to decipher the entire message. So much to discover! Uncovering a variety of quotes rich in humor, wisdom, or insight can be challenging, yet with 100 levels to complete you are sure to have enough room to hone your skills and become the true expert. Each new message grants a sense of satisfaction and an insight into the wisdom of the brightest people in history!  Nearly endless content Your decoding journey can continue almost endlessly, with Cipheur offering a rich supply of extra coded message packs. Test your wits against sets like Last Words, Proverbs, Stupid Laws, Uncommon Words and many more! All this wrapped in a pleasant, simple and concentration-friendly visual layout to help you work and relax. • 100 quotes by famous people - fun, witty or insightful - we have them all • 3 difficulty levels to allow you move forward in your own pace • Helpful hints system • Numerous achievements to unlock • An unusual gameplay focused solely on deciphering coded messages
row.short_description: Cipheur is a free cryptogram game, allowing you to test your logic and language skills against 100 quotes by famous people. Do your best to discover intriguing patterns, unfold the coded messages step by step, and enjoy the incomparable satisfaction of deciphering another sentence.

row.name: Blight's Grasp
row.detailed_description: Carve a path through this planet: Battle your way through a variety of environments, and fix broken down portals using power cores you find in the environment. With your grit, wits, and some elbow grease you’ll overcome and overpower any obstacle in your way. String together your on unique attacks: In Blights Grasp you can mix and match your different fighting styles with the alien elements you can harness, creating a variety of effects and combinations. The act of mixing these elements and styles is quick, allowing for on the fly moves and strategies.  Features: A 3rd Person Action Game centering on melee combat. Use your ranged attack to extend combos and hit far away enemies. Collect power cores to buy power ups and fix portals. Navigate environments using your jumps and dashes. Switch between different fighting styles and elements using the radial menu.
row.short_description: Explore a foreign planet on a journey to find your lost sister and a cure for this corrupted world. Fight through waves of enemies using a combination of this world's elements. Will you be able to piece together a solution or will it already be too late?
row.notes: Blights Grasp contains cartoon and fantasy violence within it's combat encounters. Contains a gamey and cartoonish depiction of violent acts such as punching with vibrant colorful effects and the use of spells and magic to make attacks stronger.

Now, you must rebuild your army from scratch, lead your troops into battle, experience the true thrill of war, where every punch lands and every strike bleeds, and feel the shock of massive army confrontations! row.name: Liquor Store Simulator: Prologue

You start your business in a small shop that you bought on credit. At first, it won’t be easy—you’ll have to work the cash register yourself, accept deliveries, keep track of inventory, and maintain order in the sales area. But hard work and smart decisions will help you turn this modest store into a thriving business with a wide selection of products and satisfied customers. row.name: Pip Puzzle: Pip and Ooma's Battle
row.detailed_description: Unleash Your Puzzle Mastery in Pip Puzzle: Pip and Ooma's Battle! Dive into a world where strategy meets chaos! Harness the unique skills of each character to dominate the board: Net gems and relocate them for the ultimate setup. Smash through layers of gems with brute force. Crush your opponents' gems by strategically dropping balls on them. Or, for the mischievous mind, torment your opponent by turning their gems black and white, sending their strategy into disarray! Choose your path, master the chaos, and outwit your foes. The choice is yours in Pip Puzzle: Pip and Ooma's Battle! Ready to play like never before? Step into a world where every stage is a new spectacle! As you solve puzzles watch the icy excavation site melt into a sea of lava with visuals and sounds heating up the challenge. Navigate through a dystopian Tokyo where the fog grows thicker, the music somber, and the puzzles more enigmatic. Explore a scrapyard in the vastness of space, where the silence of the cosmos is broken by clanking metal, and the stage itself comes alive with each move. Choose your favorite character, from a bad-mannered witch with even worse-mannered hair, to an amnesic explorer full of grit.
row.short_description: Pip Puzzle is an action puzzle gem game where you flood your opponent’s side with gems by smashing your own gems. Fight through Arcade, or play online against your friends. Find a character with a unique skill that best fits your play style, and battle through stages that evolve while you play!

row.name: By Bait or By Bullet
row.detailed_description: By Bait or By Bullet  is a bombastic 2D fishing rogue-lite adventure with both story-rich top-down exploration and action-packed platforming combat, made with Unity and available on Windows and through WebGL! The Rock Beyond Reality - Converse with the curious collection of characters who have been dragged beyond reality as you gear up for your next tentacular tussle. These odd bedfellows have stories aplenty, and more importantly, they’re willing to part with some valuable gear in the hope that you’ll be the one to defeat the sea beast once and for all. Fishing Dock - Play a fishing minigame to buoy your battling power and collect fish from the strangest ocean this side of nonexistence. Time your casts and reels with the mouse to maximize your menagerie of munitions! Maelstrom - Dive into battle against 3 fearsome limbs of a great interdimensional octopus! Use your mouse and keyboard to give Contra and Cuphead a run for their quarters in frenetic 2D run n’ gun boss battle mania as you jump and dash your way to victory (or usually, defeat). By Bait or By Bullet does not feature any controls/input configuration. HUB WASD to move around, and press E to interact with NPCs and buy items. FISHING Use the left mouse button to select your bait on the BAIT LOADOUT screen. You can also click on bait you've already chosen to get rid of it. On the FISHING screen, press the left mouse button to cast your line. To reel your line in, press the left mouse button when the reel prompt appears. To get a better catch, reel in your line when the circle shrinks into the green! COMBAT Use the mouse position to aim your gun, and the left mouse button to fire. Use A and D to move left and right, and LEFT SHIFT to dash left or right. Use the space bar to jump; hold the space bar down to jump higher. If you have multiple weapons, use TAB to switch between them. AUDIO Music and SFX volume sliders DIFFICULTY In Options -> Gameplay there is an assist mode heading that includes Invincibility: Toggle this on and take no damage when hit. +1000 shells button: Shells are the currency used to buy permanent upgrades. Press this each time you want a 1000 shell boost to your buying balance. You can use this to buy upgrades a little earlier, get practically infinite shells, or anything in between. In the Hub/The Rock Beyond Reality right before the dock: Press E to pick up Skipper: Skipper will float around close to the player and constantly shoot at the boss, damaging it. Press E in the same spot if you'd like to disable this feature. Press E to pick up the alternate bobber: The bobber makes the fishing section more lenient. It lengthens the 'Perfect!' window of the reeling/caught portion, and it widens the optimal landing area for the bobber. The probability of getting junk is also passively lowered. Practically, this means more shells and more useful items in combat. Press E in the same spot if you'd like to disable this feature. VIDEO Gameplay brightness + saturation sliders (Disclaimer: These features were not fully implemented. We did not remove it in hopes that this limited version can still help those who need/prefer it. These settings don't apply to UI elements.) There are, to our knowledge, currently no actions the player can take that crash the game. You can enter combat without a weapon equipped, making it impossible to deal damage. In the full game, the current plan is to force the player to take the starter gun (Rotten Salmon) with them every time they fight.
row.short_description: By Bait or By Bullet is a bombastic 2D fishing rogue-lite adventure with both story-rich top-down exploration and action-packed platforming combat, made with Unity and available on Windows and through WebGL!

row.name: Maiden And Lord
row.detailed_description: Game gift package: tm-123，tm-222，tm-456，tm-666，tm-789 Customer service email: wangquan0630@outlook.com Contact customer service to receive the gift package (Contains skin roll，note: Maiden And Lord when contacting customer service) 'Maiden And Lord' is a relatively casual strategy war game that emphasizes player cooperation and the development of civilizations. It introduces innovative mechanisms such as 'Private Territory' and 'Safe Gathering,' creating a prosperous and harmonious otherworldly realm. ------- This is a strategy war game that breaks away from the endless conflicts between players in traditional strategy games! Instead, it focuses on cooperation and civilization development. The game seamlessly combines elements of strategy warfare, card-based hero development, simulation management, and team adventures. It also introduces groundbreaking city-building mechanics based on 'Prosperity' and 'Civilization' while implementing unique features like 'Private Territory' and 'Safe Gathering.' Players can even dispatch caravans to transport goods across continents, fostering prosperity and harmonious growth together! [Exclusive Territory, Safe Gathering] In a crumbling otherworld, you take on the role of a lord who has crossed dimensions to restore the world and become a candidate for the throne. You will gain a private territory where you can collect resources, develop agriculture and industry without fear of interference from other players. Focus on building your own capital city and creating a peaceful, prosperous new world! [Develop Civilization, Build a Homeland] Say goodbye to the combat power-focused traditional model. This game takes 'Civilization' and 'Prosperity' as its core principles of development. By spreading civilization and fostering friendly cooperation, you can advance city development and make your nation flourish. The fire of civilization will illuminate every corner, forging a wealthy and harmonious new world. [Wilderness Adventures, Mysterious Exploration] In an otherworldly land full of unknowns and dangers, areas beyond the city walls are teeming with monsters and secrets waiting to be challenged. Defeating barbarians is essential! You will lead your team into the wilderness to challenge powerful monsters and unlock unique terrain zones such as deserts, forests, snowfields, and swamps. During exploration, you will discover rich treasures and rescue trapped soldiers. [Wilderness Trials, Treasure Hunts] The spirit of adventure never dies! The game introduces 'Wilderness Map,' 'Ruins Dungeon,' and 'Divine Domon Trials' modes. As your city develops, you will unlock challenges of increasing difficulty. In Ruins Dungeon and Divine Trials, team up with friends to face unknown dangers, overcome countless challenges, and uncover lost treasures. [Thrilling Competition, Peak Battles] Participate in diverse competitive modes such as 'Arena,' 'Ladder Tournament,' and 'Tournament,' where you’ll engage in intense battles against lords from all over. Showcase your strategy and skill to claim championship glory and earn exclusive rewards! [Hero Development, Missions Together] With three major races and numerous heroes, each hero possesses unique skills and missions to help you defeat monsters and protect your homeland. Dispatch heroes to collect abundant rewards. They will be your most loyal companions on this otherworldly journey, assisting you in seizing the crown. [Territory Conquest, Dominate the Continent] Six regions and 36 cities await, each guarded by legendary lords. Players must utilize strategy and collaboration to gradually conquer cities, expand territories, and ultimately rise as the ruler of this otherworldly realm, crafting a legendary tale of their own!
row.short_description: 'Maiden And Lord' is a relatively casual strategy war game that emphasizes player cooperation and the development of civilizations. It introduces innovative mechanisms such as 'Private Territory' and 'Safe Gathering,' creating a prosperous and harmonious otherworldly realm.

row.name: 皇上驾到
row.detailed_description: I. Game background In the game 'Your Majesty's Arrival', players will travel back to ancient times and become emperors. The game constructs a huge and detailed ancient world with rich historical and cultural background, a complete map of the ancient world, and every scene from the majestic court to the beautiful harem is vivid. When players ascend the throne, they will be at peace in a corner, where the world is divided and the situation is complex and changeable. There are various forces fighting inside and strong enemies watching outside. They need to govern the country with wisdom and strategy, and create their own prosperous dynasty. II. Gameplay Political Handling: Players need to personally attend the court to handle various political matters. From the appointment and removal of officials, local construction, tax adjustments, to military expeditions, diplomatic decisions, etc., all need to be weighed one by one. Reasonable selection of talents and appointment of capable officials can improve the efficiency of national governance; formulating appropriate tax policies can ensure the abundance of the national treasury; and in terms of diplomacy, various means of cooperation and cooperation should be flexibly used to continuously expand territory. The management of the harem: The emperor's harem cannot be ignored. Players need to deal with the relationships between the concubines in the harem, as different concubines have unique personalities and skills. At the same time, as the emperor, they also need to shoulder the responsibility of inheriting offspring, giving birth to and cultivating princes and princesses, marrying with the offspring of other players, and getting married or enfeoffed when they grow up. The prince will play an important role in the prosperity of the empire. City Construction: Players need to plan the construction of the capital and various cities, and cannot neglect all aspects of agriculture, commerce, and industry. Agricultural facilities can be built to ensure food supply, workshops can be built to promote the development of handicrafts, and commercial facilities can be built to increase trade income. At the same time, attention should be paid to infrastructure building such as urban security to enhance the prosperity and stability of the city. Military War: Building a strong army is the key to defending the country. Players need to recruit soldiers, assemble the army, appoint commanders and generals, and enhance the combat effectiveness of the army. Reasonably allocate the army, formulate strategies, unify the Central Plains, conquer neighboring countries, and expand territory. III. Game features and objectives This is a fully 3D highly immersive emperor simulation game. The game simulates the emperor's experience of managing and governing the country, using strategies and management methods to continuously develop. The goal is to unify the Central Plains, continuously expand territory while also taking into account the governance and development of the territory, and strive to create a prosperous empire.
row.short_description: A high-simulation emperor simulation game with a real game timeline. From the first perspective of the simulated emperor's accession to the throne, he governs the government, manages officials and concubines, raises children, conquers the world, and experiences the life of an emperor.

row.name: Aura Kingdom - Impact

Featuring a passionate anime style, stunning characters, and elements of fantastical adventure. Players will experience the brand-new class 'Floating Cannon,' along with innovative gameplay such as Eidolon Inlay and free weapon switching, delivering an unparalleled adventure experience. row.short_description: [Aura Kingdom: Impact] is an anime-style fantasy MMORPG. Explore a vast world, fight with dynamic skills, and switch classes freely. Summon Eidolons to aid in battle. Try the new Floating Cannon class with powerful ranged combos and seamless skill use.

row.name: Stagees - Just Play !
row.detailed_description: Stagees is currently free and in Beta, and we are keen to get feedback and development ideas from users / testers !, for more details please check out the early access section. Experience music in a fantastic new way ! Play any song in the world with 2-6 buttons. Choose an instrument and join your favorite band by yourself or together with friends.  Use the buttons S, D, F, J, K, L in single-play to 'catch' the notes as in a traditional rhythm game, but this time you are providing the sounds and playing side by side with your dearest artists. Correct player buttons for multi-play can be found under the FAQ section on the Stagees www homepage. For tutorials and other playing examples please watch the Stagees Youtube channel. Although Stagees is a game-like music playing platform it includes some great educational elements. Go for it, challenge yourself and truly enjoy music like you never thought was possible. Practice a bit and start to improve your personal best in single-play and be amazed how fun it is to play music with friends using Co-op multi-play. Examples of users who will most likely find joy in using the platform:                            Persons who enjoy playing music games Persons who have a general interest in music or are involved in music somehow Persons who would like to learn and understand music further Person who might be restricted to play traditional instrument for instance due to an injury Persons who like to share or gather music experiences Persons who would like to play in a band Persons who know how to make music but do not play any traditional instruments Persons who would like to learn to make music Persons who would like to get inspired to try out other music instruments Persons who have ever dreamed of becoming something in music No previous musical background required, go ahead and Just Play !
row.short_description: Stagees is an interactive music platform where the user experience will be a “short cut” to music playing and gives an instant feel of being able to play the sounds for any song in the world, simply by using only a few buttons. Try out the included songs, import own songs, or check out the Store.

row.name: Relic Hunt
row.detailed_description: Relic Hunt is an exciting clicker game where every click earns coins and offers a chance to obtain valuable items necessary for collection sets. As you progress and achieve new milestones, the collections unlock unique features and enhance your stats. The game also includes mini-games, such as poker, where players can compete against each other by betting their earned coins. Collect sets, participate in mini-games, and expand your collection of unique items!
row.short_description: Relic Hunt is an exciting clicker game where each click earns coins and gives you a chance to obtain rare items for your collection. Gather unique artifacts, participate in mini-games, including poker!

row.name: Cubey Quarry
row.detailed_description: Cubey Quarry is a clicker/idle game about building up a quarry, you can either invest clicks in long term using the drill or grinder, or get some quick and fast action with using your pickaxe and smelter, with all of these tools combined you can optimise your time and build up your own quarry as quickly as possible. You can join with up to 3 other people (1-4 players) making things go a little faster, and it never hurts to share your progress
row.short_description: Mine ores, smelt or grind, get money, build your quarry and repeat.In this small free to play game you slowly build up a quarry, either with your friends or by yourself, it's a perfect game to have running in the background and checking up on every once in a while.

row.name: Vast Haven-1 VR
row.detailed_description: Step into Haven-1, the world’s first commercial space station. Built by Vast in Long Beach, California, Haven-1 is a next-generation space station, home to an innovation lab for both private astronauts and government missions. In this journey, you’ll be guided by NASA Veteran Astronaut and Vast Lead Astronaut Andrew Feustel as you unlock the hatch to enter Haven-1, navigating your way through its corridor to explore the interior of the space station. Explore and interact with crew storage areas, the common area, the ergonomic crew quarters, and payloads in the Haven-1 Lab. Enjoy an expansive, 180-degree view of Earth through the domed window, and experience the overview effect like a real astronaut. Discover the future of space habitation from the point of view of an astronaut and experience life aboard Haven-1, where innovation meets the cosmos.
row.short_description: Step into Haven-1, the world's first commercial space station. Unlock its hatch to navigate through the interior of the station, where you can interact with the storage area, the crew quarters, the Haven-1 Lab, and a stunning, 180-degree view of Earth.

row.name: Hopeguard
row.detailed_description: Your order of knights has been slaying dragons for generations. Now, only the Queen remains and you have been chosen to eradicate her. However, at the peak of the sacred forge, the confrontation will not go as expected… Hopeguard is a third-person dark fantasy game centered on the themes of loss and acceptance. Journey through caves, ruins and forests to solve environmental puzzles and fulfill your quest—but with a new perspective. YOUR CORNERED NEMESIS As the last of her kind, the Dragon Queen fights with the desperation of a dying breed. Could it be that she resists so fiercely to protect something precious? WITNESS THE REMNANTS OF WAR The Hopeguard knights have paid a heavy price in their ancestral hunt. Finding an alternative path through the ruins won’t always be easy. MY FAITHFUL SHIELD! You are trained to survive and your shield has saved your life countless times. THE SACRED CRYSTALS GUIDE THE WAY Ancient, dormant magical mechanisms can be reactivated, but they will clearly need to be realigned.
row.short_description: Hopeguard is a third-person dark fantasy game about loss and acceptance. You have been chosen to eliminate the Dragon Queen, but the confrontation will not go as expected. Journey through caves, ruins, and forests to solve environmental puzzles and fulfill your quest -but with a new perspective.

row.name: All Abug!
row.detailed_description: All Abug! is an adventure in a larger than life setting. Embody a lizard with its caterpillar friend by its side in a cartoony environment as you seek asylum from the Great Dusting. Although seemingly dark, this game will make you blow some air out of your nose with its silly humour. GOBBLE UP EVERYTHING ON YOUR PATH From plants to enemies, use your super long lizard tongue to gobble up different resources at your disposal and use them to your advantage. Feed your caterpillar, destroy obstacles and grapple to new heights with your all-in-one tongue! ACCOMPANY A GIANT CATERPILLAR In the face of danger, leave no insect behind. As your caterpillar friend advances along the path, remove obstacles that block its way and defend it from infected enemies that try to stop you. Feed it resources that cross your path to use its special abilities like a SUPER HOT FIRE BREATH ! BOARD PASSENGERS An unforgettable journey surrounded by insects with unique personalities seeking shelter from the apocalypse. After meeting at the stations, they will board your caterpillar and journey with you to safety, commenting about the events around them. Learn more about this larger than life world through the eyes of its citizens.
row.short_description: Faced with the threat of a wave of toxic fumes, embark on an expedition to save yourself from certain death. Gobble up obstacles on your path to allow your caterpillar to move along and board survivors who also seek asylum!

row.name: Highrise
row.detailed_description: WELCOME TO HIGHRISE – YOUR VIRTUAL HOME ON THE INTERNET Step into Highrise, the ultimate social playground where you can connect, play, and express your digital self. Whether you're here to make new friends, build amazing spaces, or show off your unique style, you'll be joining a thriving community of over 50 million people exploring a world of endless possibilities. CONNECT THROUGH PLAY Immerse yourself in a vibrant online universe with millions of users. Instantly join thousands of interactive rooms for gaming, casual chats, or unforgettable events. Chat in real-time via messages or voice and forge meaningful connections. Compete in weekly events to win exclusive outfits and rewards. Enjoy a safe and welcoming environment, supported by our world-class moderation team. EXPRESS YOURSELF, YOUR WAY Design a one-of-a-kind avatar that reflects your personality and style. Customize your profile with a unique background, bio, and favorite items showcase. Share your thoughts, experiences, and creativity through text, images, or videos on the Feed. Bring your artistic vision to life by designing new items in community contests. Build and decorate virtual rooms to create the perfect hangout for you and your friends. FOR THE COLLECTORS & TRADERS Discover a treasure trove of 50,000+ collectible items , with fresh drops every week. Buy, sell, and trade in the player-run marketplace to level up your outfit and earn profits. Spot an outfit you love? Inspect, trade, and negotiate directly from the Inbox. Keep track of must-have items with your personal Wishlist. Use advanced filters and categories to find exactly what you're looking for in seconds. Your Highrise adventure starts now. Step into a world where creativity knows no limits and every interaction is a new possibility. Are you ready? 🚀
row.short_description: Highrise is your virtual home, where over 50 million users connect, play, and express their digital selves. Create a unique avatar, design custom spaces, and join vibrant communities for gaming, chatting, and events. With creativity, and a thriving community, Highrise offers endless possibilities.
row.notes: Highrise features an open social community where players can engage in freeform conversation. Some discussions may touch on sensitive or mature themes. Cosmetic items in the game may include avatars wearing bikinis or shirtless male appearances, but full cartoon nudity is never allowed. Players may use mild profanity in chat as long as it is not directed at others in an abusive or harassing manner. Violence in Highrise is lighthearted and cartoonish, often shown through exaggerated animations, whimsical effects, or stylized comic visuals rather than realistic depictions. References to smoking or drinking may appear indirectly through collectible items or community discussions, but illegal activity is not permitted or endorsed.

row.name: Good Lord! Everyone at the Reunion For My Religious All-Girls School Is a Trans Man... And They're Hot?!
row.detailed_description: It's been 10 years since you graduated from a private Christian all-girls high school, and you decided to head to the unofficial reunion hosted by your old bestie. It's a weekend retreat at a fancy vineyard you photograph happy couples at all the time, but when you get there... You're the only cis woman who was invited?! And everyone you went to school with is a hot guy now?? ~~~ Good Lord! Everyone at the Reunion For My Religious All-Girls School Is a Trans Man... And They're Hot?! (or Trans Masc Reunion for short) is a romantic comedy otome game featuring a cast of all trans masculine love interests. Catch up with your old graduating class and maybe learn a thing or two about yourself in a hilarious weekend romp at a posh vineyard. What could possibly go wrong? Features 3 Trans Masc Love Interests All Happy Endings! Original OST Original Character Art Playable Wordcount: 30k+ Goose. Your Love Interests Elias delos Santos the Party Host Pronouns: he/him  Ethnicity: Filipino American Occupation: Wedding & Events Coordinator Your high school bestie, a social media hound, and just about the only person you kept in touch with from high school all these years. He came out to you 9 years ago and has been the singular queer person you personally know (or at least, that's what you thought). You're not sure if you've ever met anyone as simultaneously chill and stressed out as Elias is, but hopefully he can relax this weekend. Angel Devin the Withdrawn Metalhead Pronouns: xe/xem/xir, he/him Ethnicity: African American Occupation: Farming Co-Op Organizer Voted 'Most Likely To Be Possessed By Demons' by the class, Angel used to be the weird outcast whose metal music you could hear from xir earbuds while passing by. Xe has a tendency to wander away from large crowds, but you attribute that to xem being more shy than misanthropic. Honestly, what concerns you more is the fact that no one seems bothered by Angel going off by xir lonesome. Liam Goodwin aka LuciferSatan69420 Pronouns: he/him Ethnicity: Caucasian American Occupation: Social Media Influencer A former Christian cheerleader who preached and practiced 'Modest is Hottest.' In the last two years however he’s made a full 180° to “All Skin, All Sin.” He takes immense pride in the video series that turned him into a star, “ASMR I’m Your Mean Boyfriend.” Will you finally have the chance to get some revenge on Liam this weekend?
row.short_description: Are you really the only woman at the ten year reunion for your religious all-girls high school?! Catch up with your old graduating class and maybe learn a thing or two about yourself in a hilarious weekend romp at a posh vineyard. What could possibly go wrong?
row.notes: Certain scenarios in the game involve sexual tension between adults, including intimate situations and heavy innuendo. No visual or textual depictions of sexual content are included in the game.

row.name: PolyCore
row.detailed_description: Polycore A 2D pixel-art platformer with a geometric twist. You are Polycore, a sentient 12-sided interdimensional being, peacefully orbiting a strange, colorful planet—until a mysterious spaceship blasts you out of the sky. Crashing into the planet’s core, you're shattered, reduced to a mere triangle. Your mission: rebuild yourself, piece by piece, and seek revenge. Climb. Collect. Conquer. Begin your journey in the crater you created. Every jump challenges your agility and your mind, as you hunt down your lost sides, each one reshaping your form. As you evolve from triangle to square to dodecagon, your thirst for vengeance increases exponentially. Features: Dynamic shape-shifting mechanics Smooth, responsive platforming built for precision and experimentation Epic finale: Reclaim your full form, return to orbit, and bring the battle back to the stars Will you reclaim your sides and your strength? Or stay shattered forever? The Polycore, an eldritch being of shape and form. The silent fractal adventuerer explores the reaches of deep space, orbiting an unknown planet. Suddenly, as it searches for more shapes, it is knocked into the atmosphere by a ship of intruders warping in. Falling through the surface of the planet, it finds it has lost form and must regain its shape. Trapped within the depths of unfamiliar ruins, with only one way out! Will you help the Polycore utilize and build back its geometry and escape back into the void?
row.short_description: Certainly not another rage platformer.

row.name: 帝天之战
row.detailed_description: 《帝天之战》重大更新公告 亲爱的勇士们 ： 自上次因重大BUG紧急维护后，经过数月的潜心修复与优化，我们终于带着 史诗级更新 回归！此次更新不仅彻底解决了 装备属性异常、地图加载崩溃、BOSS刷新机制错乱 等核心问题，更新增了 超多硬核玩法 与 平民福利 ，真正实现 “散人吊打土豪，小怪爆终极” 的江湖盛况！ 一、重大BUG修复：江湖秩序全面重整 装备系统稳定化 彻底修复 “嗜血词条吸血效果叠加异常” 的漏洞，现改为 全身嗜血词条数量达标时触发“血魔狂暴” （3词条：吸血+10%；7词条：吸血+30%且每秒回复1%生命）。 修正 “三大陆BOSS专属装备属性丢失” 的问题，共工、祝融等BOSS掉落的专属装备现可稳定激活 “元素撕裂”“神力灌注” 等特效。 地图与任务机制优化 解封 “泣血洞窟” 成就称号的隐藏触发条件，现完成洞窟内所有精英怪击杀即可100%获得称号。 修复 “二大陆运势占卜” 卡顿导致无法获取顶级会员的BUG，现每日可免费占卜3次，必出 “天运至尊” 会员（持续24小时）。 战斗平衡性调整 削弱 “土豪玩家专属光环” 的爆率加成，改为 全服共享爆率提升 （根据在线人数动态调整，散人玩家收益更高）。 增强 “切割系统” 的基础攻速，现所有玩家起步即可享受 “刀刀烈火” 的畅快体验。 二、全新玩法：硬核江湖，智者为王 “专属鉴定2.0”系统上线 新增 “词条孔位融合” 机制：低级装备可拆解为【词条碎片】，用于在高级装备上额外开孔（最多额外开3孔）。 引入 “元素共鸣” 特效：当全身装备携带同类型元素（如火焰、冰冻）达到5件时，触发 “元素风暴” （范围伤害+减速）。 “三大陆·混沌秘境” 开放 全新地图 “龙炎界·深渊” ：怪物掉落【天龙震荡波·改】（范围扩大50%，撕裂效果持续时间翻倍）。 隐藏BOSS “虫巢母皇” ：击败后必掉【暗行撕裂爪·极】（百分比切割+吸血双特效，散人神器）。 “跨服散人争霸赛” 开启 每周六20:00开启，所有玩家 零门槛参与 ，通过击杀怪物积累积分兑换 “散人至尊” 限定称号（攻击+500，爆率+20%）。 赛事奖励新增 “自选专属装备箱” ，可任选三大陆任意BOSS专属装备（含共工、祝融等终极神器）。 三、平民福利大放送：零氪也能制霸全服 “七日变强计划”升级 完成每日任务即可领取 “灵元宝箱” （必出1000-5000灵元，可用于切割系统升级）。 累计登录7天赠送 “平民战神礼包” ：含【嗜血项链·初阶】（3词条嗜血）、【地首之御·碎片】×10（合成防麻痹装备）。 “幻羽幽莲”主线任务优化 新增 “自动导航” 功能，点击任务目标即可直接传送至对应地图，告别跑图烦恼。 任务奖励翻倍：完成二大陆主线任务额外赠送 “切割值+1000” 的永久BUFF。 “小怪爆终极”机制强化 三大陆普通怪物现在也有概率掉落 “宇宙力量”“精神力量” 等合成叁元力量的核心部件。 调整 “洛河夜魔坠” 的掉落范围：洛河区域所有怪物（包括小怪）均有机会掉落，防冰冻效果必备。 四、视觉与操作优化：沉浸式传奇体验 技能特效重制 “嗜血狂暴” 特效升级：触发时全身笼罩血色光芒，附带 “血雾弥漫” 范围伤害。 “天龙震荡波” 新增 “龙影穿梭” 动画，攻击轨迹更清晰，打击感拉满。 操作便捷性提升 新增 “一键鉴定” 功能：背包内所有专属装备可批量鉴定，节省大量时间。 优化 “悬赏任务” 界面：现在可同时接取5个任务，自动规划最优刷怪路线。 开发者寄语 ： “此次更新不仅是对BUG的彻底终结，更是我们对‘平民传奇’理念的深度践行。从词条融合系统到散人争霸赛，每一处设计都旨在让所有玩家——无论氪金与否——都能在这片江湖中找到属于自己的传奇！愿诸位勇士以智破敌，以勇称王，共书《帝天之战》的新篇章！” —《帝天之战》运营团队 敬上
row.short_description: 在《帝天之战》，我们撕碎了“氪金为王”的虚伪面具！这里没有碾压式的数值差距，只有“操作与智慧”的巅峰较量。专属装备全图爆、小怪掉落终极神器、散人吊打土豪不再是幻想！无论是朝九晚五的上班族，还是闲散独行的江湖客，都能在这片混沌大陆中，用实力书写属于自己的传奇！
