row.detailed_description: Chlorofell is an isometric action shooter focused on mastering quick thinking and manual reloading. You play as a soldier of nature’s wrath, and fight through a factory of environments where plants and technology collide, and squads of enemies coordinate to stop you. With a limited shield covering your fragile amount of health, you can be easily overwhelmed, but through mastering the speed of movement, manual reloading, and the specialized ammo you’ll find along the way, you just may make it all the way to the source of this scourge and have the chance to finish this fight. Tight movement and shooting in an isometric prospective 4 levels to fight your way though 3 special ammo types to discover and leverage Focus-encouraging gameplay with manual reloading and a reload combo system This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Master an arm cannon built from the scraps of your enemies, specialized ammo, and quick thinking, to tear your way to the heart of the mechanical scourge threatening your planet.

row.name: Cultivation Story: Infinite Sword Realm Playtest
Killer Chat! - Original Edition
row.detailed_description: After asking too many murder-related questions online (for your book), you get an invite to a... serial killer chatroom?!  What the...? Killer Chat! Original Edition brings the award-winning satirical serial killer dating chatsim you know and love to Steam ( Public Favorite & Honorable Mention, Spooktober Jam 2024 ). Play as a (customisable!) writer as you pretend to be a serial killer, get inspiration for your book, fall in love and try not to call the cops through a whirlwind six months with your murderous beau of choice. Who knows? You might find your happily ever after... or headline the news as a gruesomely lovesick corpse. It's honestly up to you.  SO YOU'RE A SERIAL KILLER. SUPPOSEDLY. A reporter by day, an aspiring writer by night: you've been asking all the important questions on the dark web.  Like, how do you bury a body? How do you kill someone with a crowbar with the right angle to cause blunt-force trauma? What's the best way to hide from law enforcement? If you're to write a good crime book, this is how you'll do it. Suddenly, ERROR! UNKNOWN  invites you to a server... with a warning. 'don't be so obvious smh You're Gonna Get Caught'. ... It's a serial killer chatroom. You may be slightly screwed. WELCOME TO HELL, LOSERS! Play as a (fully customisable!) character as you…  Desperately pretend to be a serial killer… just like the other girls serial killers. So they don't kick you out. Or kill you. Oh god, they might kill you.  Get to know some killers. You might as well scope this out, right? No better chance to gather accurate first-hand data for your book.  Huh, they're actually kind of nice?  Oh shit, he's hot. And she's hot.  Maybe you can… date… some murderers? What even is your life. FEATURING WHO OTHER THAN... YOURS TRULY?  Customisable MC! (Name, username, personality, gender, face, body, clothing, accessories, what kind of  pseudo  serial killer you are...) Four  serial killers love interests across all genders (male, female, non-binary)...  Story-rich, choice-based branching towards 8 unique endings. Make voice and video calls to the server's serial killers, listen to voice messages, get them to accept your friend requests, and more! Write your own status, biography, and messages in chat! Four illustrated CG's. Custom-made OST and sound effects. A playtime of approx. 2-3 hours per route, 9-12 hours for all routes. We're planning on adding many more features exclusive to the Expanded Edition (also on Steam!), so stay tuned for the full announcement. However, how much content we can add depends on how much we get funded! CONTENT WARNINGS:  Death, murder, references to abuse, and serial killers... but you knew that. MEET THE SERIALS! AND THE REST... (An arsonist, a slasher out of the '90's, a surfer who trips into killing, a lonely hearts poisoner ... you'll have to play the game, won't'cha?)

Play as a (customisable!) writer as you pretend to be a serial killer, get inspiration for your book, fall in love and try not to call the cops through a whirlwind six months with your murderous beau of choice. What could possibly go wrong?

row.name: Cozy Aquarium

row.short_description: Immerse yourself in a beautifully designed world where you can create, decorate, and manage your very own aquarium while enjoying soothing Lofi music. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or boost your productivity, CozyAquarium offers something for everyone.

row.name: Anturi
row.detailed_description: In the course of the game, you explore various islands and help the inhabitants to find out information about your father's fate. There are many new skills to learn and adventures to experience along the way. But be careful, the world has many stories to tell, secrets to uncover and dangers to overcome. So what are you waiting for? Find your own path and follow your heart in the world of Anturi. Story When his father fails to return home in search of resources, Wikku decides to leave the safety of his homeland and venture into the unknown world of Anturi. But there are unknown dangers out there. As soon as you enter their territory, the environment becomes bleak and you feel sick and weak, so be careful. And look for ways to stop this corruption. Gameplay Use the boomerang to destroy all the Heartless and cause chaos.or find ways to avoid them.your play style is completely up to you! Disclaimer: Anturi consists of two of the planned nine levels and the development has been completed for the time being.
row.short_description: As Wikku, embark on a search for your missing father in the unknown world of Anturi. Explore the islands and help the inhabitants. Also gather information about your father's fate. Improve your skills to better combat the unknown dangers.

row.name: Campoca
row.detailed_description: Step into a world of pure joy with the game Campoca . This game is your go-to feel-good experience, filled with fun minigames and surprises!  Immerse yourself in an interactive wonderland where every element is designed to bring a smile to your face. This game brings happiness right into your heart with very simple controls - just bring your mouse or trackpad! Explore the campsite and earn rewards from feel-good activities and use them to decorate your very own space. Everything in Campoca  is absolutely free to download and play, with no in-game purchases or data collection. Campoca is where wholesome relaxation awaits you. Every moment is designed to fill your heart with the happiness, something much needed today!
row.short_description: Enter Campoca, where feel-good activities and delightful interactions are yours to enjoy completely for free! Collect joyful memories and turn your campsite into a charming, heartwarming retreat!

row.name: Sled Together
row.detailed_description: Sled Together is a fast-paced arcade race with unique penguin launch mechanics. Compete on a series of colorful tracks: maneuver between traps, outrun rivals and collect boosts that help you or hinder others The main feature of the game is the moment when you release your penguin into free flight. Calculate the speed, angle and trajectory to hit the target accurately and earn maximum points. The more accurate the hit, the higher the result. Each track has its own tactics waiting for you: combine the drive of the race with the skill of launching to leave your rivals behind. At the end of the race, the points are counted, and the winner is the one who combines the speed, accuracy and aerodynamics of the penguin the best! Features 8 unique ice tracks with traps, obstacles and targets A crazy mix of racing and launching a penguin into flight — speed + precision = victory! Boosts that help you or hinder your rivals Customization of penguins: hats, scarves, new characters Multiplayer for up to 8 players or singleplayer with bots
row.short_description: Compete on crazy tracks, race on turbo sleds, collect boosters and... launch your penguin into flight! The winner is the one who best combines speed, precision and aerodynamics

Ventomori
row.detailed_description: Ventomori is a 3D asymmetric puzzle co-op that places you centre stage as intrepid astronauts on their way to Planet M-113, Xanahspati, hoping to unveil the secrets behind a mysterious distress call. Join forces to brave the unknown, Choose to be the eyes from above on the space station as the Control player or conquer your fears as you plunge headfirst towards planet Xanahspati as the Scout. Work in tandem to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and ensure each other’s survival as you traverse. But be careful, silence here… is quite deadly. Discover the past, reveal the future, Towering ruins of intrigue await in this narrative driven world. Take in the melancholic sights and deduce the history of the unseen Padullurians as you navigate around monoliths of ancient, alien technology and the planet’s harsh, bone-rending winds. If at first you don’t succeed…, Try and try again to hone your experience with each attempt. With every pass, you gain the most valuable of resources. The digital bodies may fade, but the ever-present minds remember.
row.short_description: In this asymmetrical multiplayer co-op puzzle game, brave the treacherous unknown and endeavour on a deadly, desolate planet. Be the eyes from above or the scout on the ground and work together with a friend to uncover the mysteries and escape from the planet Xanahspati.

row.name: Culinary Wizard
row.detailed_description: Embrace cooking techniques like never before After being fired from a previous job as a line cook, a young chef is hungry for new work. One morning a mysterious job offer appears that beckons you towards a mysterious, magical restaurant. Culinary Wizard is a traditional 2D action-platformer made in a cozy 32-bit pixel art style. Bring ingredients to life and travel between unique worlds, battling hunger one customer at a time. Refine your palette and master the techniques of the culinary arts to deliver tasty meals to happy customers, no matter the request. Game Features Traditional side-scroller action in a retro pixel art style, with a dash of modern zest. Level up with powerful skills and abilities! Smash your way to victory with a mighty tenderizer, throw in a dash of salt when in a pinch, or slice foes to pieces with a cutting edge chefs knife. Take your skills to new heights with your trusty spatula, or roll through the competition with a wooden rolling pin. Become an interdimensional chef and travel between distant worlds to cook for quirky customers with absurd appetites that are almost as bad as their jokes. Spice up your fashion sense with over 15 wacky costumes to wear! Choose your favorite cooking styles to make your culinary journey unique. A vast selection of sweet and savory food-based enemies all brought to life with traditional 2D frame-by-frame animations. Hand crafted environments with seamless parallax, giving that sense of depth to a flat world. A handful of sound effects custom made for each enemy that gives them some extra flavor. 20 trophies to earn and display proudly in your bedroom as you advance through your cooking career. Flexible keyboard/controller inputs that let you rebind buttons to anything you want to best fit your gaming playstyle. Hungry for more? Complete Culinary Wizard to unlock recipes from the secret menu; a chef's greatest challenge! Expand your palette as an interdimensional chef Each new world you travel to along your culinary journey is just as weird as the last, with level layouts carefully hand crafted in a traditional 32-bit pixel art style. As you discover new worlds, a variety of new ingredients become available that make each world feel unique and full of life. Hang out by the beach and catch some sun with the bros, or venture down into the rotten depths of the restaurant and uncover a rotten surprise. If you enjoy traditional platforming gameplay, have a hunger for adventure, and love corny jokes, then start your journey today to become a Culinary Wizard!
row.short_description: A magical action platformer following the life of an apprentice chef learning to master the secrets of the culinary arts under the tutelage of a newfound teacher. Journey through magical lands, bring ingredients to life, and slay foes using kitchen tools, all in a classic 32-bit pixel art style.

row.name: Through The Ages
row.detailed_description: Through The Ages is a 17 minute real-time high end graphical cinematic that takes us on a nostalgic journey through three of NVIDIA's iconic GPUs in unprecedended visual detail. Featuring visuals that push the NVIDIA RTX 4090 to its limits, Through The Ages employs Nanite assets with up to 122 million polygons with the latest in NVIDIA technologies including ReSTIR Global Illumination, RTX Direct Illumination, Enhanced RayTraced Translucency, Real-Time RayTraced Caustics, Shader Execution Reordering and DLSS.  This tech demo was created as a personal project in collaboration with NVIDIA & Maingear who provided hardware to make this project possible Through The Ages uses the Unreal® Engine. row.name: Built to Scale Solitaire
row.detailed_description: Take a load off your mind with  Built to Scale Solitaire , a uniquely designed card game about building a musical scale, inspired by Zachtronics' solitaire games. ASSEMBLE:  Stack cards in ascending order by suit, but take care around the Widget cards which need to be assembled  in a free cell! BUILD SCALES:  Each card sent to the foundation is part of a scale. Arrange your cards right and they'll all fall into place automatically. TUNES TO SOLVE TO:  Jam out to original music written by GenericArrangements! Warning: they're  very  catchy... HD TEXTURES:  Play with new, 4K-ready card textures, or switch back to classic textures at any time. STATS & ACHIEVEMENTS:  Track your best (and worst) games with built-in stats and earn Steam Achievements.
row.short_description: Have you had a busy day from work? Is the daily grind stressing you out? Try Built to Scale Solitaire, a uniquely designed card game inspired by Zachtronics' solitaires!

row.name: Moon Journey - China's Lunar Exploration Digital Museum
row.detailed_description: All resources in this game are for learning and reference purposes only regarding the exploration of lunar culture. They must not be used for any other purposes, especially not for commercial promotion. Violators will be held accountable. About this game: 'Journey to the Moon' is an interactive game that combines lunar exploration with art and culture, as well as science popularization. The core of its development is 'space life is coming eventually'. Players will experience and explore the future cultural and art center built on the lunar surface by switching between first-person and third-person perspectives. Through four levels, 'Journey to the Moon' presents to players ancient Chinese moon culture, modern lunar exploration projects, and future human space life. In 2025, this work will be presented on the screen of China's first art satellite 'SCA-1 Satellite', which is currently in orbit, as one of the 'Infinite Utopia' cosmic interactive spaces in artist Hao Ruichang's space art project (Phase II) (Xu Bing Art Satellite Residency Project). This work will also serve as a practical slice of the aerospace era and the emerging art field, exploring the feasibility of future 'integrated space and ground curation'. Story Background: With the gradual realization of the five major themes of national space science exploration and the construction of a habitable lunar base by the lunar exploration project, humans will gradually move to the moon in the future and establish a 'Moon Path' museum on the lunar surface to commemorate the journey of lunar exploration and look forward to an even more exciting future life in space... row.name: Shojo Warriors
row.detailed_description: As passionate fans of Nijigen and action-packed competitive games, the four of us set out to create an intense, fast-paced brawl game. After months of learning and experimenting with the game development tool 'CliCli,' we are excited to present our passion project. Welcome to our discord and share your thoughts! Exciting and Tense Gameplay Mechanics In a chaotic arena filled with unpredictability, defeat your opponents and seize their bounty points. Once defeated, you'll lose your bounty points—there’s no such thing as a permanent lead; a comeback can happen instantly! Unique Equipment System In between the thrilling battles, you can purchase various abilities through a unique equipment system, allowing you to create your fighting style. Crush your opponents in the next round and enjoy the strategy and economic management of the game! Joyful Stealth and Positioning Utilize map obstacles for strategic positioning and master the art of dodging and weaving. Grow and develop in the corners while observing the chaos unfold. Conserve your strength before launching a joyful ambush to snatch the bounty!
row.short_description: Shojo Warriors is a fast-paced multiplayer brawl game set in a vibrant, anime-inspired fantasy world, made with『CliCli』. In this game, you'll purchase and combine equipment during battles to help the girls achieve victory through growth and strategic gameplay.

row.name: 宫三国
row.detailed_description: 客服QQ：672651441 【游戏特色】 一、颠覆传统——创新的战斗系统 《宫三国》打破了常规的回合制战斗模式，引入实时竞技的热血对战。 二、策略至上——深度的卡牌养成 在《宫三国》的世界里，没有最强的卡组，只有最适合的策略。精心培养你的武将，打造属于自己的无敌军团吧！ 三、视觉盛宴——精美的游戏画面 《宫三国》为玩家呈现了一幅栩栩如生的三国画卷。每一次出牌，都仿佛身临其境，亲历那战火纷飞的年代。 四、随时随地——轻松的游戏体验 《宫三国》致力于让每位玩家都能快速上手，享受最纯粹的卡牌乐趣。 【游戏玩法】 在《宫三国》这款游戏中，玩家可以根据不同的策略和喜好搭配出多样化的阵容。以下是一些建议的武将搭配，这些搭配考虑了武将之间的协同效应以及不同游戏阶段的战术需求： 新手推荐阵容： 前期：张星彩、关银屏、步练师、张苞、蔡文姬 这个组合注重前期的稳定发展，步练师可以提供治疗支持，而张星彩和关银屏则可以在前排造成不错的伤害。 中期：诸葛亮、步练师、蔡文姬、小乔、吕玲绮 随着游戏的推进，加入诸葛亮和小乔可以为队伍带来更强的策略和控制能力，同时保持治疗和输出的平衡。 复活献祭阵容： 前期：许褚、典韦、程昱、华佗、庞德 以坦克和治疗为主，能够在前期承受较多伤害并保持战斗力。 中期：许褚、典韦、大乔、郭嘉、吕玲绮 加强了控制和辅助能力，大乔和郭嘉的加入提高了队伍的生存能力。 后期：许褚、典韦、吕布、甄姬、夏侯惇 引入了强力输出武将吕布，以及提供控制的甄姬和夏侯惇，使得队伍在后期拥有更强的爆发力。 怒气爆发阵容： 前期：皇甫嵩、赵云、祖茂、马超、张苞 以快速积攒怒气和释放技能为核心，赵云和马超能够迅速清理敌方单位。 中期：诸葛亮、赵云、黄忠、马超、袁绍 进一步强化了输出能力，诸葛亮的加入为队伍带来了更多的策略变化。 后期：诸葛亮、赵云、关羽、刘备、张飞 以蜀国五虎将为核心，拥有极高的单体伤害和团队协作能力。 灼烧阵容： 前期：皇甫嵩、周泰、黄盖、周瑜、小乔 利用周瑜的灼烧效果和小乔的治疗能力，可以在前期建立优势。 中期：孙策、贾诩、大乔、小乔、周瑜 加入了孙策和贾诩，增强了队伍的连击和控制能力。 后期：孙策、孙权、太史慈、孙尚香、周瑜 以吴国武将为主，强化了灼烧效果，同时保持了良好的输出和治疗平衡。 单点突破阵容： 前期：皇甫嵩、张角、黄忠、庞德、吕玲绮 专注于单一目标的输出，张角和黄忠能够对敌方形成有效的压制。 中期：张角、黄忠、夏侯渊、吕玲绮、貂蝉 引入了更多的远程输出和控制，夏侯渊和貂蝉的加入使得队伍更加灵活。 后期：诸葛亮、张角、曹操、公孙瓒、貂蝉 结合了输出、控制和策略灵活性，曹操和公孙瓒的加入提升了队伍的全面性。
row.short_description: 《宫三国》是一款以三国武将收集和策略搭配为主要乐趣的放置卡牌游戏，游戏采用新派的水墨国风美术风格，将传统风格与现代技艺相结合，为玩家构建出一个极具沉浸感的魔幻三国世界!

row.name: Take Care (of me)
row.detailed_description: Take Care (of me) Take care (of me) immerses you in a first person dark and suspenseful environment where you will have to complete an Escape Room filled with a variety of puzzles. 'Where am I, what am I doing here?' This is the question our protagonist asks herself when she finds herself trapped in a bathroom with no memory and little chance of survival. She tries to escape, and with every door she opens, fragments of her past are revealed, while the shadows of mystery close in around her. As fear grows and memories intertwine, the only way out seems to be confronting the evil that haunts her. Will she escape her own mind before it's too late?
row.short_description: My name is Lorena. I don’t know where I am or how I got here. I just woke up in a bathroom, locked in, but I will escape this place and figure out what’s happening.

row.name: WASTED
row.detailed_description: Games for dummies: A bunch of anonymous ATMs act like bumper cars in an arena, roaming around set on a desolate square quay surrounded by an infinite ocean. As a first-person player, you ram into other bot ATMs before they hit you to earn cash. Spoiler: you always lose. Designed for PC, using keyboard or Xbox controller. Play @Kunstmuseumgelsenkirchen or download for free to play at home! This is an indie art video game by Studio Alona Rodeh, Berlin, Germany. It was produced for  Interzone , a solo show at Kunstmuseum Gelsenkirchen (2024-2025) with the support of Stiftung Kunstfonds_SoloProjekt, the Ministry of Culture and Science of the State of North Rhine-Westphalia, Alfried Krupp von Bohlen und Halbach-Stiftung, and Artis. WASTED can be played with an X-Box controller (preferred) or keyboard. X-Box Controls: Up/Down = Accelerate Left/Right = Steer Left/Right Menu Button = Pause/Restart Keyboard Controls: Up/Down = Accelerate Left/Right = Steer Left/Right Esc = Pause/Restart Z = Left Trigger Space = Right Trigger
row.short_description: A surreal group of generic ATMs acts like bumper cars in an arena, roaming around set on a desolate square quay in an infinite ocean. As a first-person player, you ram into other bot ATMs before they hit you. This is an indie art video game by Studio Alona Rodeh, Berlin, Germany.

row.name: GeoGuessr Steam Edition
row.detailed_description: The Free edition includes unlimited Quickplay Solo Duels and Quickplay Team duels. In-game purchase of 1 year Steam Pass is required to play Competitive Solo Duels,   or be on an Unlimited Yearly or Elite Yearly subscription. GeoGuessr Steam Edition takes you on a journey around the world, challenging you to recognize locations and outsmart your opponents. Each round places you in an unknown location, where you must use landscapes, signs, and landmarks to pinpoint your position. Face off against players worldwide in exciting multiplayer battles. Climb the leaderboard, sharpen your geography skills, and discover famous landmarks or hidden corners of the world. Every guess brings you closer to victory. Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate champion? In this edition, you’ll compete against players from around the world in Competitive Solo Duels. This game mode is structured around a ranking system and with skill and perseverance, you can rise to the prestigious Champion Division, where the best players face off to prove their mastery of the world. On your way to the Champion Division, you’ll access new features and game modes, such as No Move and the legendary NMPZ.                        In addition to the full Solo Duels experience, you can access Quickplay Solo Duels and Quickplay Team Duels - available for both paying and free users. Team up with a Steam friend and play together against another duo from anywhere in the world!                 The free offering includes: Unlimited access to Quickplay Solo Duels Unlimited access to Quickplay Team Duels To unlock the full Competitive Solo Duels experience, you’ll need to purchase a GeoGuessr Steam Pass inside the game, or be on an Unlimited Yearly or Elite Yearly subscription. General notes: Having a GeoGuessr browser subscription does not grant you full access to the GeoGuessr Steam Edition , unless you have an Unlimited Yearly or  Elite Yearly subscription. Nor does a GeoGuessr Steam Pass grant you access to the GeoGuessr browser version. GeoGuessr Steam Pass holders will be able to cross-play against GeoGuessr browser subscribers and vice versa.
row.short_description: Explore the world with GeoGuessr Steam Edition! Compete against others, climb divisions, and prove your geography skills. Travel to stunning locations, analyze clues, and make your best guess. Quickplay Duels is unlimited Free-to-play, Competitive Duels is subject to payment/subscription.

row.name: El Pasante Elementalista
row.detailed_description: You are a beginner magician! You are a beginner magician seeking to graduate from the Arcania magic academy, and to do so you must embark on a wonderful adventure to the ancient crypt to return the golden scroll and graduate as a professional magician! row.name: Soda Splash
row.detailed_description: Soda Splash is the first game created by our two-person team. As a new team, 『CliCli』 is an efficient game editing tool that has helped us significantly in our development. Join our discord, we welcome your feedback and suggestions to help us improve! **Game features** Dive into an exhilarating multiplayer co-op survival PvP game! row.short_description: Soda Splash is a multiplayer co-op survival PVP game made with a game editing tool『CliCli』. Players team up to defeat soda cans and gather resources to enhance their characters. Work strategically to increase the rival’s soda cans for the victory!

row.name: Cor Draconis
row.detailed_description: A wandering team of adventurers stumble upon a powerful, magically-infused dragon heart. They decide to harness this power in order to create a settlement for themselves and other adventurers. As the town becomes larger, the settlers realize they are not alone, there are small encampments of many sorts of foes, from goblins, to giants, to the undead! After banding together and killing the dragon, the monsters have used its carcass as power for their settlements. However, they must have missed the most powerful remnant of them all, the heart! These fiends have guarded their most valuable treasure, the dragon’s fossils, with their lives. If one could combine the heart with all the fossils who knows what may happen? Features include: City Building - Construct and upgrade buildings to increase your power and to grow your settlement into a bustling city! Dungeon Crawler Mini-game - Explore your way through dungeons and defeat monsters though D&D-style combat.
row.short_description: In Cor Draconis, players gather a team of magical adventurers, conquering dungeons and collecting enough fossils to revive the dragon that once protected the lands. Grow your settlement into a bustling city, rid the land of monsters, and restore magic and peace to the nation once more!

row.name: Minimalist Box
row.detailed_description: Minimalist Box – A multi-level Sokoban challenge 【About this game】 Minimalist boxes is an innovative puzzle game with Sokoban as the core gameplay, redefining the classic mental challenge through four distinct physics rules. Journey through 96 carefully designed levels, experience new puzzle-solving dimensions from traditional logic to unique themes, and feel the intellectual storm brought by each step in the seemingly simple movement of boxes. ▌Four dimensional themes, breaking through the stereotype • Classic Echo (24 levels) Relive the sheer fun of the golden age of Sokoban and solve retro-style puzzles with precise step counts using the most basic pushing rules in the grid maze. Each level is the ultimate test of spatial planning skills. • Double-sided (24 off) Step into the realm of quantum entanglement! Take control of two different cabinets at the same time and plan the best route in brainstorming! Note: Different chests need to reach different destinations, e.g. red chests cannot reach blue destinations • Gravitational (24 levels) When the box has gravity, the place that looks like a dead end may be the secret to clearing the level! Take control of the gravitational boxes that attract each other, make the boxes attract each other, and plan the best route! Note that normal chests cannot be attracted. • Ice (24 levels, stay tuned) Predict your predictions on the eternal ice! Once the block is pushed, it will slide to the end of the path, so take advantage of this feature to push the box to the end! Every slip is an irreversible game of time and space. ▌Core features ◆ 96 hand-polished puzzles: 24 levels of progressive difficulty curves for each theme, from beginner guide to brain-burning level ◆ Dynamic physics rule system: The unique interactive logic of each world brings 4 completely different puzzle-solving experiences ◆ Minimalist art style: no bells and whistles, enjoy the most original Sokoban! ◆ Puzzle data analysis: Have a record of the number of steps you have cleared, challenge your limits, and find the best solution in many routes! 【For such players】 ✓ Classic Sokoban enthusiasts looking for rule innovations ✓ Physics puzzle addicts crave multi-dimensional challenges ✓ Strategy gamers pursue the thrill of precision computing ✓ Casual users enjoy progressive brain workouts Join this cross-dimensional pushbox revolution now and prove that you're the best master of space strategy in the multiverse in the collision of classic rules and physics anomalies! With each push, the possibilities of the world are being reconstructed...
row.short_description: It's a traditional Sokoban game where you can rewrite the classic Sokoban gameplay with subversive physics rules in 4 dimensions , 96 brain-burning puzzles! In the symphony of boxes and physical changes, become the ultimate strategist who reconstructs the logic of space!

row.name: Bounce IT
row.detailed_description: Bounce It is a fast-paced arcade game built around one core rule: Keep the ball bouncing from side to side. Each bounce keeps you in the game. Time your inputs well to maintain the rhythm and stay on track. Across every game mode, the challenge is to keep the motion going while adapting to new patterns, obstacles, and setups. Score higher, survive longer, and unlock new content as you go. Earn experience by completing levels and improving your score. As you level up, you’ll unlock skin tokens to get skins and visual effects to personalize your experience. Core Features Signature Bounce Mechanic A satisfying side-to-side bounce that defines every mode and challenge. Progression Through Play Gain experience by reaching milestones, and improving your runs. Unlockable Skins Customize your ball, bouncer, particles, trail and much more! Endless Score Runs Push your skills to the limit in endless modes. Minimalist Visuals with Focused Gameplay Clean, readable presentation designed to keep you immersed and in control. Developer Note Bounce It is my first experimental Steam project, created mainly as a way to learn and grow as a developer..
row.short_description: Keep the ball bouncing non-stop, earn high scores, level up, and unlock new skins and cosmetics in this addictive arcade challenge.

row.name: Project Gravity
row.detailed_description: Take the role of a test subject tasked with testing out a new experimental device capable of changing the gravitational pull of any objects it is used on. Your mission is to complete a series of tests designed to challenge the capabilities of the device. Features: The device allows you to change the gravitational pull of yourself, allowing you to 'fall' in any direction you please. Similarly, you can use this device on other objects as well, which allows you to send any object flying into whatever direction you please. As you progress through the tests, the Overseer will monitor your progress and talk to you as you play.
row.short_description: Take the role of a test subject tasked with testing out a new experimental device capable of changing the gravitational pull of any objects it is used on. With this at your disposal, you must complete a few puzzles in this short single-player experience.

row.name: Keep It Lit
row.detailed_description: Keep It Lit is a Virtual Tabletop designed to enhance immersion while playing the ShadowDark roleplaying game.  Torch Timers! Realistic dynamic lighting Simple user interface for Players Integrated ShadowDark character sheets Import player characters from Control of multiple tokens Chat window Integrated dice roller Play online in multiplayer mode Play in-person with a flat-screen monitor Keep It Lit is free for Players! Please note that the Keep It Lit DLC is required to host a session
row.short_description: Keep It Lit is a virtual tabletop designed to enhance player immersion. You Game Master can use the GM Module DLC to create that sense of tension, mystery, and foreboding that’s so critical in your ShadowDark game sessions! The Player version of Keep It Lit is free!

row.name: Compass of Destiny: Survivors
row.detailed_description: Compass of Destiny: Survivors Using assets from Compass of Destiny: Istanbul, Survivors mode is a special game mode that heavily features action and survival elements. Set in the mystical atmosphere of Istanbul, players must survive against ever-increasing waves of enemies. Key Features of the mode: Endless Waves of Enemies: Players face more challenging and diverse enemies with each wave. Dynamic and Infinite Maps: Various maps set in different locations offer players different strategies. From rural areas to historic streets, the game is played in a variety of areas. Equipment and Power-ups: Players can earn new equipment, upgrade existing abilities and gain unique powers between waves. Content Unlocked Over Time: Players can unlock new enemies, equipment and abilities as they reach certain levels. Point System: The time you survive, the number of enemies you kill, and the level you reach determine your score. This increases competition and encourages players to perform better. Strategy Advice: Manage your stamina and limited power carefully. Enemies become more dangerous as you progress, so making the right investments in power-ups is critical. Make good use of the map's features to gain an advantage in tight spaces or scatter enemies in wide areas. Survivors mode offers gamers a fast-paced, exciting and highly replayable experience.
row.short_description: Compass of Destiny: İstanbul oyununun assetlerini kullanarak hazırlanan Survivors modu, aksiyon ve hayatta kalma öğelerini yoğun bir şekilde yer veren özel bir oyun modudur.

row.name: Ultranatural
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Ultranatural , a no-frills PvP arena shooter built for quick, competitive fun. This is a student project from S4G Berlin, designed with simplicity in mind to modernize the classic arena shooter experience. In Ultranatural, you’ll face off against friends on a single, carefully designed map, using one traditional weapon to prove your skills. The focus is on skill-based combat, fast movement, and intense one-on-one or small team matches. With easy-to-host servers, it’s a perfect way to settle who’s the better shot among your group. Whether you’re a fan of old-school shooters or just looking for a quick, straightforward game to play with friends, Ultranatural keeps the action sharp, simple, and fun.
row.short_description: Ultranatural is a fast-paced PvP arena shooter where skill and speed rule. Battle friends on one hand-crafted map with a single essential weapon. Easy server hosting makes it simple to jump into intense duels or team skirmishes. Pure, straightforward competition awaits!
row.notes: This game contains depictions of firearm combat, including shooting and self-harm content. While there is no graphic violence or blood, the realistic visuals and themes may be distressing to some players. Viewer discretion is advised.

row.name: Lost City of Bardo
row.detailed_description: [Official Game Guide in the Community Hub] Embark on an epic journey into the heart of the Great Maze of Bardo, a place where few have ventured—and none have returned. Within the Great Maze, you’ll find lurking dangers, hidden treasures, and new challenges at every turn. Can you navigate its depths and escape, or will you become trapped forever? This game is free to play but includes In-App Purchases to aid your journey. The Save Sword Inventory item grants unlimited saves, making it easier to complete the game. While save swords can be found within the Great Maze, they are rare. The Lost City of Bardo is a vast open-world adventure game. The Great Maze is so immense that you could wander for years before finding your way out! To grasp its true immensity, here’s a zoomed-out view from one corner of the Great Maze: Along the way, you’ll encounter sources of wisdom, valuable allies, and powerful potions to aid your journey. The game’s built-in guide will let you know your current task, and scattered throughout the maze, special devices will help you overcome obstacles and uncover new paths. Even with these tools, the sheer scale of the Great Maze is overwhelming. The game’s task system will always inform you of what you need to do next. Completing these also unlocks corresponding Achievements. Each task prepares you for the next, and although tasks can be completed out of order, you will always know what you need to accomplish to finish the game. The Game has four stages: The first stage of the game focuses on preparing for The Arena. During this phase, you will learn essential skills, including how to gather resources and use various devices within the Great Maze. You will discover how to collect and create crystals, utilize gold and diamonds, cultivate special mushrooms, and craft powerful potions! Once you enter The Arena, you’ll face nine grueling levels that will test everything you’ve learned so far. Conquering The Arena will reward you with a powerful weapon—the Plasma Gun—which is key to progressing further in your quest. In this stage, you’ll need to gather additional resources, primarily gold, and journey to the center of the Great Maze. It may sound daunting, but don’t worry—you now have the Plasma Gun and a new ally to help guide you! This is one of the most challenging stages of the game. Everything you’ve done so far has been preparation for this moment: a journey to each corner of the Great Maze. Here, you must face the three great monsters of Bardo and return victorious, having gathered the four Great Crystals. The Monster of the East In the far eastern reaches of the Great Maze dwells a massive, eight-legged creature known only as Shadow. Her hunger is insatiable, and the skulls of her victims litter the ground. No one has ever seen her—only her shadow. And by then, it’s already too late… The Monster of the West In the westernmost reaches of the Great Maze lurks a dreaded beast known as the Kraken. Its tentacles rise from the inky depths beneath your feet, striking with lightning speed. Only when every last one has been severed will it reveal its hidden treasure. But navigating this place is no easy feat—traps and obstacles lie in wait at every turn, and the slightest misstep will send you plummeting into the abyss below! The Monster of the North In the northernmost reaches of the Great Maze dwells a legendary beast without a name. He resides in a vast abyss, guarding a great treasure. This foe cannot be defeated—but he can be outwitted, if you are quick enough! The Great Crystal he protects is the key to unlocking the final phase of your adventure. With the four Great Crystals in your possession, the final challenge awaits. The Great Maze has tested your skill, endurance, and wit— you are ready uncover the final secrets of Bardo! The Legend Awaits…
row.short_description: A massive open-world maze adventure game.

row.name: The King's Legend
row.detailed_description: The King's Legend A gritty, medieval fantasy turn-based strategy game where every move is a matter of sacrifice. Sit at the war table as a king locked in a deadly duel against a rival monarch. Across a hex-based battlefield, command an evolving army of Soldiers, Knights, Wizards, and powerful Legends. With each turn, you must make brutal decisions—sacrifice your own to strengthen the rest, upgrade your forces, and regenerate lost pieces to outwit your opponent. Played for millennia, this ancient game is more than tradition—your kingdom’s fate hangs in the balance. Challenge your friends in intense 1v1 battles where cleverness trumps brute force. Think carefully, strike boldly—only the smartest king will rise to legend. A Duel Demands Two.  The King's Legend is a head-to-head experience—built for rivalry, not solitude. Whether side by side or connected through Steam Remote Play, a challenger is required. No friend at the ready? Seek one out. A true duel waits for no one.
row.short_description: Fight your way to victory by strategically sacrificing, upgrading, and regenerating your pieces. Duel your friends in this fantasy turn-based strategy game, seizing every advantage you can. Let the wiser king become the legend!

row.name: 19th-century Printing Press Experience VR
row.detailed_description: Would you like to experience how books were once printed? Take the role of a printer as you are guided step-by-step through printing on a 19th-century cast iron printing press. The printing press you will operate is a virtual reproduction of one owned by William Morris (1834–1896), who used it to print The Works of Geoffrey Chaucer (1896) for his Kelmscott Press. The “Kelmscott Chaucer,” as it is more commonly known, is one of the most beautiful books ever produced, and you will print its title page. The printing press was later owned by type designer Frederic Goudy (1865–1947). The press’s association with Morris and Goudy led it to be nicknamed the Kelmscott/Goudy Press. The Kelmscott/Goudy Press now lives an active life at the Cary Graphic Arts Collection at the Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). The following team of students, led by Professor Shaun Foster and Curator Steven Galbraith, brought the press to life in a VR setting. Lead on the app:  Aidan Grant  Danielle Bertone, Bailey Cohen, Zach Darrow, Sam Donez (Lead), Aidan Grant (Lead), Caspian Halbert, Morgan Hamilton, Sean Herman (Lead), Devin Klibanow (Lead), Andrew Lytle, Matthew Mouthon, Grant MacWilliam, Hunter Ostrander, Jessica Torregrossa, Hannah Wertz, and Boyu Xu.   Initial work began with a BreakThru Grant from the Rochester Regional Library Council.
row.short_description: A hands-on educational experience that guides you through the process of printing on a 19th-century printing press.

row.name: Trapventure
row.detailed_description: Trapventure is a tough but fun medieval adventure where you’ll be solving tricky puzzles, dodging deadly traps, and battling skeletons. Play as an archer and test your reflexes and brainpower as you jump across floating platforms, face off against enemies, and work your way through dangerous environments. It's a challenge, but that’s all part of the fun! Key Features: Traps & Puzzles : Solve puzzles and avoid traps that’ll test your timing and smarts. Platforming Fun : Jump, dodge, and time your movements. Rage-Inducing Challenge : It's designed to make you sweat. Expect to fail, expect to try again, and expect to love the thrill of overcoming tough obstacles. A Note from the Developer Trapventure is my first fully completed game, developed solo while I was learning game development. Starting from a background in Level and Game Design, I pushed myself to learn more about programming and game creation through tutorials and personal effort. This game is the result of that journey, a small but intense adventure filled with challenges. I hope you enjoy the experience as much as I enjoyed making it. Thank you for playing!
row.short_description: A tough, rage-inducing platformer where you solve puzzles, dodge traps, and navigate through deadly obstacles to escape a cursed fortress. Good for players who love a challenge and don’t mind a little frustration along the way.

row.name: Shrimp Keeping Simulator
row.detailed_description: Grow, feed and care for your shrimp pals. Watch your shrimp multiply and sell your colony when they become too numerous. Gameplay Loop! You start with an empty aquarium which you can decorate a little bit and buy some shrimp for. After adding some plants and ghost shrimp you'll need to feed and otherwise care for your shrimp. When you get too many shrimp you can sell them to make money and then buy another species or more decorations! The game features around 30 minutes of gameplay but can be played for longer if you really like shrimp. Features: 2 shrimp species Feeding Aquascaping Cute lads
row.short_description: Grow, feed and care for your shrimp pals. Watch your shrimp multiply and sell your colony when they become too numerous.

row.name: Unluckily in Love: Fragments of Love
row.detailed_description: Yuel’s life was miserable. Though born into a wealthy family, Yuel’s parents divorced when he was young and his father was cold and callous. Desperate to earn his father’s affection (or, failing that, his approval), Yuel worked hard at university, studying for a degree he wasn’t truly interested in… Until his father’s sudden death puts a wrench in Yuel’s plans. Feeling lost and bereft, Yuel seeks help from his older cousin, Tavi, who agrees to take Yuel in while he’s coming to terms with his father’s death. This was only ever supposed to be a temporary arrangement, but feelings begin to grow between the two that are more than just familial. Now, with his father’s funeral behind him and a hefty inheritance he’s set to earn, Yuel must try to muddle along as best he can while living with Tavi. It’ll be a while until Yuel comes into his father’s money, so until then, the two need to stay afloat as best they can, all while trying to maintain their unusual relationship. Will they be able to succeed, or will it end in disaster? A continuation of Unluckily in Love which picks up where the original VN left off Four cute slice of life stories which can be read in any order 200k of text (approx 8-15 hours of reading) A slew of adorable artwork A cute gay romance story with an established couple A lively supporting cast Several brand new songs in the OST A handful of adult scenes which are all consensual in nature Cute boys!!!
row.short_description: A collection of episodic boys love / yaoi stories which takes place after the events of Unluckily in Love. Follow Yuel and Tavi as they experience the joys of crossdressing, going on dates, and loving one another a whole bunch ♡
row.notes: This visual novel contains some cursing, sexually charged dialogue, and depictions of smoking. It also contains several consensual sex scenes between two adult male characters. These scenes are all consensual in nature. Please note: the main couple in this story are a pair of first cousins.

row.name: Long Knives
row.detailed_description: English localization only available in Demo. Dynasty crumbles. The land fractures. You're one of many orphans, taken in by distant kin. On reaching adulthood, you become a constable, whether for survival or ambition. Long Knives is a low-fantasy wuxia text-based adventure with TTRPG mechanics and deep narrative branching. Key Features TTRPG-inspired. Second-person narrative. Customize attributes. Choose pre-orphan background. Allocate points. Proficiencies affect skill checks. Uses an 18-sided die, not D20. Visible and hidden checks. Reload anytime. Personalized Experience Every line of dialogue is your choice. Story branches respond to hidden variables. No cloud saves. All data is local.
row.short_description: An oriental narrative mystery. The story branches upon your choices. The dice lies.

row.name: 帝国：权杖与文明
row.detailed_description: 关注我们 欢迎关注我们了解《帝国：权杖与文明》的最新进展： 官方QQ群：293724741 文明征程起，火热开服中！《帝国：权杖与文明》是一款多文明题材战争策略游戏，更是一个真实的古文明战争模拟器。登录送百抽，橙将免费领！演绎沙盘、建设城市、养成英雄、征战海陆战场等丰富玩法等你探索。此刻，文明正在厮杀，历史等你重铸，实时对抗扩张版图，争夺至高王座！ 时空交错，文明乱斗 从农田到帝国，从选中第一块农田起，你的文明就已开始书写。马其顿长枪阵？波斯不死军？蒙古重骑兵？战术不被历史束缚！从华夏王朝到罗马帝国，从维京军队到波斯商队，古文明的命运掌握在你手中！是协助成吉思汗的黄金战马踏碎波兰的十字军防线，还是让拜占庭重骑兵在君士坦丁堡城头插上双头鹰旗？文明奇观拔地而起，历史战场由你执棋。用沙盘奇谋颠覆千年战史，每一场战役都是历史的分岔点。 中外英雄，任意搭配 杀神白起卸下玄衣甲胄，与屋大维并肩立于巴格达城墙，武则天与埃及艳后在多瑙河畔双枪合璧。200+历史名将突破时空壁，携带着各自的特殊技能与你并肩作战。英雄不再是数值符号，而是文明博弈的活体图腾。所有玩家在初始大卡池就有机会集齐所有武将，20抽必出橙卡，7日连登领百抽，一键无损换将系统使新手玩家在10秒内即可复刻大神配队，战术推演无需试错成本。 策略奇谋，决胜千里 拒绝无脑数值碾压。在这里，协作即是生命线，每场战役都有N+1种解法，你可以通过谋略感受千变万化的跨文明沙盘战场，让策略游戏从此不再是枯燥的调兵遣将。 智能减负，轻松写意 游戏内置的自动铺路系统，省去打地铺路的烦恼，中转站可一键调取主城兵力，一秒补充主力部队。游戏引入了独特的盟友互助机制，帮助新手玩家轻松占领自己打不过的内城地块。在这里，没有996式的爆肝，只有刀刀见血的福利和充满创意的战场。玩家可以即刻集结，用自己的名字改写四大古文明的编年史。 文明的火种，终需真正的战略家执掌点燃！快与我们一同重返千年古战场，聆听历史上的风声阵阵，开启属于你的万国之路！
row.short_description: 在你的眼里，文明是怎么样的？是石头长矛到飞机导弹的跨时代战场，还是从三国时代到骑士之剑的地域时空跨越，亦或是和无数历史英雄一起肩并肩作战和决策的机会，更是从生命最初的萌芽，到最伟大文明的艰辛进化旅程······ 这一切，相信在《帝国：权杖与文明》中，都能找到属于你的答案。

row.name: URLate
row.detailed_description: URLate is a short point & click adventure that immerses you in a hand-drawn world filled with puzzles and mysteries to solve. Features: Short point & click adventure (about 30 min). Hand-drawn characters and environments. Dark aesthetic. Mysterious background story.
row.short_description: URLate is a short and free point & click adventure that immerses you in a hand-drawn world filled with puzzles and mysteries to solve.

row.name: Lost Prototype
row.detailed_description: Lost Prototype is a ‘game’ created by an unnamed developer. You are asked to try this game...or ‘prototype’ and find a way out. Something is hiding in this prototype or someone,  we don't know. Just avoid getting caught. This game lasts about 10 to 20 minutes and contains flashing lights and sometimes loud noises. (Lost Prototype is a test ‘game’ to train myself on Unreal Engine and especially to make my steamwork account and stuff).
row.short_description: Lost Prototype is a walking simulator in which you have to find your way out of a maze under construction. But be aware, you're not alone in this place. Something is following you and wants to erase all your progress.

row.name: Idle Commonwealth
row.detailed_description: Idle Commonwealth is a incremental game where you will develop your community, increase the population, construct buildings, assign your residents to various professions, set taxes and governance, discover new technologies, and establish relations with other nations. Main Features: collect and produce various resources build workplaces as well as housing for your population research new technologies to unlock further development opportunities establish the type of government and set tax rates discover other nations trade with or conquer your neighbors earn in-game achievements to enhance your capabilities prestige to boost your production and unlock new content The game is still evolving! The upcoming updates will include features such as genetic modifications for the population, space colonization, and more...
row.short_description: Idle Commonwealth is an idle game that pays homage to the best of the idle genre. Start small, grow your commonwealth, maintain morale, establish governance, invent technologies, trade and conquer your neighbors.

row.name: Ceuswark Defenders
row.detailed_description: STORY The village of Ceuswark, set in a fantasy world, attracts the attention of evil forces. When the villagers learn that these forces plan to raid their humble village, which has roots going back thousands of years, they quickly reach out to a wizard named Osdam. They tell him they are ready to give all their wealth to protect their home. Osdam does not know what ruthless forces he will face. However, he quickly realizes that these enemies are unlike the demonic forces he has fought before. Despite this, he declares that he will do his best and rushes to help the villagers. GAMEPLAY Destroy all evil enemies and giant monsters attacking the village of Ceuswark Defenders and save the village. Enemy variety Special abilities and traps Rich atmosphere with high-quality sound design. Immersive gameplay
row.short_description: Ceuswark Defenders is a carefully designed single-player village and tower defense game made with Unreal Engine 5. Defeat evil forces and save the villagers!
row.notes: There is mature content due to the gameplay involving combat.

row.name: Magic Soldier
row.detailed_description: Dive into a breathtaking fantasy world with Magic Soldier ! Discover a 2D open-world MMORPG where exploration, adventure, and strategy come together. Embark on a journey in a rich and vibrant universe where every decision shapes your destiny. Explore a vast world filled with mysteries, dungeons, and hidden treasures. Take on epic challenges by battling formidable bosses and hordes of enemies. Create your unique hero with customizable skills, equipment, and styles. Forge alliances with other players to overcome challenges or engage in thrilling PvP battles. Experience crafting and economy by gathering resources, crafting items, and trading to thrive.                 Join a growing community and dive into an unforgettable adventure !               Open-World Exploration : Roam a vast and vibrant fantasy world filled with secrets, quests, and hidden treasures. Epic PvE Combat : Battle dangerous creatures, challenging bosses. Epic PvP Combat : Engage in epic battles in the PvP arena with a ranking system for the 'Magic Soldier number 1' title, earning points through victories and losing them through defeats. Profession System : Perfect all 7 available professions to gather resources, craft powerful items, and boost your gameplay potential. Character Customization : Choose your class, skills, and equipment to build a hero that reflects your playstyle. Skill Enhancement System: Improve and optimize your character’s skills to maximize your potential and become the ultimate soldier. Trading System : Buy, sell, and trade items with other players or merchants based on the variety and value of the items. Enchantment System : Enchant your gear multiple times to enhance its stats and unlock the maximum potential for endless progression. Upgrade System : Upgrade your gear up to +10, with success and failure mechanics. Use special items to prevent level loss and push your equipment to its full potential. Multiplayer Experience : Join forces with players worldwide for cooperative missions or compete in player vs player arenas. Wild Zones : Enter dangerous wild zones where PvP is permitted, and be cautious as high-level players may risk losing items in these areas. Karma System : In wild zones, killing another player increases your karma. At certain thresholds, your name's color changes, showing your assassin rank. Karma resets only if you're killed in a wild zone. Guild System : Create or join a guild to share resources, and work together to dominate the world of Magic Soldier !         Secret Zones : Discover hidden areas with extremely powerful bosses that drop unique items. Instance System : Face challenging instances in Normal or Elite mode (for the brave) either solo or in teams to earn exclusive rewards. Survival Mode :  Take on survival instances, where each round brings tougher challenges and loot that varies based on the rounds you've survived.          Codex System :  Track your global progress throughout the game in the Codex. Once you complete it 100%, unlock a unique item that will set you apart from other players. Teleportation System :  Once you discover the relevant areas in the game, the teleportation system will allow you to quickly travel between them for easier exploration. Bestiary System :  Once you've gathered information about a monster, you can view its loot, attack types, and defense types in the bestiary to help you strategize your battles. Embark on your journey today and prove you're ready to conquer all that this world has to offer, with over 150 hours of gameplay waiting for you !
row.short_description: Embark on an epic journey in Magic Soldier, a 2D open-world MMORPG. Explore vast landscapes, fight powerful foes, craft unique items, and team up with players worldwide. Adventure awaits, shape your destiny today !

row.name: Camilla
row.detailed_description: Fear comes from accidental situations. Let Camilla get out of her sudden changed terror and back to her family's side. Sometimes run wild, sometimes use ideas to be with her family she wants to go back to her happy daily life. Camilla is a Pac-Man-type running simulation game, Check the number of goods needed to clear the stage between maze-like cities, and buildings, and get the goods as you run. [Stage Clear Tips] - Check the number of target goods required to clear each stage - Avoid monsters that interfere with the acquisition of goods, acquire the target goods, and move on to the next stage - Items you can spot in between help you avoid monsters. Clear the stage with a total of three stages to reach the final ending. [How to play] moving: WASD Jump: Shift Interaction: E Backflip: F [Play time] 20 minutes Configuration options provide screen adjustment, sound-related adjustment options. This game supports Korean, English, and Japanese.
row.short_description: Pac-Man-type running simulation Camilla is the story of a girl who confronts fear. Check the number of acquired goods for clearance for each stage and acquire all the goods and move on to the next stage. You can clear all the stages consisting of three stages and check the final ending.

row.name: Juggling
row.detailed_description: It's a game where you just keep clicking. Keep clicking anywhere on the game screen. No operations other than clicking are possible. The girl juggles the soccer ball every time you click. If you continue juggling a certain number of times, the background image may change.
row.short_description: It's a game where you just keep clicking. Click to see the girl juggling.

row.name: Cooking with Magic
row.detailed_description: Cooking with Magic is a chaotic and fun cooperative game where players take on the role of witches and wizards working together in a magical kitchen. Welcome to the Arcane Academy , a place where young magic apprentices become masters of the art of magical cuisine. Here, the secrets of the legendary gourmet alchemist, Master Savorix, are passed down from generation to generation. The time is approaching for the Tournament of Magical Cutlery , a culinary competition among apprentices from different magical regions. This annual event celebrates not only excellence in cooking but also the unity and friendship between talented young wizards. However, something dark is happening at the academy. Rare and valuable ingredients are disappearing from the storerooms, and the dishes prepared by the apprentices are coming out with unexpected magical effects. There’s a tension in the air and a mystery to be unraveled. Players take on the roles of apprentices from different magical regions, joining forces in improvised teams to participate in the Tournament of Magical Cutlery. They must work together to prepare challenging magical dishes, from edible potions to enchanted feasts, all while racing against the clock and solving puzzles across various parts of the academy. As the tournament progresses, players uncover clues about the culinary incidents. While the pressure of the competition rises, they must also investigate and solve the mystery behind the culinary chaos before the academy’s reputation is tarnished and the tournament is canceled. With magic, teamwork, and the perfect blend of culinary and magical skills, players will need to save the Tournament of Magical Cutlery and restore trust in the Arcane Academy!
row.short_description: Cooking with Magic is a chaotic and fun cooperative game where players take on the role of witches and wizards working together in a magical kitchen.

row.name: The Void Chronicles Chronis
row.detailed_description: Artemis, a struggling writer who doesn't believe in himself. On July 7, 1947, he finds a mysterious pocket watch on his porch. He thinks nothing of it until something happens to his neighbour, and all of a sudden time has restarted to when he woke up. Can Artemis find out the source of the time loop and figure out how to break it? Game Features -Figure out what in Artemis's routine must change to progress forward. -Meet Artemis's cheerful neighbour named Melody, who is always ready to help. -Immerse yourself in the 1940s aesthetic. -Narrative Driven Experience -A free time-loop game where every reset reveals a new layer of the mystery. Presented by JBOStudios and brought to life by the brilliant mind of the solo-developer at Soul Narrative Games, this experience sheds new light on the time loop genre!
row.short_description: Every decision matters. It’s a race against the clock in a story where paranoia, creativity, and courage are your only allies. Will you break the loop, or will time break you?

row.name: LATEX, LEATHER, LIPSTICK, LOVE, LUST
row.detailed_description: 'My social circles are divided into three, stalwart, mutually exclusive groups. A first of chronically online Tumblr users. I've drifted in and out of several and now exist in one with next to no ties to my home country. A second of extremely normal heterosexuals. The worst they've seen are Instagram wellness reels and Discord does not exist to them. And now, apparently, a third of rubber-coated kinksters who want to rearrange my guts. I feel like someone like me shouldn't have a third. ” LATEX, LEATHER, LIPSTICK, LOVE, LUST is an interactive fiction piece for unemployed British trans men in their 20s with no career prospects whose only major social interactions happen over Discord. Other people can play it as well, I guess. Play the game (for free!) that had people giving such rave reviews as: 'So beautiful, so intense, so funny.' 'I almost cried at several points, and ended up crying at the end.' 'dear god this was an experience' 'the first interactive fiction to make me feel *actually* anxious and afraid' '[slurs]' And won the most controversial entry in IFComp 2024!
row.short_description: A self-described 'chronically online' trans guy goes to a kink club thinking it will fix him. It doesn't.
row.notes: LATEX, LEATHER, LIPSTICK, LOVE, LUST is a mature story featuring various explicit and consensual BDSM sexual acts, suicidal ideation, references to self harm, as well as a deeply unsavory analysis of very unpleasant, very online people. A full list of content warnings can be seen in-game from the main menu under "PERVERSIONS".

row.name: Endless Horizons
row.detailed_description: Endless Horizons is a walking simulator that deals with the problem of seeking validation through others and how it grows old and exhausting as time goes on.  You will land on an alien planet with the task of helping the native Jellyfish people. You use your electricity ball to remove the invasive shark species from the Jellyfish homes. Along the way you will learn more about what motivates you as a person and the internal struggles of Commander Storm. Features - A compelling narrative about what drives Captain Storm - A cool alien planet with habitants to walk around and explore - Electricity Powers to help the native people
row.short_description: You have landed on another planet to fulfill your hero duties. This is your life that you love. Save the Jellyfish from their Shark Adversaries.

row.name: Kombi
row.detailed_description: Kombi is a fun, minimalist, grid-based puzzle game. The aim of the game is to move tiles across the board, picking up points along the way, in order to end up with a single tile with a value that matches the number of the target tile. While it starts off simple, the later campaign levels introduce enough complexity to keep you entertained and scratching your head for hours. And once you've completed the campaign levels, you are free to enjoy an unlimited selection of custom levels, allowing you to play the game indefinitely. There are no limitations or locked levels, each level can be completed in any number of turns, though there is a special completion badge awarded if a level is completed within a certain number of turns. Features 100 campaign levels of various grid sizes A custom level generator allowing you to choose any difficulty you want Minimalist design Relaxing background music Unlimited UNDO options if you make a mistake 4 different themes, including dark mode
row.short_description: Kombi is a fun, minimalist, grid-based puzzle game. The aim of the game is to move tiles across the board, picking up points along the way, in order to end up with a single tile with a value that matches the number of the target tile.

row.name: Auto Adventures
row.detailed_description: Auto Adventures is a free asynchronous PvP hero builder that combines the strategic decision making of a rogue-like with auto-battles against other players. Throughout your adventure you will choose items and skills to make the strongest hero you can while auto-battling other players until you achieve 10 victories, or die trying! This game features: Hundreds of unique items each with different abilities and effects. Choose items that synergize well with each other to create crazy powerful heroes! Dozens of different monster encounters. Defeat monsters to take their items! Find rare and powerful items from strong monsters. Several different archetypes of items, and skill stats for each. When you level up, choose to allocate your stat points to become better at using certain kinds of items. Asynchronous PVP: During each round you make choices to improve your character, such as buying items or defeating monsters. At the end of each round you then auto-battle against another player's character in a PvP matchup. We use an asynchronous match-making system which means that you can take as long (or as short!) as you want to make your turn. There are no round time limits. A globally shared item pool: When players use an item, that item becomes rarer and will show up in shops less often. This system automatically ensures that over-powered and popular items will stop appearing, thereby keeping the meta fresh and dynamic.
row.short_description: This is a free hero builder auto-battler. Embark on a rogue-like adventure choosing items and skills to make the most powerful hero you can, all the while auto-battling against other players!

row.name: Stele
row.detailed_description: Stele is a challenging and intelligent puzzle game filled with problem-solving and decryption. The game features four chapters, encompassing a total of 96 meticulously crafted levels. Each level tests players' logical thinking and strategic planning abilities. Gameplay Mechanics Players need to utilize movable stone pillars and plan their routes to trigger a series of events, paving the way for small squares to reach their destinations smoothly. However, you must consider the element of 'timing' as setting complicated routes will consume more time, but sometimes it becomes a necessary means to clear the level. The game includes various mechanisms, and triggering them can introduce multiple possibilities, leading to unexpected ways to complete the level.
row.short_description: Stele is a challenging and intellectually stimulating puzzle game where players need to utilize movable stone pillars and plan their routes to trigger a series of events, paving the way for a small square to reach its destination smoothly.

row.name: Bygone Dreams: Prophecy
row.detailed_description: Bygone Dreams: Prophecy is a prologue version of the full game Bygone Dreams, it features the first 2 levels with 2-3 hours of gameplay depending on difficulty settings and your skills. VANQUISH THE NIGHTMARE, RESTORE THE DREAM Winner of the Reboot Develop 'Visual Excellence' award. Winner at the 2021 WN Dev Contest as chosen by Epic Games. Bygone Dreams is a high fantasy action adventure with RPG elements set in a surreal dream world. The dream land of Lume, under the protection of its matron deity, is being threatened by a terrible Nightmare. Embodying the spirit known as Wa, you are the world's last hope for survival. To aid you in your quest, you must seek out the world's Guardians - powerful creatures worshiped and revered in times long before the corruption seeped in. However, the task ahead is anything but easy, as the Guardians themselves succumbed to the Nightmare. FEATURES Explore the dream-land of Lume, a vast world full of mystery and danger. Face dozens of epic bosses standing in the way between you and the salvation of the Dream. Fight your way through the game using a combination of melee weapons, ranged weapons, and magic. Customize your equipment to suit your play style. Experience the story on Normal difficulty or get ready for an exceptional challenge on Heroic mode - a ramped up difficulty featuring revamped boss fights and additional Heroic-only bosses. Unlock handcrafted higher difficulty levels. Experience the epic story with over 2 hours of fully voiced cutscenes. Show your mastery in special time trial and no damage boss challenges. The game will take players on an inspirational adventure featuring elements from Slavic mythology and medieval Bosnian folklore. An epic orchestral soundtrack will set the tone of the journey in over 50 original songs full of traditional instruments and melodies. Take a leap into the world of Bygone Dreams and prepare yourself for an unforgettable experience!
row.short_description: Bygone Dreams: Prophecy is a free prologue for a high fantasy Action-Adventure game set inside a surreal dream world. Face fantastical adversaries, solve puzzles, and fight your way through challenging bosses in your quest to save the world's matron deity and stop the nightmare consuming the dream.

row.name: Deeper Underground
row.detailed_description: Trapped underground after a nuclear apocalypse, an unqualified survival “expert” must now lead a growing community of followers who believe in his every word. In Deeper Underground , you must scavenge, build, and lead while keeping morale high and your lies intact. Manage resources, make tough choices, and navigate the psychological pressure of maintaining your fake expertise—because if the truth gets out, survival might be the least of your worries. Key Features: Base Building & Resource Management – Construct and expand your underground shelter, ensuring your community has enough food, water, and supplies. Scavenge the Ruins – Venture into the wasteland in search of valuable resources, but be wary of dangers lurking in the darkness. Choice-Driven Narrative – Shape the story with the lies you tell and the decisions you make—will you admit the truth or keep up the façade? Dynamic Community System – Manage followers with different personalities, needs, and levels of trust in you. Keep them loyal… or risk rebellion. Survival Mechanics – Monitor hunger, radiation exposure, and mental well-being as you fight to stay alive in a crumbling world. Moral Dilemmas – Sacrifice individuals for the greater good, hoard resources, or inspire hope—your leadership style will define your fate. Can you keep your followers alive… and your secret hidden?
row.short_description: Trapped underground after a nuclear apocalypse, a fake survival expert must face the fallout of his lies. Build, scavenge, and lead your community in this darkly comedic survival game where every choice matters.

Brews & Blood: Origin
row.detailed_description: ' Brews & Blood: Origin' is a Atmospheric Horror game where you need to manage a liquor shop in a remote Indian village and escape it's horror. Story: Your uncle calls you for a last-minute favor—he needs you to cover a one-night shift at his liquor shop in a remote Indian village. But why did your uncle choose to hand over his shop to someone else on the very night of the Red Moon? The truth is revealed as the night unfolds.  One shift. One cursed night. Will you survive the horrors of the Red Moon? Gameplay: First-Person Horror Simulation: Manage the liquor shop, serve customers, and complete small tasks—until the horror takes over. Deep Atmospheric Horror: A slow-burn experience where fear creeps in through eerie silence, disturbing visuals, and unsettling encounters. Horror Chase Sequences: As the curse takes hold, terrifying entities will hunt you—run, hide, or find a way to fight back. Car Driving Mechanics: Escape through the haunted village in a desperate drive for survival, but the roads may not lead where you expect.
row.short_description: Brews & Blood is a Atmospheric Horror game where you manage your uncle's liquor shop for one night in a remote Indian village.

row.name: Gladiator Rumble
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Gladiator Rumble! Where your audience transforms into fierce gladiators, ready to fight for glory in the ultimate Twitch-integrated battle simulator. 🔹 What Is Gladiator Rumble? Gladiator Rumble is a unique game built for streamers and their communities. Engage your viewers like never before by turning them into AI-controlled gladiators who battle it out in the arena, all while you set the stakes! 🔹 How It Works: Viewers Join the Fight: With a simple !join command in Twitch chat, viewers step into the arena as AI warriors. Set the Stakes: Decide the prize for victory—whether it's a new stream wallpaper, playing a viewer-submitted song, or letting them join your party in another game! Dynamic Battles: Every battle is unique, with a mix of strategy, chaos, and spectacle. 🔹 Key Features: 🎮 Twitch Integration: Seamlessly connect your channel and watch your viewers compete live. ⚔️ AI-Powered Gladiators: Each viewer's gladiator comes with unique behaviors, adding unpredictability to every battle. 🎉 Interactive Experience: Keep your audience engaged with fun rewards, surprises, and creative challenges. 🔹 Why Streamers Love It: Gladiator Rumble isn’t just a game—it’s an interactive event that turns your channel into a community-driven colosseum. Watch your viewers cheer, taunt, and strategize as their AI gladiators clash for victory. Do you have what it takes to manage the chaos and crown the champion? Download Gladiator Rumble now and bring the ultimate gladiator showdown to your Twitch channel.
row.short_description: Where your audience transforms into fierce gladiators, ready to fight for glory in the ultimate Twitch-integrated battle simulator.
row.notes: Gladiator Rumble features cartoon-style depictions of violence within its AI-controlled battles. Gladiators engage in combat with weapons such as swords, maces, and axes, resulting in visual effects like exaggerated knockbacks, sparks, and minimal blood splatter. The game is intended to be lighthearted and entertaining, with no graphic depictions of gore, dismemberment, or realistic injuries. The tone is more akin to a competitive, fun arena fight rather than a brutal or realistic simulation of violence. There are no depictions of sexual acts, drug or alcohol use, or any themes involving self-harm, assault, or other sensitive topics in the game.

row.name: Speedway Challenge 2025
row.detailed_description: Put your kevlar and helmet on, get on your motorcycle without brakes and hit the track for glory in the 'Speedway Challenge 2025' game! This product will allow you to fulfill all your speedway dreams - become the next world champion, as well as lead your beloved club to the league pedestal. The path of your individual or club career is up to you. Game modes waiting for the player: - Quick Match - a quick way to stand with your rivals under the tape and fight a fierce battle for victory! Choose the teams, indicate the location and go, because the referee has started the two-minute clock, so it would be a shame to be late for the first race. - Career (after in app purchase) - create a new virtual rider or choose one of over a thousand available riders and lead his career according to your own discretion. It's up to you whether you'll become a speedway globetrotter or lead a quiet life and riding once or twice a week. - League (after in app purchase) - build a club from scratch or choose one of the available centers and lead it to the very top in one of several European leagues. Make sure to have a team that complies with the regulations, but remember to be able to afford the salaries. The medal will be the summary of your hard work. - Challenges - accept the challenge and do the task that awaits you. Achieve a specific result as a team or individually, win expected number of times or do not let the rival achieve a significant score. - Online - test your skills in a confrontation with players from all around the world in the ranking game or invite a group of friends (after in app purchase) to play together. You will compete on almost 70 tracks from all over the world - from South America, through the Antipodes to Europe, with competitors who have been precisely reproduced in terms of skill level and riding silhouette. Each competition will be held in accordance with the applicable rules of speedway sport.
row.short_description: Feel speedway emotions thanks to realistic riding physics. Play online mode with friends or local in career mode, league mode, challenges, tournament and quick matches. Are you ready for the challenge?
